about_the_game:
General description:
Montero is a fantasy mystery with RPG elements. Every game session is a story of a random monster hunter, a dwarf belonging to a special class of fighters trained to deal with rare and dangerous enemies. Going on a quest (that usually takes you from half to one and a half hours), the player will have to protect dwarf settlers living in a randomly generated village from an unknown enemy.

History:
The principal feature of a developing kingdom is its growing territory. The new lands are wild, and many dangers await brave colonists who dare to settle there. The new settlements need to be protected, but it would be too costly to send troops to the borders every time a problem arises. This is why the kingdom needs Monteros, monster hunters who do not possess superpowers or artifacts, but rely on constant training, intellect, and knowledge of their enemies.



Gameplay:
Every Montero starts the game already as a skilled tracker, craftsman, fighter, and hunter. The character does not level up any skills during a game session. The success of the mission depends on the player’s choice of the gear and their knowledge of the world that will grow from game to game.
To defeat the final boss of the location, you will first have to find out who it is. In order to do that, your character will collect evidence (bits of fur and armor), talk to the locals, and even exhume bodies to examine the wounds. You will have to build barricades, set traps, make gear to prepare for the fight. This requires resources which you will find in the area or among the locals’ possessions. You will also have to help the settlers to recover from wounds, poisons, and illnesses. If there are no settlers left in the village, your mission is considered a failure.

The final boss is not your only enemy. The newly settled territory is full of wild animals, robbers, poisonous mushrooms and insects. Monteros feel cold and hunger, suffer from poisoning, bleeding wounds, injuries and stress. The game will create a unique location for each session, so that every new mission is different from the previous ones. A successful mission adds objects to your collection of gear that will always be available for future missions. Succeeding, however, will not be easy, since you will have to adapt to the conditions, manage your resources wisely, learn to navigate the terrain, and be quick to employ your combat skills in a fight.
All in all, Montero is mostly about the advancement of the player, not the character.

about_the_game:
VR Antarctic Adventure is an experience that allows you to experience scientific activities in the most fascinating continent on the planet.

You will discover fossils, extract ice samples and have a time travel adventure to discover the Cretaceous period, to understand the relationship between the Antarctic continent and all the continents since the beginning of planet Earth.

This is a project developed by an interdisciplinary team belonging to the National University of Tierra del Fuego, Antarctica and South Atlantic Islands, seeking to expand the offer of activities and technological experiences specifically related to divulge and disseminate information about the natural and cultural heritage of the city of Ushuaia and the Province of Tierra del Fuego.

The interdisciplinary team was composed of:
Director: CP Katherina Carmona
Co-Direction: Dis. Silvana Jaldin
Technical Team Coordination: Lic. Natalia Mella
Graphic Design: Dis. Federico Conforto
Graphic Design: Lic. Francisco Gonzalez
Programming: DV: Nicolás Salguero
Sound: Tec. José Pera
Voice: Lic. Ma. Eugenia Raffi

Scientific collaborators:
Dr. Ma. Eugenia Raffi
Dr. Eduardo B. Olivero
Dr. Daniel Martinioni

Please note that this experience is in Spanish, we are working on the English version.

about_the_game:
About This Game
Touhou Souzinengi V is a full-scale RPG that carries on the traditions of RPGs from the good old days.
It was made with the challenge of seeing just how interesting battles could be with standard, 5-character, turn-based combat,
and whether its character growth system would be fun while remaining simple.
It's an RPG where progress involves figuring out enemy weakness and patterns,
then picking the appropriate party members and skills for the situation, as opposed to just bruteforcing by grinding levels.
It's packed with plenty of content to challenge yourself with, too.
If you include collecting all the items and enemy skills, there's over a hundred hours of fun to be had.
Even just reaching the final boss provides you with dozens of hours,
ensuring that it won't let you down when it comes to its volume.

*Touhou Souzinengi V is a Touhou Project fangame.
Touhou Project is a copyright of Team Shanghai Alice.

about_the_game:
Starfinder RPG - Starfinder Society Scenario #1-02: Fugitive on the Red Planet

A Starfinder Society Scenario designed for levels 1-4.
Theft cannot be tolerated, especially when the culprit is a former Starfinder! The PCs travel to the red world of Akiton, hot on the heels of a deserting Starfinder who stole a magical relic from the vaults of the Lorespire Complex. Things get complicated when they discover what should be a dreary town in Akiton's wastelands is now positively jubilant. Could this revelry, not to mention the re-opening of town's formerly defunct mining operations, be related to the wayward Starfinder?
Written by Jim Groves .

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

  • All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage
  • Individual area descriptions linked to maps, containing new encounters, treasure parcels and descriptions for just that area
  • Tokens for each encounter are all pre-placed in starting locations on the map. You can edit these on the fly.
  • Drag and drop treasure parcels and Encounter XP that is easily awarded to your players to keep the game moving ahead
  • All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them

Converted by:   Christopher Ward

Requires: An active subscription or a one time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds Full or Ultimate license and a one time purchase of the Starfinder ruleset.

about_the_game:
Ground parkour: First Mission, where there are many obstacles and will help you cope with the obstacles.
It is a fun game full of supporting characters and also has a multiplayer system. In the game, you can try to complete the track either online or offline and have new characters. But you should remember that everything is not as easy as it seems. Obstacles can mislead you and get on your nerves. For this reason, always be careful and alert.

The environment of the game is the construction site in the city. Players can have characters with many different themes. For example; You can have many characters such as a worker, a commoner, a boss, an assistant, and add fun to your entertainment with their abilities in the game.

Additionally, the lack of a save function in the game increases the difficulty of finishing the game. You won't get a second chance. Even the slightest misstep can take you back to square one. But your character has different features that will give you an advantage. Depending on the body structure of the characters, some can run fast, some can walk fast, and some can jump high.

Don't be intimidated by the moving obstacles in the game, because your characters are designed to overcome them. Within the map environment; There are moving obstacles, elevators, small and large obstacles, and while these obstacles sometimes give you an advantage, sometimes they can create a disadvantage. There are also objects on the map that will help you jump higher. By using these objects correctly, you can reach the finish point in a shorter time.

Playing the game alone may be boring, so you can increase your fun by inviting your friends.




- You can play with your friends with Online Mode.



- Auxiliary items that will easily take you to heights



- Characters with different physical characteristics.



- Many different categories and characters with different physical characteristics.


Ground parkour: First Mission, in short, you compete with yourself to reach the highest point on the track with different characters and different abilities in a construction site in the city. Each character has different abilities and you progress on this track full of obstacles. Your goal is to reach the finish line at the highest point. Enjoy!

about_the_game:
Experience the essence of deckbuilding. Engage in tense 10-minute battles on a level playing field. Figure out a fun build from a unique set of cards and carefully evolve your deck into a well-oiled war machine. Don’t copy decks, build on-the-fly and let your creativity shine. Every match is a new mind game! Beat the player, not the meta.

In this skill game you have a fair shot at the top spot, no matter the size of your collection. Climb the ranks fighting with weapons of equal strength. There is no pay-to-win.

Hone your skill in single-player missions that inspire your creativity.

Explore the many expansion packs Tuggowar has to offer, discover new cards, abilities, extreme combos, crazy interactions and counter-plays.

Expansion packs each feature 5 replayable missions with objectives of varying difficulty. These objectives help you find some of the more advances strategies. Some involve fixed steps while others are more puzzling.

Exploit powerful card combos and commanding strategies. Analyze, think deep, experience glorious lightbulb moments, discover unknown synergies, test, adapt and outplay to pull off truly epic wins!

Join the ranks of veterans who keep coming back for more, even after hundreds of hours. Just one... more... game...

Features

Innovative mechanics

• Interactive map instead of a life total

• Unique draw system

• Intricate hidden information dynamics

• Disrupt to counter key card combos

Made for PvP

• Ranked & casual modes

• PvP leaderboard

• Play a friend

• Mirrored shop mode

• Relaxed, normal and blitz game speeds

Chill in PvE

• Campaign missions

• Specialized AI bots (easy, normal, hard, unfair)

• Challenge runs: 7 win mini-tournaments

• Pause mid-game & resume later

Ever-growing card pool

• 50 base set cards

• Frequent release of new expansion packs

• New cards, new mechanics and new missions with each expansion

Medal system

• Influence the card pool used in a match

• Play with your favorite cards more often

• Collect medals and create your twist on the game

Progression

• Rank up from bronze to diamond - and beyond

• Collectable avatars & player titles

Analyze and Show Off

• Hyperlink replay sharing & spectator invites

• Observe live high-ranked matches

• Weekly show matches - get your spectacular wins featured!

Alone Again: The Countryside - Lore Book, aims to unravel the mysteries and events of Alone Again, exploring the deep and subjective details of this story.

Accessing the DLC:
After purchasing and downloading Alone Again: The Countryside - Lore Book, find the game in your computer's Steam Client, select “properties”, find the “local files” option and select “explore”. This will take you to the game files, where is the DLC.
After accessing the folder titled "The Lore Book DLC", you will be able to view all the DLC content! It is highly recommended to read the "SPOILER ALERT" file.

We strongly recommend that you DO NOT view this pack if you haven't finished the main game yet, as it contains numerous spoilers that will definitely detract from your final experience.

It is recommended to view the contents of this pack only after completing the game!

about_the_game:
Play as a contestant on the most violent game show of all time, The Kill Zone! In this top-down shooter, you'll murder hundreds of attackers in brutal fashion on your way to epic showdowns against challenging bosses. Dual-stick controls allow you to move and attack in all directions. Crouch behind objects or roll to evade attacks.

Try not to feel too bad for the attackers as you slaughter them in a blood bath. We get to know more about certain attackers in the 'Featured Story' segment, where we take a look into their personal life and motivation for joining The Kill Zone, right before entering the arena and facing certain death.   • Co-operative Multiplayer: Support for up to 4 players using Photon Fusion.

  • Gamepad Support: Support for Xbox and PS4 style gamepads.

about_the_game:
Jump into a canoe and control it at the same time. SHOUT, PANIC, MISCOMMUNICATE, OVERSTEER, and somehow still move forward, together. The ultimate test for your friendship is waiting for you.

This is not a peaceful river ride. It’s physics-based multiplayer MADNESS where every second counts. HIT every rock, SCREAM through every turn, and FLIP OVER when it matters most.

Yes, there’s a baby. And yes, YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE. Paddle through rapids, rocks, and sheer panic while desperately trying not to flip the boat and launch the poor thing into oblivion.

Overcome wildly different challenges, dodge unpredictable obstacles, and try to finish the course without flying, falling, or fully losing your mind. Be warned: every turn hides a new surprise and YOU ARE ABSOLUTELY NOT READY FOR IT.

about_the_game:
This DLC is an open window on UFHO2’s development, an adventure that lasted more than 2 years - more than 5 taking the original version made in Flash in 2010 into account.

Contents:

  • Almost 500 screenshots of 2 years of work in progress. In these, you will be able to see the game as it was made, from the very first shape of rooms, to the last UI tweaks (including things that were changed during development).
  • Other Versions contains the first UFHO of 2007, in its offline form, and the initial prototype of UFHO2 of 2010, with a simple AI to play against. Both require Flash Player. Also, you will find the pirated version that was released in April 2014 on torrents (save data is not compatible with the full version).
  • Some promotional graphics, icons, covers, box art
  • Some work-in-progress graphics, sketches, drawings, concept art - including the pixel Jeevil character that were featured in the WiiWare game Bit.Trip RUNNER by Gaijin Games.
  • The trailers produced for the original Flash version, then called "UFHO Space Academy". Notice how the first one referred to a version that was supposed to come out on Facebook!
  • The video that was used for the 2012 Kickstarter campaign.
  • Some work-in-progress audio, with the draft for the aliens voices, some of which were never chosen.

about_the_game:
The Rabbit Haul has you playing a cute rabbit trying to rebuild their hometown that’s been ravaged by greedy raccoons. During the day, you are growing crops in your farm and adding them to your food haul to help rebuild your town’s economy and food reserves, as well as planting and growing defensive tower plants that will help defend against the Trash Panda Posse. When you choose, you turn to the night phase to ward off increasingly difficult enemy waves attempting to bring you back to ruin. The cycle continues until you defeat all the waves in the run, and you are rewarded for your progress to rebuild the town and upgrade yourself for the next adventure.

During the day phase, you can spend as much time as you’d like growing your garden. Plant crops and towers, water your farm, upgrade your defenses, and add harvested crops to your haul. Be strategic in your placement - you will be awarded for synergies created between plants - making the best garden possible.




When you choose to go to the night phase, you will defend your haul alongside your flower towers against an increasingly stronger Trash Panda Posse. Each wave gets stronger, with different enemy types attempting to spoil your riches, so you must upgrade your weapons and defenses to ensure you can survive the night and make it to the next day.




Explore a sprawling, randomly generated world full of treasures and quests, able to provide you with unique items and helpers to rebuild your town and reinforce your farm even further.




Between runs, you can upgrade your playstyle, unlock new merchants, and prepare yourself for your next adventure. With an array of unique weapons, upgrade paths, powerful towers and crops to unlock, The Rabbit Haul offers countless playstyles for players to master.

A series of freight locomotives CO (Sergo Ordzhonikidze, axle load 17 tonnes) designed for medium loads and working on lines with light rail. Built from 1934 to 1951 at the Kharkov, Bryansk, Voroshilovgrad, Krasnoyarsk and Ulan-Ude Locomotive Works. Total production of locomotives - 3049.

Currently, the engine operating SO17-4171, is used for filming movies and holiday trips. Outside of this it is in an exhibit at the museum railway transport in Kiev, Ukraine.

The model is based on real photos.

SPECIFICATIONS
  • Axial: 1-5-0 formula.
  • Diameter of driving wheels: 1320 mm.
  • Design speed: 75 km / h
  • Maximum power: 2200 hp
  • The length of a steam locomotive with tender: 23 m
  • Weight of locomotive in working condition so: 97.8
  • Heating oil
  • Tender: four-type 11.
  • The stock fuel oil: 18 tons

NOTE: To use this locomotive once installed you can find the locomotive and tender under the Trainz Tab when searching for "CO17".

“THE SUPER SPACE SNIPER COMES. NOBODY CAN SURVIVE.”


Toaplan’s Out Zone is back in action and reloaded with modern features, like online leaderboards, arcade-accurate emulation, quick saves, and the brand-new beginner mode. As one of the most celebrated run and gun shooters in arcade history, its hellish challenges will get your blood pumping if you have the skills to match!

Countless alien invasions of Earth have left humankind on the verge of extinction. You must plunge headfirst into battle as a world-class cyborg mercenary in a last-ditch effort to overthrow the alien threat!

ORIGINAL GAME FEATURES:

  • Run and gun your way through hordes of enemies in this vertical shoot 'em up!
  • Go at it solo, or join forces with a buddy in co-op mode!
  • Master a unique weapon system with omnidirectional lasers, straight-shooting shotguns, and special weapons like the Super Burner and the Super Ball to obliterate the alien attackers!
  • Stay alive and alert by keeping an eye on your constantly depleting battery!
  • Feel your heart pump to Tatsuya Uemura's original soundtrack!

QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS:

  • Minimal Input Lag: Emulation, input processing, and rendering all complete on the same frame.
  • Quick Save using F1-F10, Reload with Shift+ F1-F10
  • Online leaderboards for Single Credit, No Assist, and Assisted plays.
  • Instrument panels with extra gameplay information and artwork.
  • Rewind the game between 10-18 minutes, depending on the action.
  • Capture sharable replays to immortalize your interstellar victories (or funny moments).
  • Assist Features such as auto-fire at multiple rates.
  • Very Easy Mode: Lower the difficulty to breeze through the adventure.
  • Pixel perfect or full-screen scaling in windowed or full-screen mode.
  • Rotate the gameplay in 90-degree increments.
  • Steam Achievements
  • Choose between Raw Input on Windows or Steam Input.
  • Hone your skills in the ultra-customizable practice mode!

about_the_game:
After a long day you just want to get home, so you head to the parking garage, but something doesn't feel right. Something lurks in the dark, something that stalks you, something that wants to sell you overpriced insurance.

To make things worse, you have lost your parking card and are out of cash. Your task is to find the parking card and find some money to pay for your stay at one of the Park 'n Pay machines. While you wander the long tunnels and spacious halls of the underground garage, you may find yourself face to face with Warranty Man, or maybe he will walk up to you from behind, you always need to be on the lookout.

Instructions

The rules are simple to successfully evade Warranty Man and escape

  • Find your lost parking ticket, you need this to pay for your parking

  • Collect some cash, luckily there are a lots of lost bank notes scattered around

  • Collected all of the above? Find a Park 'n Pay machine

  • Are you being chased by the salesman? No Problem! 

    • First, do not look at him and try to outrun your chaser, eventually he will disappear

    • Second, look around, can you see any vans nearby? Go near it to pretend its yours, he doesn't sell insurance for those things. He will leave you alone, just do not look at him

  • Got caught and had to buy insurance? Well, there is always the Retry button

Playtime

The first successful run should take 30-60 minutes to complete. There are no saves, once you are caught it's game over. The locations of the bank notes and the parkig card are random on each run, so as the frequency of the salesman apparitions. The difficulty of each run is influenced by those things.

about_the_game:
Storm is an atmospheric survival game. This is the first, short introduction to a series of episodes of Storm. You wake up in an intense snowstorm. As you look around for ways to get out of the biting cold, to somehow find shelter, your body gets colder, your hands freeze up, and the storm intensifies. And as you slowly move forward a bigger question rises: who are you? Where are you? How did you get here?

INSPIRATION


Storm is a game about identity, and about destiny. Storm lives somewhere between a film and a game. We were inspired by the visual beauty of extreme environments; an aesthetically beautiful but deadly experience where your body is pushed to the extreme.

THE FUTURE


The snowstorm is just the beginning of a bigger project. We have 5 further levels planned out, and a detailed script in-progress. Each level will take place in different environments. A desert sandstorm, a jungle, a city. And each level will be connected by a narrative where your quest for survival is intertwined with your ability to resolve the mystery around your identity.

TEAM


Team Storm VR is made of a small group of friends. Storm is a passion project that we mostly work on in our spare time.

The main character in Storm is voiced by the amazing Tommie Earl Jenkins.

We'd love to hear from you!

  • Solve mysteries by manipulating your memory. Escape a factory, solve a crime, and win the hearts and minds of your enemies by changing the past.
  • Get immersed in an epic narrative-driven adventure with a diverse cast of characters.
  • Get to know over 10 unique characters, each with their own quirks.
  • Investigate and solve the mystery of your mysterious power. Who is behind this?

about_the_game:
Between the monster attacks and the magic theory essays, your sophomore year at Magi Academy is shaping up to be a killer.

Keeper of Day and Night is a 390,000 word interactive urban fantasy novel by Brynn Chernosky, where your choices control the story. It’s entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

A newly declared keeper, you realize life hasn’t changed much when you’re attacked by werewolves over the summer. With the aftermath of a demon attack to deal with, the kidnapping of a girl who isn’t supposed to exist, and more magic theory homework than ever, your sophomore year at Magi Academy is shaping up to be a killer. Hopefully not literally.

  • Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bi, or asexual.
  • Romance or befriend one of ten love interests, from a cheerful clairvoyant to a snarky telepath, each with a unique subplot.
  • Learn to control your powers as one of seven unique species, from human to nephilim, while raising a hellhound puppy, phantom kitten, or dragon hatchling.
  • Choose one of six majors, from Magic Theory to Magic Technology Engineering.
  • Embrace your celebrity status as a keeper, or swear off press conferences forever.
  • Support one of the factions working to take control of New Magi City, or forge your own path.
  • Discover the secrets of your past, and become involved in the NMC intrigue yourself.

about_the_game:
Relax & recover in this short free 3D environment where you take control of your favorite bath tub girl. My Bath Tub Companion is an experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax.

Watch her from a distance, become her rubber duck toy, or see through her eyes. Take control and watch her enjoy herself with props around the room.

Gain answers to some of life's biggest questions, like: What is my girlfriend doing when she is in the bath tub for so long? How did we use up so much hot water on the utility bill? Why is there a charge for 50 rubber ducks on my credit card?



People have places to be, stress to worry about, but not you.
Sit back, relax, listen to the sounds, enjoy the soothing visuals. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience, and we've got you covered. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at.

Features List

  • Create ducks in the bath tub
  • Possess the rubber duck & see what she does with it
  • Possess her to see through her eyes
  • Relaxing music

About

Relax & recover in this short free 3D environment where you take control of your favorite bath tub girl. My Bath Tub Companion is an experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax.

Watch her from a distance, become her rubber duck toy, or see through her eyes. Take control and watch her enjoy herself with props around the room.

Gain answers to some of life's biggest questions, like: What is my girlfriend doing when she is in the bath tub for so long? How did we use up so much hot water on the utility bill? Why is there a charge for 50 rubber ducks on my credit card?



People have places to be, stress to worry about, but not you.
Sit back, relax, listen to the sounds, enjoy the soothing visuals. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience, and we've got you covered. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at.

  • Create ducks in the bath tub
  • Possess the rubber duck & see what she does with it
  • Possess her to see through her eyes

It is just a red tomato with a stupid hat. He tries to look like a cool tomb raider, rolling and jumping all over the maps.
Help him find all the treasures in the mystic castle or watch him many painful ways.

THE GAME

Tomato Jones is a physics-based puzzle/adventure game. It combines the classical gameplay of an RPG platformers with the skill driven game style of the ball rolling games.
Your goal is to collect all coins and the hidden golden artefact at the end of each level, while avoiding various dangerous traps, obstacles and enemies.
The game is crafted in the atmosphere of "Indiana Jones" movies, while trying to be as funny and humorous as it can be.

Take a look at the features:

FEATURES

- 20 beautiful and challenging levels(5 in the DEMO)
- Great looking "soft body" tomato physics
- World map /actually I'm not sure why I've done that thing. :) /
- New approach to camera movement and viewing angles
- Fun soundtrack and SFX
- Super cool gameplay
- Tons of ketchup

And hey...you can also drive mine carts ;)

Temptation at Sunset Cove

A Week of Sun. A Lifetime of Choices.

When Ethan finally meets Lily—the woman he's shared a long-distance digital romance with for two years—the stage is set for a dream vacation at an exclusive tropical resort. But paradise has its price. Amidst sun-drenched beaches, hidden lagoons, and moonlit dinners, Ethan will face more than just rekindled passion. He'll navigate jealousy, temptation, and the kind of erotic discoveries that can either strengthen love... or destroy it.

Temptation at Sunset Cove is a fully voiced adult visual novel that puts you in control of Ethan’s choices as he and Lily explore their relationship across a single unforgettable week. Will their bond survive the seductions of the resort? Or will new desires take root and blossom into something even more dangerous?

🔥 Explicit, choice-driven storytelling
❤️ Multiple relationship paths and endings
🌴 Exotic resort setting with steamy, branching encounters
💔 Romance, drama, betrayal... and redemption

Whether you stay loyal, open your relationship, or give in to temptation, every decision leads to new possibilities—and consequences. Will you chase fantasy, fight for love, or embrace the chaos?

One week. Every choice matters.

about_the_game:
"Times Of War" is an immersive tower defense game developed by TARTORGAMES S.R.L. Engage in intense battles against a variety of military vehicles as they advance towards your base. Strategically deploy Gun Towers, Laser Towers, and Plasma Towers to protect your territory. Upgrade your towers, place traps, and manage resources to enhance your defenses. Power Plants generate electricity, while Cryogen Refrigerators help maintain tower efficiency. Gain experience, level up, and unlock Technology Points to upgrade structures. Immerse yourself in this thrilling game filled with ranks, achievements, and strategic challenges. Lead your defenses to victory in "Times Of War."

Welcome to "Times Of War," an immersive tower defense game developed by TARTORGAMES S.R.L. In this captivating game, you will find yourself engaged in intense battles against a wide range of military vehicles, including cars, tanks, helicopters, and planes. As they relentlessly advance towards your base, your strategic prowess will be tested as you deploy and utilize three unique types of towers to halt their progress and safeguard your territory.

Prepare to explore a variety of structures and resources at your disposal. The structures available for placement include Gun Towers, Laser Towers, Plasma Towers, Power Plants, and Cryogen Refrigerators. Each structure possesses its own unique characteristics and special abilities, providing you with a diverse range of defensive options.

In "Times Of War," you have the ability to upgrade your towers, enhancing their range, attack rate, and damage capabilities. With each upgrade, your towers gain additional special abilities, further empowering your defensive strategy. Furthermore, you can strategically place traps along the vehicle path, detonating them at critical moments. These traps require resources such as inflammable barrels, different types of plates, and cement bags.

Throughout the game, you will collect and manage resources, including inflammable barrels, cement bags, as well as granite, wood, and metal plates. Additional resources in the form of battery capacity, overall electric capacity, and general consumption capacity play crucial roles in maintaining and expanding your defensive capabilities. Resource collection and storage can be optimized through the upgrading of your depot, allowing for increased storage space.

While placing structures, it is essential to consider the battery cost associated with each placement. Power Plants, when strategically positioned, generate electricity periodically, thereby increasing your battery capacity. They also contribute to the overall electric capacity. However, be mindful of your general consumption capacity, as exceeding it will cause all towers to halt until you either destroy a tower or place an additional Power Plant.

The performance of your towers can be affected by their temperature, with prolonged use resulting in increased heat. However, the placement of Cryogen Refrigerators within the range of towers helps to reduce their temperature, thereby preserving their efficiency.

During gameplay, you may encounter pre-existing structures that require repair to augment your overall electric capacity. Every action in the game generates experience points (XP), allowing you to level up. Leveling up grants you Technology Points, which can be utilized within the technological upgrade tree for your structures. Additionally, "Times Of War" features ranks and achievements, providing an additional layer of challenge and accomplishment.

Embark on an exhilarating journey in "Times Of War" as you defend against waves of relentless military vehicles, deploy powerful towers, and strategically manage resources to emerge victorious. Are you ready to lead your defenses to victory?

about_the_game:
Gameplay:

Goal

get to the top of the pinball machine.

Controls

Left button for the left flipper, right for the right. Pull the plunger (that metal thing that launches the ball from the start). That’s it.

Expecting more from a pinball machine?

Easy to learn, hard to master

Maintain the ball’s momentum and time your flipper hits just right. Use the environment to your advantage and discover your own shortcuts.

(Warning: Sometimes a clever idea can backfire.)

Varied levels, each with its own personality.

Every new stage brings fresh challenges—ride the wind, hit buttons, travel through gravity tunnels, smash meteors, and conquer arenas!

A true paradise for speedrunners!

(Before making any rash decisions, remember: the beginning is always a place you can return to.)

Immersive visual style:

The machine clearly shows its age-chipped paint reveals once-hidden screws, and loose wires occasionally peek through.

Still, none of that takes away from the handcrafted charm and craftsmanship FlippTech once poured into their machines.

(FlippTech is not responsible for any damage to your mental well-being, nor for any destruction caused while attempting to complete this product. Play responsibly.)

Character Choice and CyMu (Cymut and Mutrobo)

Choose a character and CyMu of your choice to start your journey.

CyMu Capture

Build a strong team, trying to capture your favorite CyMu.
You can also capture the Special Cymut or Special Mutrobo which are much stronger but only appear at random times and locations.

Evolution of CyMu

Is it difficult to capture? Then gather the necessary items to evolve your CyMu.

CyMu Collection

Complete your Cymut collection to earn a Special Cymut, which is much stronger.
Complete your Mutrobo collection to earn a Special Mutrobo, which is much stronger.

Inventory

When you defeat an enemy, collect their loot, which will be sent directly to your inventory.

Big boss

Get ready to face the six bosses, one from each element (Water/Ice, Electric, Plant, Evil Wind, Fire, Earth).

2 player mode

Play with a friend on the same computer in 2 player mode.
Player 1 requires a keyboard and mouse, player 2 requires a joystick (Gamepad).

Help Dr. Albert

The main objective of the game is to deliver the 6 Boomags to Dr. Albert because only he can save us from this uncontrolled mutation of Cymuts and Mutrobos.

about_the_game:
Rev up your engines, it’s almost time to race back to the past with Rally Arcade Classics! 

Whether you are a veteran craving for some good old arcade rally game, or a rookie that is willing to take the challenge and race versus racing legends, Rally Arcade Classics puts on the table every ingredient to experience a rush to the past.

Including 44 iconic cars from the 70’s, 80’s, 90’s and 00’s, and 48 thrilling tracks to rev up their engines to the max while drifting every close turn, you will never run out of challenges to take upon.

Speed is (almost) everything. Beat every timer, collect credits to purchase faster cars, collect golden cups and stars to unlock more challenges in the following game modes:

Licences: Before you take the wheel behind one of the legendary rally cars, you got to test yourself and get the licence to drive them in 10 custom made tracks.

Tour: Race through a variety of challenges across four different countries to get credits, stars and the reigning spot of nº1 on the online leaderboard.

Arcade: Get your hand full with 16 unique old arcade challenges, where you will race against 14 other drivers across 4 different tracks to reign supreme as the winner.

Rally: The classic mode, where you will drive through one of the four countries rallies, racing neck to neck with legendary drivers to conquer the gold cup. With 3 different difficulty levels, and 3 different wheel drives car categories, we exchange exhausting hour-long gameplays for some quick and always-changing short bursts of action with much more variety.

Events: Weekly and monthly events, where everyone gets the same track, car and weather conditions and climb to the top score on the leaderboard.

Chrono: You can choose country, track, car, time of the day and weather conditions to test yourself on different cars and road conditions to amp up your game.

 

Rev up your engines, it’s almost time to race back to the past!

Midtris is mind bending puzzle game where your goal is to place blocks around the center piece and clear layers of perfect squares. Blocks will appear from 4 different directions and game will get harder as you destroy more blocks.

There are 5 different game modes to play. Bombs and other special blocks will spice up the gameplay. Classic mode will offer more traditional block stacking experience without bombs.

Complete challenges and unlock new block styles. These should offer challenge even for experienced players, but if that is not enough you can compete with other players on global leaderboard.

Midtris is sequel for Centrist with modern rules. Some of the new features include:

  • SRS (Wall kicks)

  • Block holding

  • More pieces shown in next block displayer

  • Updated UI and menu backgrounds

  • New game modes (Midtris & Pentos)

  • New music

  • Score rework

Master Jump Charging, Quick Falling, and Double Jumping to maximize your movement. Collect Ammo Boxes and Med Kits to keep the fight going! Activate Power-Ups to annoy your friends or give yourself an advantage! Duel Timers is a unique take on two classic genres!

Important Note: Duel Timers requires both a Controller and Keyboard and Mouse. Player 1 will always play on Keyboard, and Player 2 will always play on Controller. This also applies for players using Remote Play Together. Remote Play Together also works across platforms, but a controller is still needed for Player 2, as is the case for all Remote Play Together games with multiple independent players.

about_the_game:
A fantasy story full of magic and intrigue that will transport you to a different time and place. Ranger Quest is a 2D top down adventure game that combines exploration with the puzzle aspects of a maze. A modern game that incorporates pixel art to create the nostalgia of an 80’s era top down adventure game.


No adventure would be complete without doors to open and rooms to explore. Navigate through the maze to find the elemental orbs and the pieces of the magic map. With each orb you find, more of the maze will open up for you to search.


Activate shrines and be transported between floors. Only by moving back and forth between floors will you be able to find the correct path and solve the puzzle.

The Minotaur Maze Engine takes a classic 2D Maze and reinvents it by having the walls move. A game designed to be enjoyable and challenging for players of all ages. For anyone who has enjoyed the simple pleasure of completing a maze at some point in their lives. The Minotaur Maze Engine brings the classic maze into the 21st century.
Developed with the Godot game engine.
Music and sound effects obtained from ZapSplat.
The Minotaur Maze Engine. The maze where the walls move.

about_the_game:
A massive extinction-level event in the year 2040 wiped out the entire Earth. Human civilisation was effectively ended.

You awaken 1000 years later with no memory of what happened. Everything has been completely and utterly destroyed. All alone with no one in sight, you need to survive and explore this strange new world. Animal and plant life have somehow found a way. Are you the only person left alive? Determined to find out what happened, you head out searching for answers.

But beneath the beautiful facade, this world hides a secret far beyond your understanding...

INTRODUCTION

This is a realistic physics-based open-world survival game. Survival, crafting, exploration and base building are the main focus. You will need to hunt for food and water and survive against environmental hazards. There may be unknown dangers ahead. Combat is possible, but more of a defensive nature.

It is still currently very early in development, but some basic survival and building is already in place.

IMMERSIVE PHYSICAL INTERACTIONS

Every object you grab has collisions and interacts with the environment. Push things with a stick, hit objects or move things out of the way. Your hands will dynamically touch and rest nearby walls or surfaces. Foliage rustles and bends when you walk through and slows you down.

Characters are full physics-based active ragdolls and will react to and collide with physics objects. They can walk, run, climb and lose balance and fall down realistically. Grab and pull them and they will move along. Pull too hard and they will fall down.

UNIQUE 3D PHYSICAL INVENTORY SYSTEM

Unlike other games with a standard 2D grid inventory, this inventory system stores items as physical 3D objects and can be moved and arranged and grabbed seamlessly during gameplay. A custom physics solution allows for controllable collisions, arranging and prevents objects flying away.

BEAUTIFUL ENVIRONMENTS

Beautiful natural scenery for you in immerse yourself in. Dense forests, beaches, coral reefs, mountains and other natural environments to be explored. Discover and scan new species of flora and fauna. Build your base and just chill and enjoy the scenery.

NEXT-GEN REALISTIC WATER

Next-gen cutting-edge water system with realistic splashes, foam, bubbles and droplets. All moving together with the flow using real-time fluid simulation. Physics buoyancy system makes objects float and move with the current.

REALISTIC FOOD

Highly detailed food models based on actual photographs makes eating an enjoyable experience. Like in real life, you need time to chew and swallow and not just instantly have it disappear. Hunt, prepare and cook gourmet dishes. Survival can be an enjoyable experience!

BUILDING

Build your own base and defend against enemies. Solve puzzles in the world, for example building a bridge to cross a river, stairs to reach high places, or just plain out creatively building things for fun.

  • Please listen, there isn't much time, we have to warn you before the memory backup fails, you must- SIGNAL LOST.

  • Seriously, the game doesn't deserve a soundtrack this good.

about_the_game:
Enter the realm of a retired assassin, forced back into action by treason. You may be a hired killer but you still have a sense of loyalty and justice. Visit the dark recesses of a world corrupted by crime, greed, degradation and dishonor. And a past that catches up with you.

Trust no one - if the price is right, the finger of your most trusted ally will be on the trigger. Your targets may hide in the most remote areas of the planet, but their destruction is never prevented - only postponed.

Learn your trade - master your tools - overcome your obstacles - outsmart your enemies - eliminate your targets. Remember: rash decisions bleed consequences. Know when to strike instantly, know when to take your time. Chance favors the prepared. Failure is not an option.

  • Pick up contracts in exotic locations around the globe: Sicily, St. Petersburg, Japan, Malaysia, and India.

  • Operate in a non-linear world where the outcome of your actions and proficiency as a hitman are measured on a balance between stealth and aggression.

  • Stalk and eliminate your targets up close and personal, in either 1st or 3rd person perspectives.

  • Execute your assignments with a diverse arsenal of equipment, from armor-piercing sniper rifles and explosives to chloroform and poison darts.

  • Acquire and carry weapons and tools from mission to mission through an enhanced inventory and save-game system.

  • Original soundtrack composed by Jesper Kyd and performed by The Budapest Symphony Orchestra.

Omno: Prologue is a standalone mini-adventure set in the world of Omno. Intended as an introduction to the world of Omno, this prologue will introduce you to some of the game’s mechanics, creatures and ideas, but is completely separate to the main game, coming Spring 2021.



Omno whisks you away on a journey of discovery through an ancient world of wonders. A single-player adventure full of puzzles, secrets and obstacles to overcome, where the power of a lost civilisation will carry you through forests, deserts and tundras - even to the clouds.

  • A gentle yet emotional single player journey
  • Discover and explore a beautiful, mysterious world
  • Strange and fantastical creatures to befriend
  • Challenging puzzles and ancient secrets to uncover
  • Lovingly crafted by solo developer Jonas Manke over 5 years

About the developer
Jonas Manke, solo developer and father of 3, began work on Omno as a hobby project 5 years ago after working as an animator in both games and movies.

about_the_game:
Once upon a time in the late 20th century AD, near the turn of the penultimate decade of the millennia, a magical confluence occurred in Middle School Macintosh computer labs across the globe: Artillery.

Infamously known by teachers as the scourge of attention -- countless students spending entire computer lab periods firing cannons at each other instead of writing English assignments. The temptation too great, no child could refuse the siren's call of the game's accurate physics model and competitive nature.

Notebook Artillery is a love letter to hours wasted playing video games in Middle School computer labs instead of working on class assignments. And sure, maybe if I would've spent more time paying attention in class and less time playing video games I wouldn't be making indie games as a means to pay off insane amounts of student debt. But hey, its 2020 and maybe this can be one last beacon of hope for myself and everyone who loves this kind of game.

Players choose their "firing angle" and "powder amount" to fire cannonballs at opposing player's towers, or break floating targets in a solo player target practice mode. The randomly generated stage layouts will change strategy from round to round, and wind strength has an effect on a cannonball's trajectory which players must account for. Its simple arcade-simulation-action, fun for all ages, with completely hand drawn game art running at a gorgeous 4K. It's like you're looking directly into a Trapper Keeper and the imagination of every middle school kid. Whats not to love?

  • Hand drawn game art in gorgeous 4k.
  • Play Solo target practice, or challenge local friends and family in vs mode.
  • 3 unique world styles fashioned after various wild west motifs.
  • Stage layouts are randomly generated to make no two games the same.
  • Fight the wind and dodge trees to destroy opponents strongholds.
  • Completely visual buttons, no in-game writing.

This was such a fun game to make, and it's so much fun to play with my kids, I hope you find it as fun as I do. And for fans of the original Macintosh classic, I hope this fulfills the desire to play this game again.

Made with GameMaker Studio 2

about_the_game:
Not Tonight: One Love is a full, extra chapter that follows on from the main Not Tonight storyline. King's Head Dave has had just about enough of everything happening in Britain, and has decided to pack up and move to France, in the hope of finding true love.

Will love bloom for Dave, or will he end up looking like a complete wally? Only you can help Dave to secure his romantic future, while the UK collapses in his rear-view mirror.

  • Take on the role of fan favorite King's Head Dave!
  • Help Dave find love in France, while Britain burns down behind him!
  • Use the FlamR app to meet new people and attempt to win their hearts!
  • Mix cocktails like the Snowflake and the Wired Russian!
  • Keep riff-raff out of clubs to earn a living in la France!
  • Around 3-4 hours for one playthrough, with multiple endings to find
  • Humor that is guaranteed to make you laugh at least 7, maybe 8 times

about_the_game:
Tuoni is a turn-based RPG that borrows aesthetics and elements from old-school roguelikes.
It is an atmospheric blend of exploration, simple but tactical combat, and extensive buildcrafting. Take your weapon, grab your armor, and wander towards the northern wilderness on your mission to reach Tuoni, the land of the dead.

JOURNEY TO FINNISH MYTHOLOGY

Explore a rich fantasy-world inspired by Finnish legends and the untamed northern wilderness. Tuoni offers a unique blend of old-school RPG-design and atmospheric worldbuilding, where ancient spirits, forgotten creatures, and silent but all-seeing forests accompany your journey through the unknown.


Mountains, forests, and marshes stretch endlessly, each region telling its own story through inhabitants and environment. Gnomes skitter in woods, trolls lurk in dark caves, and spirits drift between trees and water. Who knows, you might even cross paths with Näkki by a dark pond or glimpse the ancient wrath of Iki-Turso rising from the depths.

EXPLORE THE UNTAMED WILDS

  • Open World: The North is vast, wild, and slow to reveal its secrets. Trek across howling fens, mossy cliffs, and ancient forests, on your journey to reach land of the dead, Tuoni. There are no set paths, only the ones you carve for yourself.

  • Procedural Generation: Wilderness shifts with every journey. Twisting cave systems, forgotten trails, and roaming beasts are reborn with each venture. Key locations stay unchanged, and offer memorable characters and deep lore to uncover.

  • Finnish Mythology: Step into a world shaped by ancient Finnish myth. From deathly marshes to spirit-haunted woods, every corner of the wild holds presence of forgotten gods, various spirits of the nature and large amount of creatures from small to gigantic. Is that a stone or a troll?

LEARN TO SURVIVE

  • Turn-based Combat: Fights are tactical and unforgiving, and rely on a tick-based system. Magic can empower weapons just as easily as it tears through foes. Do you grab an axe, explore powers of fire or become a feared shaman?

  • Freely Explore: Tuoni lets you choose your path. Explore where you will, shape your character as you see fit, and decide who lives or dies. But tread carefully, as the land does not forget.

BUILD YOUR LEGACY

  • Character Development: There are no hard-set classes, only choices. Shape your hero from a wide array of archetypes like Frostborn, Stone Guardian or Battle Shaman (and many, many others), while forging a build that stands the test of time! 

  • Upgrade Weapons: As you journey deeper into the wild, you'll uncover ways to reshape and enhance your gear, to make your journey longer and stronger.

  • Enemy Variety: Wolves, bears, and other beasts roam the land, some still natural, others hollowed and warped by unknown forces. In the depths of troll-caves, increasingly deadlier and older trolls live, each layer revealing something more ancient and grim. What can you find down there?

AN ADVENTURE AND A CHALLENGE

Blending RPG's and Roguelikes, Tuoni offers two game-modes:

  • Adventure Mode: Progress is saved on checkpoints, and each death starts from most recent one. Beware however, world is still dangerous and poses a great deal of challenge.

  • Traditional Mode: Truly challenge yourself with a world that kills you for good. No more checkpoints and every death starts all the way from beginning.

FAQ

Does the game use AI-art?

No. All graphical assets (in-game and Store-page), music and sound-effects are created by human artists.

Can CRT-filter be removed?
Yes, and adjusted if you wish to.

about_the_game:
It's a cold morning in the dungeons of Castle Moonshine and cyberized hunk Ryukaze and his many friends and foes are moping around in their cells, not remembering who they are or what they are doing there. Their wretched lives are about to change however when a mysterious psychopath approaches them with a diabolical plan. Could this all be the work of the School Held Back Program? Yes, it is. The gang soon find themselves hopelessly lost in the darkest corners of the dungeon, disillusioned but determined to survive. Only one question remains...

What is the point of Phucker in the Rome?

GENRE
Roller Coaster Psychological Edge of Your Seat Visual Novel Thriller

GAME INFO
Use the mouse to navigate, make important choices and self-investigate. Be enthralled by the gripping story line with a twist ending that will have you reeling for days.

PROS
 Is better than Woods and Gulag.
 Babes and hunks beyond your wildest imagination.
 Will elicit "gamer feels".

CONS
 Is in good taste.
 Makes sense.
 Will increase your social credit score.

DODORI is a rhythm adventure game where you perform music along the lines of a rotating square. To create the ultimate performance, steady and passionate band practice is a must!

There are only six days left until the festival!

And this year's festival feels different— Rumor has it a super famous band is coming to visit!

But suddenly, your bandmates start handing in their resignation letters...?

You play as Sara, the vocalist of the Soun High School band, and it's up to you to bring the band back together.

DODORI isn’t a serious game.

Right now, it's just a giant pudding(!), but many more fun and varied events are on the way!

but maybe, just maybe, music isn't the most important thing after all.

about_the_game:
Soul's Remnant is a free to play 2D platformer MMORPG by Chaomoon, with a focus on social gameplay and exploration. Customize your skills with our classless system, team up with others, and defeat monsters, bosses, and dungeons together!

Venture into the mysterious world of Soul's Remnant with friends or meet new ones along the way—just watch out when night falls!

Game features:

  • 2D platformer MMORPG with a cute and colorful pixel art graphics style

  • Large world to explore with lots of monsters, bosses, dungeons, and secrets to find!

  • Classless skill system and various stats to build your character with

  • Lots of equipment of various rarities to find and upgrade

  • Challenging dungeons and bosses for your (and your friends) to conquer

  • Guild system with various perks for you and your guild to unlock

  • Full crafting and gathering system, with many recipes to unlock and items to craft

  • Comprehensive quest system that provides various fun missions to complete for rewards

  • Lots of player-driven and party-based content, such as parties, party grinding, housing, and player shops for a full player-driven economy!

  • Full soundtrack of 30+ originally composed songs, all written, composed, and produced by Chaomoon

Made by a small indie team!

Hi, I'm Chaomoon! For nearly 9 years now, since April 2016, I've developed Soul's Remnant alone as my passion project. Over years of hosting public playtests, the game developed a community of dedicated players, and grew to be something larger.

Now, working towards bigger and better versions of the game, the team has expanded, with Rajah joining the team to help with future updates and development!

Developed with community in mind!

Community feedback has always been a crucial part of Soul's Remnant's development, so feel free to join our community and leave feedback for us, as we continuously work towards making the game even better!

---

"Now Hiring: Daytime Security Staff for Apartment Complex"

Working hours: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Trial period: 10 days

There are three essential rules for security staff:

1. Always greet the residents.

2. Always have guests write their real name in the visitor log.

3. Never speak to the woman in white.

---

Overview

Pomegranate Housing Complex is a first-person horror adventure game where you work as a daytime security guard at a cursed apartment for 10 days.

The story branches depending on your interactions with residents and visitors—and whether you obey the rules.

Ten days of time-limited patrols

In-game time advances one hour every 3 real-world minutes.

Time stops during major events.

You’ll move between the guard room and the apartment building, carrying out tasks such as:

Guard Room:

  • Monitoring surveillance camera footage

  • Checking the visitor log and resident list

  • Greeting residents

  • Handling phone calls

Apartment Building:

  • Patrolling each floor and the rooftop

  • Responding to unusual occurrences

Breaking the rules will corrupt the ordinary

Several rules govern your job.

Breaking them increases your "Haunting Level."

If it rises too high, you'll lose control and face consequences.

But some events... can only be witnessed if the haunting is strong enough.

Uncover the hidden pasts of residents and guests

Residents and visitors follow fixed routines—appearing only at specific times and days.

But your involvement may cause their behavior to change.

Whether to face their hidden pain and trauma is entirely up to you.

Multiple routes, multiple endings

Your choices, rule adherence, and how you connect with others will shape the outcome.

Some scenes and endings will only occur under specific conditions.

Several endings exist—ranging from calm resolution to eerie revelations.

Why are you in a place like this?

about_the_game:
Welcome to Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon

Step into the world of Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon, a mature, first-person perspective open-world RPG that immerses you in a dark fantasy realm inspired by Arthurian legends.

Uncover a complex and branching main storyline that lets you shape the legacy of King Arthur’s reign, 600 years after his fall amidst unending strife.

This game is a love letter to open-world FPP RPGs.

Key features

  • Massive gameplay experience: Dive into 50-70 hours of rich content spanning three expansive zones.

  • Branching narrative: Engage with a complex main story and hundreds of side quests featuring remarkable, voiced characters.

  • Limitless playstyles: Customize your gameplay with countless builds—mix attributes, skills, and gear to create your favorite setup.

Every corner of Avalon is packed with discoveries—hidden items, story secrets, unique enemies, dungeons, quests, and fascinating NPCs. Freely explore at your own pace and forge your path in a truly open world.

Switch seamlessly between melee weapons, shields, bows, magic, throwables, mixtures, and more. Dodge, parry, and block to protect yourself from danger. Experiment to develop your ultimate combat style against a wide variety of challenging enemies.

With all the stats, perks, equipment, and crafting, you can shape your playstyle exactly how you wish.

Want to be a crazy alchemist-berserker punching enemies to death? Sure.
A mystical blacksmith-mage summoning undead hordes? We’ve got you covered.
A stealthy archer lurking in the shadows? Say less—this is the game for stealth archer enthusiasts.

Experience three distinct zones, each packed with quests, NPCs, items, and more:

  • Misty Horns of the South

  • Sunlit Cuanacht Village

  • Frozen peaks of the Forlorn Swords

Avalon is alive with various supporting activities that enrich your journey. Participate in sketchbook journaling, fishing, farming, blacksmithing, alchemy, cooking, mining, managing your house, and more.

At night, the Wyrdness—a chaotic primordial force—descends upon the land, altering reality and introducing survival challenges. Your foes become even fiercer, leaving no place for mistakes or hesitation. Kill or be killed.

Confront morally ambiguous choices that will test your character and shape Avalon’s future. Follow the dark legacy of King Arthur Pendragon while engaging with over 250 NPCs and tackling 200+ side quests.
detailed_description:

about_the_game:
Fight Back Against the Nightmare

Your quiet town has been overrun by horrifying creatures from another dimension. With nowhere else to turn, you'll need to use your wits and scavenged supplies to survive. Raid the local hardware store to build defenses and traps. Gear up at the gun shop to unleash firepower on the encroaching horde. Find notes left by residents to learn more about the invasion.

Six Nights of Terror

For six terrifying nights, you'll need to strategize, build, and fight your way through relentless waves of increasingly monstrous enemies. Each night brings a new challenge, pushing your ammo count and defenses to the limit. From Them also features an infinite mode, letting you test your mettle against a never-ending onslaught of creatures. Can you survive the endless horde?

Learn by Doing (and Seeing!)

From Them comes with the full Unreal Engine 5 project files, giving you a unique opportunity to see exactly how it was built. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone who likes to poke around, From Them provides valuable insights into the Unreal Engine development process.

Are you ready to defend your town... From Them?

Bot Chop - Chop up or shoot deactivated drones that are hurled towards you while avoiding friendly drones.
Guardian - Defend a portal from waves of drones, keep in mind it hurts when a drone flies into your face.

Other Features:
Compete with friends and other players on leaderboards set for each mode.

Time slows down when laser beams get too close but this has a cooldown so dodge wisely.

about_the_game:
HEARTSHOT is a high-octane VR espionage thriller where chaotic gunplay meets retro-inspired cinematic environments. Deploy into the Siberian tundra and infiltrate a covert facility, delving into the heart of a shadowy operation to uncover its sinister agenda. Armed with high-tech magnet gloves, seize weapons from fallen enemies and manipulate your environment as you make your way through a sprawling, subterranean complex.

Gameplay


Your ultimate multi-tool in HEARTSHOT: the Magnet Gloves. Use them to retreive weapons and ammunition, manipulate machinery, and perform explosive entrances.



HEARTSHOT features a wide variety of weapons and attachments, with an intuitive interaction system to let you customize your loadout on the fly.



There isn't always time to reload— sometimes throwing any available object is your best bet to stagger the enemy and regain footing. You have better aim than you think, especially with the help of HEARTSHOT's throwing auto-aim system.

Story


Fill the role of a seasoned agent on a mission to dismantle a global criminal empire. A whistleblower's urgent call brings you to a remote Siberian base, once a Soviet-era criminal hub, now under the ruthless control of Marko Sokovic. Your mission: infiltrate, hack, and uncover Sokovic's sinister plot. Success demands resourcefulness under rising stakes.

about_the_game:
Cyberpulse is an arcade twin-stick thrower that combines the best of retro shooters and arena battlers with innovative game physics. Experience an electrifying campaign that will challenge arcade veterans and a multiplayer battle mode anyone can enjoy.

UNLEASH SHOCKWAVES OF DATA


Master novel mechanics that offer a new take to a classic genre: Instead of shooting bullets, you control cyberkinetic forces to fling, yank, and blast your foes directly into molten firewalls. Use your cybership to hurl an adversary or discharge devastating power-ups and send everything flying!

CHALLENGE CYBERSPACE


Fight your way through over fifty unique levels filled with a diverse cast of enemies looking to take you down. Outmaneuver waves of viruses, conquer new game modes, and battle mighty bosses as you unlock the secrets of this digital dimension.

THINK YOU GOT A HIGH SCORE IN YOU?


Handcrafted levels, with just enough randomness to stay fresh, mean endless replayability while you try to beat your high score. Every level has a global leaderboard: Can you climb to the top?

TEST YOUR SYNERGY


Bring a friend and test the limits of your teamwork. Try not to toss your teammate into a firewall — or hey, go ahead — it’ll hurt your score, but it’s hilarious.

DUNK YOUR FRIENDS


Gather up to four players and duke it out guilt-free on over one hundred Versus arenas that will hook your party for hours. Tweak dozens of settings to customize your multiplayer experience into anything from a crazy party game to a competitive arena brawler.

AN IMMERSIVE ADVENTURE


Stunning visuals bring a modern take to the nostalgia of vector graphics, and the exhilarating synthwave score keeps you locked in on the action.

ARE YOU READY TO MASTER CYBERPULSE?

about_the_game:
The Fairy Queen needs your help!




Become her Guardian Spirit and raise a little hero from an egg to battle the Dark Lord and bring peace back to the land.

This is an Elf Egg...

You are a guardian spirit created by the Fairy Queen to look after the heroes of this realm. You are to guide them. Raise them. Help them face the dark terrors of the world.



Part digital pet game, part RPG adventure, and part casual Idle game, Yolk Heroes is a charming blend of many different elements. Quest and grind to protect the citizens of the realm, or simply enjoy your digital friend!

Raise your hero!

From egg to adventure take your elf and help them become the greatest hero they can be. Clean, train, educate, and equip your little elf. Taking them through several phases of development.



  • Egg - Protect your Elf Egg from the dangers of the world! Keep it at the perfect temperature to help the strongest possible hero hatch.
  • Infant - The helpless hero is young and cute, but can't do much! Learn the basics while getting to know your drooling elf.
  • Do errands, practice skills, play games, and develop your elf into the hero they're destined to be!
  • Hero - Once your elf reaches maturity, take them out on quests and adventures for treasure and glory!

Save this realm...

The Dark Lord has been spreading evil across the land. The Fairy Queen has tasked you with stopping his reign of terror!



  • Challenging quests await around every bend, and a myriad of unique enemies seek to assault your hero from all sides.
  • Use skills, items, training, and a little bit of luck to keep your hero safe!
  • Your hero will give you regular updates during their quests, so you can get on with your life without worrying about your Elf getting into (too much) trouble without you.
  • Equip your hero with various weapons and armor to even the odds and ensure they have the best chances possible against the forces of darkness.
  • Actions take energy! Be sure to balance work with rest, otherwise your Elf will find themselves worn out.

A companion for you...

Your little hero doesn't require constant attention. The opposite really!



Raising, feeding, cleaning and even questing with your little elf is all done at a fairly leisurely real-time pace. Yolk Heroes is a cozy experience, one which you only need to check in on a few times a day to keep your hero healthy and happy.

Don't be fooled into thinking that means there's no danger, though! Even the mightiest heroes are sometimes defeated, but if this fate befalls your Elf, worry not. Your little hero should always be able to be nursed back to health!

A virtual pet adventure...

Yolk Heroes is the virtual pet game you've always wanted! RPG Mechanics, minigames, quests...who doesn't love quests? Your elf will explore, grow stronger, and embark on an adventure to deliver the world from evil! OR! You can just relax and enjoy your little friend.

We've have been working tirelessly on this (ostensibly) adorable hero raising game. Through Yolk Heroes, we want you to take your Elf on the adventure of their lives...and perhaps make some fond memories for yourself along the way.



Happy questing!

about_the_game:
The adventure takes place in a steampunk universe, within a Great Clock (thought as Big Ben), an unpretentious building where scientific activity takes place, as part of research into new energy sources... or so the story goes.
You take on the role of an automaton, limited to moving, running and interacting, accompanied by a calculator-being that will stick with you until the end of the adventure.
The building is labyrinthine, forcing you to make numerous trips back and forth in order to progress through the story, a classic piece of architecture.
The puzzles are simple, all you have to do is find notes containing activation codes for generators.
The adventure is meant to be short, but it will take longer to uncover all that Clocked hides.


The game is simple on the surface, but will be more difficult in this other dimension.
You'll have to use your dexterity to avoid the symbiotic clusters that will surprise you during your health walk.
This is an important dimension, as it will give you access to areas that are normally inaccessible...think about it!
You'll be juggling between the "default" world and this one to navigate the Great Clock.


A classic adventure, but a story full of mystery, unclear on the surface.
There's a lot to discover in Clocked, and the adventure revolves more around exploration than escape from the Great Clock.
There are several endings, each offering a unique experience, packed with information about the history surrounding the Great Clock.
Don't forget to chat with your calculator friend, he's very chatty.
detailed_description:
The adventure takes place in a steampunk universe, within a Great Clock (thought as Big Ben), an unpretentious building where scientific activity takes place, as part of research into new energy sources... or so the story goes.
You take on the role of an automaton, limited to moving, running and interacting, accompanied by a calculator-being that will stick with you until the end of the adventure.
The building is labyrinthine, forcing you to make numerous trips back and forth in order to progress through the story, a classic piece of architecture.
The puzzles are simple, all you have to do is find notes containing activation codes for generators.
The adventure is meant to be short, but it will take longer to uncover all that Clocked hides.


The game is simple on the surface, but will be more difficult in this other dimension.
You'll have to use your dexterity to avoid the symbiotic clusters that will surprise you during your health walk.
This is an important dimension, as it will give you access to areas that are normally inaccessible...think about it!
You'll be juggling between the "default" world and this one to navigate the Great Clock.


A classic adventure, but a story full of mystery, unclear on the surface.
There's a lot to discover in Clocked, and the adventure revolves more around exploration than escape from the Great Clock.
There are several endings, each offering a unique experience, packed with information about the history surrounding the Great Clock.
Don't forget to chat with your calculator friend, he's very chatty.

about_the_game:
Welcome to the Hermes Library. It is the main library of the Hephaestus University, the most famous university in the United Nation of Europa. As a junior named Rainn Echo, you will become the new librarian working at the front desk. While performing your daily duties, you will also witness several mysterious incidents there.

【How to Become a Capable Librarian】

You will help students, faculty members, and alumni to check out and return books. Using the workbook provided, you will check if every reader has complied with the library's rule: if they have checked out more than they should, if they have returned everything on time, if they have used their own ID card... Pay attention to details, and you will become an outstanding librarian!

Work time is divided into two parts: the morning and the afternoon. You will need to help about 12 readers every day with their return and check-out. During their conversations, you will get a glimpse into the lives of these students, professors, and alumni and piece together a rich campus environment.

Check-out: the reader needs to provide their ID and the book they want to borrow. If they have a reservation, they will tell you the title of the book so that you can take it out of the reservation area on the left. The first step of check-out is to use the scanner on the ID card. The information of the reader will appear on the screen on the right. You need to check the information and make sure that they are using their own ID and they have the authorization to borrow. Then you can press the "receipt" button on the bottom of the screen, type in the title of the checked-out book and the return date, and press "print." Then you can give the printed receipt along with the ID card and the now-checked-out book to the reader.

【Hidden Messages in Books】

As you handle many books at the front desk, you will find hidden information in them. By collecting and utilizing what you may find in the books, you will uncover the truth behind the incidents happening at the university. Maybe you will get to know some special people as well.

The Hephaestus University experienced several abnormal incidents since the beginning of the term: a certain award-winning professor is rumored to act inappropriately towards students? A philosophy PhD student died under suspicious circumstances? Furthermore, body parts preserved by the medicine department was stolen by an unknown person? Is there any truth in the rumor? Did the PhD student commit suicide or was there a killer on campus? What is the goal of the culprit who stole dead bodies? Different arguments and theories are passed around in the Hermes Library in silence, but they also fuel passionate debates. Collect pieces of information from these notes and help the detective and the reporter find the truth behind these incidents.

【Enter a World of Steam Punk】

During every lunch break, you can take a break with your best friend Lilith Puck at the Cafe in the Hermes Library and talk about the news of the day. Every weekend, as the librarian on break, you can go and experience different activities with your friend: parade, club fair, exhibition...... All novelties and innovations from the steam punk world.

【Daily-Updated News Bulletin Board】

The news bulletin board is updated daily to bring you the latest information about the incidents. It also advertises for interesting activities on and off campus. A variety of clubs and student organizations also put their description and recruitment information here. Notes from certain special people resonate with you. Keep communicate with them, and you may develop something deeper with them. When you return to your dorm after work, you can check all the notes you have collected. The salary paid by the library can also be used to purchase different kinds of decorations and blank notes.

about_the_game:
You have been given the tools. You have been given the capital. Now, it is time for you to use your imagination and design a top-secret facility to the best of your ability to house anomalous entities based off the SCP Foundation.

Immerse yourself in a world where strange creatures exist, and your job is to contain them.


D-Class personnel – short for "Disposable personnel" – are sourced from the world's most dangerous prisons and affiliated with the most dangerous gangs. Keep them happy, lest they sabotage your operations.

At the end of their contract, you may choose to administer amnestics to clear their memory and let them free, or terminate them. Nobody needs to know.


Managing such an important facility comes at a cost. There will be many unique challenges thrown your way. Not only do you need to know how to handle them, but you should be constructing your facility to prepare for these in advance.

  • Groups such as the Chaos Insurgency – consisting of ex-Foundation personnel – will attempt to sabotage your operations and take any opportunity they can to raid your facility.
  • Having your facility located at such a secluded place comes at the cost of severe weather. Make sure to prepare for extreme temperatures, or for your power grid to go offline as sandstorms/snowstorms seap through the lands.
  • SCPs are purportedly sentient beings, and they do not necessarily enjoy being captured. One or more of them may break loose in a containment breach.

What is the SCP Foundation?

The SCP Foundation is a secretive organization that contains anomalous or supernatural items and entities away from the eyes of the public. SCP stands for Secure, Contain, Protect.

Your role in this game is to handle all the operations of a facility managed by the SCP Foundation, including construction, management, containing SCPs, handling situations and more.

about_the_game:
Savage is a single-player action game that allows players to experience MMORPG-style boss battles. Two characters, the Paladin and the Archer, each fulfill their roles and take on formidable enemies in battle.
This game, which focuses on boss battles, requires no tedious pre-battle preparations or boring wait times for matchmaking. Dive into ultimate boss fights immediately after starting the game!

No tedious preparations! Dive straight into boss battles

  • In MMORPGs, leveling up and gathering equipment are usually necessary preparations. However, in this game, which focuses on boss battles, players can challenge a boss immediately after starting the game.
  • There are about 30 types of boss battles available, including high-difficulty battles that could be considered endgame content, all of which can be played solo.
  • There's no need to wait for team members to assemble. You won't be bothered by the need to communicate with other players. Enjoy battling formidable foes on your own to your heart's content.

A unique gaming experience controlling two characters simultaneously

  • The battle progresses in real time, with two characters each fulfilling their roles to defeat the boss. Typically, the character not controlled by the player is either managed by the CPU or another player, but this game is different. You will control both characters simultaneously in real time.
  • For example, in terms of movement controls, the left stick on the gamepad controls the Paladin, while the right stick controls the Archer, allowing intuitive operation of each character with your left and right hands respectively. (Keyboard and mouse controls are also available.)
  • This control scheme enables a game experience similar to MMORPGs, where the battle progresses from multiple character perspectives simultaneously, even though it's a single-player game.
