about_the_game:
Castles & Crusades Ruleset 5th Edition (4th Printing)

Troll Lord Games

Now with the updated 4th printing of the 5th Edition of the player's handbook (in module form.)

With the Castles & Crusades roleplaying game, these imaginings come to life as you play the role of a hero seeking adventure in a fantastic world populated by mythic creatures and legendary beasts. Or, as the Castle Keeper, you can design the worlds and stories that make up the game, guiding friends and fellow gamers through epic adventures in wondrous settings of your own making. Now everything thing you need to play Castles & Crusades with your others across the globe is now possible with this Fantasy Grounds II ruleset.

Castles & Crusades is an easy to learn, fast paced fantasy role playing game suitable for novice and veteran gamers of all ages. The Castles & Crusades Players Handbook and Monsters & Treasure manual provide all the essential information needed to play a game of Castles & Crusades. Players can choose among 13 archtypal character classes and 7 races to create their characters. Spells, equipment, fast-paced combat rules, monsters, treasures, examples of play and endless hours of fun and enjoyment can be found in these two books. All of this C&C information is included in this Fantasy Grounds conversion.

"The developers have done an amazing job with this online version of Castles & Crusades," says Stephen Chenault, CEO of Troll Lord Games, "The conversion of our game to Fantasy Grounds II is truly amazing, with a flawless interface that is every bit as easy to use as the print version. This is a very welcome induction for C&C into the digital age!"

What's included with the Castles & Crusades Ruleset for Fantasy Grounds II:

  • Stunning graphical interface based on the artistic genius of Peter Bradley, complete with a fully functional Castles & Crusades character sheet.
  • The complete Player's Handbook for Castles & Crusades converted to a library module, including all 13 archetypal character classes and seven races from which to create your characters. Also includes all spells, equipment, combat rules -- all essential information needed to play Castles & Crusades online!
  • Everything from Monsters & Treasures for Castle & Crusades is also included as a library module, from dragons and giants to gargoyles and satyrs, over 200 monsters that is enough to challenge and entertain novice and experienced players alike. Troll Lord Games

With the Castles & Crusades roleplaying game, these imaginings come to life as you play the role of a hero seeking adventure in a fantastic world populated by mythic creatures and legendary beasts. about_the_game:
Men of War: Red Tide is a sequel to the critically acclaimed RTS Men of War. Red Tide introduces a new story driven campaign based on the writings of Soviet scribe Alexander Zorich, it also includes dozens of new or upgraded units and weapons.
Men of War: Red Tide is a stunning mixture of RTS and a third-person action that introduces a new fighting force known for its brutal efficiency during the height of World War II. Played out across more than 20 missions, Men of War: Red Tide allows to take command of the feared "Black Coats," the nickname given to Soviet Marines, an elite combat group specializing in engagements near the shoreline.
The player has direct control of new game units including the Black Coats, tanks, self-propelled guns, armored trains, landing craft, artillery and new enemy emplaced weapons to capture and use. New air support options include fighters, bombers, hydroplanes; cruisers, destroyers and gun boats which provide naval fire support.
Fighting during the Black Sea Campaigns of WWII, history buffs and WWII aficionados will recognize theaters of battle such as Odessa, Sevastopol, Theodosia, Eltingen, Nikolaev and Constanta.

  • 23 missions - Soviet, German, Romanian and Italian forces
  • Six intense historical battles and landing operations during 1941-1945
  • Over 100 different military units: tanks, artillery, armored cars, planes (fighters, bombers, transporters), war ships and boats (cruisers, torpedo boats, gunboats)

about_the_game:
Game Description

This is the story of a man who receives a divine calling. You play as a humble yoga instructor at rock bottom, now set on a path toward glory, fortune, and irresistible temptation.

Along the way, you’ll meet all kinds of alluring women who become your students... “Ambitious Career Woman”, “Lonely MILF”, “Feisty Rebel”... Or maybe even the Goddess of Yoga herself?

As your studio grows, you’ll uncover the town’s secrets, face off against rival instructors, and choose whether to win them over… or utterly defeat them. The choice is yours.

Use your hands, your guidance, and your passion to reveal the true beauty of yoga. Lead your students into the perfect union of body and soul — through touch, breath… and something far more intimate. Feel the divine sexual energy that bridges earth and the heavens.

Abhyasa and Vairagya!

Gameplay

You have 60 in-game days to grow your yoga business, train your students, and… get to know them on a deeper level. During your passionate teaching sessions, it's perfectly natural for a few sparks to fly, right?

Guide your students through proper poses, earn class fees, and deepen your connection with them. Step by step, create your own yoga empire in this cheerful little town!

Game Features

  • Developed with Unreal Engine, the game features richly detailed characters and lifelike, expressive animations.

  • This isn’t just a “clicker with a story.” During each session, you’ll interact with your students in real time: drag, tap, guide. Sometimes, things might get a little out of control… But even then, remember the harmony of body and spirit.

  • Plan how to allocate your resources, upgrade your studio, acquire interactive tools, and unlock hidden scenes. Every student has her own story, and it’s up to you to uncover the desires hidden deep inside.

  • Story, gameplay, erotic scenes, and visual style come together in a single, thrilling, and sensual adventure.

about_the_game:
On the world of Barran Kollil, a world of magic, monsters and fantasy, trouble is brewing. The planet's most mysterious nation, the isolationist Sel Tor is building a grand navy, with the seeming purpose of launching an invasion of the entire world! However, the king of the nation of Sel-Quinta has sent his herald to rally support to defeat the invasion before it starts!

This is where you come in! Taking command of a freshly formed group of six adventurers, it's up to you to travel across Sel-Quinta to rally the support of it's six major cities and halt the invasion! But Sel-Quinta's king is not the only one getting involved in this quest, and there's more going on than any of them realise...

COMBAT: The foe isn't going down without a fight! Experience tough turn based combat featuring a large six member party and a variety of foes, from the familiar to the less familiar! There's also a range of tough optional bosses - Ever fought a cursed excavator before? How about a pair of high speed mushrooms?

STORY: Experience the story of the game's six party members-the out of luck All Rounder Samson, the soft hearted Thief Katalyn, the strong but silent Lysandroth, the powerful if ill tempered caster Vegal, the demonic healer Reilia and the stoic leader Hetty. And of course, the many unusual friends and foes they meet on their journey! And the choices you make along the way will change things too-perhaps one party member will teach another some of their own moves, or maybe you'll find some new items because of it!

ADVENTURE: Journey across the multi biome island of Sel-Quinta, traveling the reaches from it's burning deserts, to it's flooded deltas and the frozen north! And perhaps, somewhere not even in the party's dimension itself!

BUILDS: There's a lot of foes out there, but you've got the ability to respond with a variety of character setups! With over 180 skills, 150 weapons and almost 200 pieces of armour/equipment, there's a huge range of possibility! Those mushrooms out in the delta got you down with status effects? Equip familiars to protect you! Got a foe that just won't die? Equip broaches that change the elements of your attacks or powerful elemental weapons! And for your own damage-well, how about an axe that petrifies the foe on the first swing, then smashes them for three times the damage on the second? A Scythe that outright kills non boss foes 50% of the time? How about a set of claws that strike eight times and always land a critical hit? They're all in there and more!

CONVENIENCE: We all know RPG's sometimes have some awkward features. Having to backtrack all the way across the world to reach a certain town, or to go shopping. Not here! Once you've been somewhere, you'll unlock the ability to remotely order in items from previously visited shops, or to travel back to places you've been before through the simple use of an item!

about_the_game:
Become a café owner in a foreign country and learn a new language as you grow your business! Open shop in 1 of the 7 cities: Mexico City, Paris, Milan, Berlin, Los Angeles, Shanghai, Seoul, and Kyoto to learn Spanish, French, Italian, German, English, Chinese (Mandarin), Korean, and Japanese!



As you greet customers and serve them the drinks and food items they desire, you pick up authentic language in the most genuine in immersive context. Click on any word to display its meaning and you can toggle the sound and words of the customers’ orders to customize the learning experience to fit your needs. No more boring phrases that you will never use! With Lost Abroad Café, you will be able to order in a coffee shop on your travel in a foreign language in no time, all while having great fun!




Learning a language in the country it’s spoken is the best, because you get instant feedback whenever you use the language. But not everyone can do that. But now, with Lost Abroad Café, you can get instant feedback right in your living room and experience the fun and joy of experimenting to figure out the meaning of sentences and phrase via the response from your customers.



As you perfect your language skills, you can grow your coffee shop by upgrading the equipment and the menu using the hard-earned coins! New equipment opens the options of more advanced ingredients, which in turn unlock new items customers can order that makes you more money! Each country also has its unique items so you will feel that you are working in a real coffee shop there with the added cultural authenticity.



What’s the fun in playing a game and learning a language without being able to compete against your friends and the community? The leaderboard function lets you see the top Café owners in each language at any given time. Top the chart and brag to your friends in the language you just learned!



As Lost Abroad Café is currently in active development, you can influence what we build next by joining our Discord! Interact with other language learners and give us direct feedback on how the game plays and what you want to see built next.

Join our growing community of language learners today and get Lost Abroad Café now on Steam Early Access. The world of endless possibilities awaits!

To celebrate the 25th anniversary of Twinsen’s Little Big Adventure 2 Classic we’ve made some welcome updates to the first game as well!

  • Steam Cloud Saving
  • Language selection
  • Windowed Support

A Little Big Adventure


Originally released in 1994 as Little Big Adventure or Relentless: Twinsen’s Adventure, Twinsen’s Little Big Adventure Classic is an action-adventure game that became an instant classic on PC and PlayStation.

You play as Twinsen, a young Quetch living on Citadel Island on a planet that orbits between two suns: Twinsun. The dictator Dr. FunFrock uses cloning technology and teleportation to control the planet and its population. Twinsen is been having strange dreams in which the planet is about to be destroyed! The Legend says that only the Heir of Sendell, Twinsun’s beloved Goddess, can prevent this from happening.

Dr. FunFrock forbids everyone to even talk about Sendell’s Legend, so he locks Twinsen up in an asylum. Twinsen needs to escape to stop FunFrock, uncover his magical ancestry, protect the planet's secrets and meet his destiny.

An epic adventure
  • Join the Rebellion against the evil dictator FunFrock and his Clone army
  • Learn about your ancestors and gain magical powers
  • Solve mysteries and puzzles to uncover FunFrock’s wicked plans
  • Travel from island to island to discover new places and meet strange characters
  • Sneak, run, jump and fight your way through danger
  • Use a variety of unique items and weapons like the Magic Ball, Protopack and Meca Penguin
  • Enjoy the memorable sound track

(Disclaimer: this game contains cartoon violence)

about_the_game:
A thousand years ago it stopped raining, and all Earth's water evaporated into the clouds.

For over a hundred years people have been building towers to attempt to reach the clouds, so they can get the water they need to survive. And for over a hundred years they've failed. It's been a long time, but you're not done building yet.

Cloud Climber is a short narrative adventure game, that can be completed in 10-15 minutes. You must explore each tower, to uncover the full story of what happened, and find a way to the last tower to continue builder higher. The game is a casual thought provoking experience, that tells a unique and compelling story.

Features:
-Fully hand-drawn graphics
-Casual exploration based gameplay
-Fully voiced narration
-A short, yet satisfying experience

Explore the last monuments of humanity, as one of the only people alive, while coming to terms with the bleak reality that lies ahead.

about_the_game:
Hi, I'm Joshicus and I spent about a month creating this
game in Aseprite and GameMaker2 before handing it over to
my friend KanjiCoder to put up here on Steam. Know that
any money you decide to give us will go toward our future
game endeavors. I hope you enjoy my simple game. Make sure
to check out the demo before you buy!

When played perfectly, this game can be completed in just
under 6 minutes. However, that feat is very very difficult.

Basically you will fail a lot.

There's no health; no lives, no saves, no continues.
There isn't even a pause button.
There are 6 levels which you will generally have to
traverse both forward and backward within the course
of a single run. Each level takes about 30 seconds to
travel across. And in-between each level there is an
automatic pause screen where you do have a chance to
collect yourself and take a break if you need.

So yeah. Check it out. The demo is just the first level
with the room transitions turned off. To unlock the whole
game throw us a few bucks and remember to take lots of deep
breaths as you fail over and over and over again.

Also!

Credit to Hewett Tsoi for their 'Alagard' font !

about_the_game:
Experience modern passenger traction in the form of DB’s stylish “IC2”, which is ready for service in Train Simulator!

The Intercity 2 is the name of Deutsche Bahn’s long-distance passenger traffic formed with spacious “Twindexx” double-deck coaches and control car, an evolution of DE Regio’s doppelstock. Twinned with state-of-the-art traction such as the DB BR 146.5, and sporting DB’s striking intercity livery, the IC2 has been offering a comfortable mix of high speed and high capacity, taking passengers on inter-city services at speeds up to 160 km/h since its introduction in 2015.

In Train Simulator, you can climb aboard the iconic IC2 and take it for a drive yourself, from either the cab of the capable DB BR 146.5, or the DBpbzfa 668.2 control car, and race along the busy West Rhine route in bold white and red style!

Included Scenarios


A trio of engaging Career scenarios are included for the West Rhine: Köln – Koblenz route:

  • [IC2] 1. Twin Decks
  • [IC2] 2. Icy IC2
  • [IC2] 3, Delays and Cancellations

More scenarios are available on the Steam Workshop online and in-game. Train Simulator’s Steam Workshop scenarios are free and easy to download, adding many more hours of exciting gameplay. With scenarios being added daily, why don’t you check it out now!

Key Features


  • DB BR 146.5 Electric Locomotive in DB Intercity livery
  • BR 668.2 ‘Intercity 2’ Twindexx Control Car in DB Intercity livery
  • ‘Intercity 2’ Twindexx Passenger Coaches in DB Intercity livery
  • 3 Career scenarios for West Rhine: Köln – Koblenz route
  • Quick Drive Compatible
  • Download size: 138.9mb

about_the_game:
The life of a Cat Cafe Manager awaits! Your grandmother left you a small cafe in the sleepy village of Caterwaul Way, and it's up to you to fix the place up, impress the locals, and befriend the local cat population. Time to roll up your sleeves, break out the tools, and start hammering away. Your cat cafe can be the talk of the town with the right attitude, menu, and of course, the right cats.

That's right, Caterwaul Way is home to a plethora of extraordinary felines. The cafe can become their home, to the delight and relief of the villagers. Who knows, maybe their presence will loosen tongues and help you discover the secrets of Caterwaul Way... cats and take them off the streets, giving them a home.

The cafe is run-down and abandoned by the time you arrive, but it's nothing that a little bit of elbow grease (and money) can't fix.

  • Renovate the cafe, then decorate and expand it as you see fit and create a welcoming place for cats - and people - to relax in!

  • Build up a capable staff by hiring the right people, managing their workload, and helping them refine their skills.

  • Refine your cafe experience further with custom dishes and other menu items, catering to your customer's needs.

A good cafe is more than just a restaurant with good food and drinks. The difference lies in relationships. At Caterwaul Way, that means befriending cats and townsfolk alike.

  • Befriend and build relationships with a diverse cast of local villagers, such as Finley, a young musician trying to make it big, or Bonner, the local ferryman who's got some very tall stories to tell.

  • Look after the local cats, befriend, and, eventually, adopt them. Each stray cat is unique and will make your cafe a little different.

  • Keep your human and feline friends happy to unlock clues and eventually learn the secrets of Caterwaul Way.

Caterwaul Way has a long and mysterious history - and many festivals celebrating it. If you want your cat cafe to become a staple of the village, plan accordingly!

  • Travel the town, interact with the locals, and discover new recipes and opportunities for your cafe.

  • And, if all goes well, maybe you'll crack the mystery of the crumbling, ancient shrine to an old feline god in the forests near Caterwaul Way...

about_the_game:
Explore a world of pixel art fantasy, where every building holds a unique surprise. Help the locals, dance in a side quest, and finish the main quest. But don't forget, it's your birthday at the end of the day!
Have FUN!

Lore-heavy:
The game focuses on the lore of Cotton Kingdom and does not contain much intense battle mechanics.

Male-centric:
The game was originally developed to wish the developer's brother on his birthday, so it is male-centric and does not have a gender-change feature.

Short and sweet:
The game can be completed in 45-60 minutes and there is no post-game content.

Free to play:
The game does not require any permissions or in-app purchases. It is completely free to play for life.

Controls:
  • Click "Options" from the Title Screen to configure Keyboard mappings
  • Use mouse pointer as a secondary control

Made with RPG Maker MV:
The game was created using the RPG Maker MV game engine. All credits and references are published at the end of the game as rolling credits.

The Workers' and Peasants' Red Army (RKKA), was the army and the air force of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic, and, after 1922, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. The army was established immediately after the 1917 October Revolution (Red October or Bolshevik Revolution). The Bolsheviks raised an army to oppose the military confederations (especially the various groups collectively known as the White Army) of their adversaries during the Russian Civil War.

The Red Army is credited as being the decisive land force in the Allied victory in the European theatre of World War II. During operations on the Eastern Front, it fought 75%–80% of the German land forces (Wehrmacht Heer and Waffen-SS) deployed in the war, inflicting the vast majority of all German losses and ultimately capturing the German capital.

about_the_game:
"Pathfinder RPG - Pathfinder Companion: Orcs of Golarion


Feel the blood spray and bones crunch as the bestial children of the Darklands come roaring across the landscape, leaving only carnage and lamentation in their wake! Orcs are some of the oldest enemies of civilization, their howling hordes beaten back time and again by the forces of light. Yet in addition to being depraved raiders, orcs are also a civilization unto themselves, with a war-torn history stretching back before the Age of Darkness. In Orcs of Golarion, learn everything you need to know about playing (or vanquishing) one of these savage warriors, as well as the outcast half-orc spawn who straddle the line between the worlds of order and chaos.
This Pathfinder Player Companion includes:
  • Details on the orcs of Golarion--their brutish lifestyles, physical qualities, cultural norms and gender roles, governance of warbands, relationship with slavery, and more.
  • A history of the orc race, from their desperate flight during the dwarves' legendary Quest for Sky to their dominance during the Age of Darkness and subsequent fall from power.
  • An overview of major orc tribes and settlements, such as the Empty Hand tribe in the fallen dwarven stronghold of Urgir and the maddened oracles of the Brimstone Haruspex.
  • Orc tribal magic, including the shamanistic worship of the mysterious Blood God and the arcane witch doctors who rule through fear and firepower.
  • Information on half-orcs and their unique roles in human and orc society.
  • New traits to customize orc and half-orc characters.
  • Orc warbeasts, banners and symbols, ritual scarring and tattoos, and more!
This player-friendly Pathfinder Player Companion works best with the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game or the 3.5 version of the world's oldest fantasy roleplaying game. Although easily incorporated into any fantasy world, it is optimized for the Pathfinder campaign setting.
This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and Features the Following additions:
  • All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage
  • Individual area descriptions linked to maps, containing new encounters, treasure parcels and descriptions for just that area
  • Tokens for each encounter are pre-placed in starting locations on the map. You can edit these on the fly
  • Drag and drop treasure parcels and Encounter XP that is easily awarded to your players to keep the game moving ahead
  • All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them
"

about_the_game:
Chaotic Conundrum is a blazing-fast 2D retro platformer with smooth-as-silk controls, expressive movement options, and tight physics, adorned with a GBA-SNES flair that looks more like a drug trip than anything, and a rockin' dynamic soundtrack.

Giga-Boy has stolen every single cheeseburger on the planet in a fit of rage, as his pig intestine chowder business unsurprisingly bombed. A 12-year-old cheeseburger enthusiast, Fernan Ricemeat, grabs his reluctant younger sister Frieda and his closest friend FJ to set off on the adventure of a lifetime – only to accidentally destroy all of time and space in the process. Whoops!

Find all the Hyper Rock shards, beat Giga-Boy's ass, and save burgers before they're history!!

LIGHTS, CHAOS, ACTION!

Sprint, jump, and beat up any baddies you find across dozens of speedrun-oriented stages. Look out for 5 burgers hidden in each stage, and be sure to book it to the exit after grabbing that Hyper Rock shard. But as a twist to the tradition, at the end of each stage you'll FLIP OUT!! So carve an escape route and beat it before you're part of the history books!

Combos are a big part of gameplay. The higher combo you have, the higher your Star Multiplier will be, boosting your earnings. The more you wreck, the more you gain!

That's not all, though! There are myriads of marvelous mechanics to mess around with in each and every level! Turn into a bouncing music note, freeze into solid ice and break things recklessly, turn into a soda cup to destroy acid walls and much more! Every single stage has something new for you to enjoy.

FEATURING...

  • Blistering-fast, yet smooth-as-silk gameplay!

  • Wreak havoc in dozens of unique and expansive "episodes", each with hours of replay value!

  • 5 burgers to collect in each level!

  • 3 playable characters, each with their own abilities, whom you can swap between on the fly!

  • Fully voiced animated cutscenes, tying the story together!

  • Hundreds of achievements to keep you coming back for more!

  • Cosmetics aplenty! No microtransactions, all unlocked in gameplay!

  • Time trials - think you can beat the developers at their own game?

  • Spicy Mode - a race against Giga-Boy in each stage... for super players!

  • Obo

Please keep in mind that this game is still in active development. As such, all assets, level designs, and gameplay components are not final and subject to change.

about_the_game:
Wake up at midnight, tune the radio to your favourite station and drive. As a small time courier, you’ll meet an cast of unusual characters, carry their packages across the region and learn their stories. Deliver packages through the night until the long shadows of dawn calls you back to your bed.



Your goal is to pick up packages from locations and deliver them on time. It’s 1986, so there’s no satnav— you’ll rely on your map and street signs to learn the best routes. Late deliveries mean less money.



At the end of each night, you return to your garage. Completing deliveries and earning cash unlocks new garages and cars, allowing you to travel further, complete bigger deliveries and build a delivery empire.



  • Explore an open world of open highways and sparkling skylines
  • Deliver packages for a cast of characters in story missions, or in unlimited procedurally generated missions
  • Upgrade your car from fixer-upper to lean muscle machine
  • Unlock new garages to take longer jobs and explore more of the world
  • Hire and manage drivers to build a business empire
  • Stream radio, MP3s, and podcasts on your car stereo
  • Photograph your journey with a range of lenses, filters and effects
  • Turn off missions and time limits with Endless Night mode

about_the_game:
Not everything is fine in the sleepy mining town of Cinderbrook. The local distillery's whiskey has turned into a glowing poison, and the townspeople have caught glimpses of strange figures in the surroundings. Investigate the case and uncover the origin of these peculiar phenomena!

design and Features

The style and features resemble adventure games and role-playing games from late 1980s. The main focus of the game is solving a mystery, but players will also face enemies in turn-based battles. You control only one main character, but during the game, you will encounter helpful characters who can join in the investigations and aid in overcoming enemies. The game is quite short, but the player's playstyle and choices will affect how the story ends.

This game is intended to be played with a gamepad or keyboard. The mouse should be used for gameplay only if no other options are available.

about_the_game:
Reflection of Mine is a dark puzzle video game about the dissociative identity disorder. The entire game takes place in the broken mind of Lilly Witchgan and the goal is to discover who is real – Lilly herself or one of her many personalities. The plot will tell us about her many minds and how are they fighting each other.



During the game, the player controls two characters at the same time and one of them repeats the actions after another. If the player turns left – both of the girls will go left, if the player turns right – both of them go right, if one dies – the other is buried with her. The difficulty is in finding the exit of the map, which is separated into two different parts. Maybe one of the girls will see only flowers in front of her, but that doesn’t mean that there isn’t a trap before her second personality. You will find a variety of traps that bring diversity into the game mechanics.
Here, madness is represented as it really is – Lilly is a foreigner in her own body and her memory is broken into pieces by the other personalities. She can’t remember many hours of her life, even days, months and years. Her live is a broken puzzle and we are here to help this girl.



- More than 10 hours of gameplay.
- Story driven psychological game.
- 55 unique puzzles with big variety mechanics.
- 10 stages of arcade mode.
- Original soundtrack.
- More than 10 unique personalities.
- Perfect way to challenge your mind.
- Use gamepad, keyboard, mouse or touch to play.






The game was developed by one person – Slava Gris who combined his art skills with his knowledge of psychology and programming to bring to life Reflection of Mine. The soundtrack is provided by Expecte Amour whose music inspired Slava to create this dark world of madness.

about_the_game:
本作品以北宋仁宗嘉佑元年至神宗朝熙丰年间的历史为背景。
宋夏庆历和议后，大宋四海稍安，仁宗英宗奉行祖宗法度谨守河山。
浮华背后，天下财力日穷而风俗日衰，一切或许到了不得不变的时候......




本作品试图深度解读宋代历史，除部分美术素材外（后续希望有机会替换），正史剧情部分若有与历史记载出入较大之处，还望大家斧正。个人能力有限，希望有幸与大家一起学习、积累、成长。




目前版本只开放做官的从文线，涉及玩法多有考据，尽力贴合宋代历史。
科举玩法：
随机题目皆为宋代省试或殿试真题。
断案玩法：
涉及案件均为宋代真实案例，大多出自《名公书判清明集》。
榷货务：
入中贸易为宋代特色，是朝廷调节各地资源分配的重要手段。
著书玩法：
多数灵感来自《全宋文》，希望能捕获宋代士人精神世界的吉光片羽。
漕运玩法：
北宋定都开封，与当时开封水系网络发达密不可分，漕运实乃大宋命脉所在。
海运玩法：
宋元海运兴起，市舶司为国家创造了大量财富，同时民间海外贸易业十分发达。从宋人赵汝适的《诸蕃志》中可以看到当时人们对海外诸国的认识。




个人认为熙丰变法是中国古代历史的转折点，唐末至五代以来，租庸调制度崩溃。赵宋终结五代之乱象，立国而不抑兼并，世人开始注重物质享受和个人财富积累。宋人迫切需要全新的思想和法度来建立新的天下秩序。
神宗和王安石力图建立一个外向的刚健政府，最终功败垂成。宋学慢慢转向，进而朱子之学占据主导地位，后世文明走向内向。
如果熙丰变法能够重来，宋代学术可以被重新塑造，一切又会怎样？




游戏中收录了《夷坚志》中的近百个小故事。
个人很喜欢《夷坚志》这本书，此书为洪迈毕生心血，洪迈幼年时北宋灭亡，后在南宋为官五十余年，履历丰富。他每与朋友相会，便闲聊各地风物见闻，最终汇编为《夷坚志》。
书中虽多有鬼神记载，看似荒诞，各类细节却具有很强史料价值，也实实在在反映了一千年前各类人物的精神世界和生活状态。




根据玩家剧情中的选择以及最终国家属性，游戏会迎来多种不同结局。

about_the_game:
Hotel Tutwin is a visual novel designed for horror / romance lovers, but can also be quirky and cute. Each story line is quick and to-the-point, but there are many to discover. Prepare for inevitable deaths.

You play as Penni, who is compelled to enter a mysterious hotel with her childhood friend. From outside, Hotel Tutwin seems abandoned and empty, but wait... It's up and running? The characters you will meet are a strange bunch, but don't let them fool you. The world at Hotel Tutwin is a balanced ecosystem that has yet to be disrupted.

Penni can choose between three male love interests, all of which have stories hidden in branches other than their main one. This means you can’t learn everything about one character by only playing the path leading to their happy ending. And it’s not like the story is made of happy endings either. In fact, only about one third of the endings are good. So if you’re looking for an easy love story without death or hardship, don’t look here!

about_the_game:
Snake-A-Roid is an Arcade style game that's been lost down the back of the sofa.
Featuring a clean vector-like style, and crunchy chip tune sound track, it evokes an era where games taunted you to spend your money, as you climbed to the top of that high score table.

Featuring three modes of play:
  • Arcade - run through the 10 arenas, each with multiple waves of asteroids and aliens, with an arena guardian to defeat.
  • Survival - pick an arena and chase that score, before your snake runs out of segments.
  • Boss Run - go toe to toe with all the arena guardians, one after the other, before facing off against The Badger.

Multiple power-ups to feed your snake, including:
  • 3-way split shot
  • Faster bullets
  • Bigger bullets
  • Snake shield
  • Smart bombs
  • And the elusive extra life
All of which stack up to turn your garden snake into a death adder.

about_the_game:
A Labyrinth of Evil

Step into the shoes of a relentless warrior in this gripping action RPG. Your mission is to purge a dark, foreboding castle fortress of its evil inhabitants. Engage in intense, visceral sword battles and execute stealth kills as you navigate through shadowy corridors and towering battlements, each step bringing you closer to the heart of darkness.

Live By The Sword

As you progress, unlock powerful special abilities that enhance your combat prowess and strategic options. Whether it’s unleashing devastating attacks or summoning your inner strength, these abilities will be crucial in your quest to cleanse the fortress.

But that’s not all—hidden throughout the castle are legendary swords, each more powerful than the last. Discover these weapons to gain an edge over your enemies, making each encounter a test of skill and strategy.

Are You Ready?

With a variety of challenges to overcome and a level layout that changes with each playthrough, prepare for an immersive experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. But beware, those who live by the sword, die by the sword...

In the demo, make your way through the first level of the castle, the layout changing every time you start a new game. You will also only be able to acquire one legendary sword per playthrough, and your character level will be capped at 5. Experience a taste of what lies in store in the full game!

about_the_game:
Summer vacation is coming, and due to your mother's work, you and her come to a remote town together to establish a communication base station.

The name of the town is The Hot Spring Town, but due to its remote location and lack of internet access, there are not many people in the town anymore

In this simple town, you will meet all kinds of people and experience different stories.

Your goal is to obtain funds through activities such as insect catching, fishing, flower picking, bird watching, while enjoying rural life. Use the funds to purchase small town stalls, attract customers, rebuild convenience stores and other shops, and hire staff; After the establishment of the internet, using social media to take beautiful pictures to attract migrant workers; Maintain town roads, road management, etc Start the plan to revitalize the town.

Attention: Due to version changes, the image materials used in this instruction are not the latest version of the game. The game graphics are based on the screenshot assets! (The image assets described in this description will be updated synchronously in the near future)

Use WASD to move and space to jump

Regarding the camera: This game is essentially a 3D game, but playing from a horizontal perspective can provide the best experience* Some specific activities, such as cooking, will be conducted from a first person perspective.

Make good use of tools to fish, catch insects, and farm freely in the small town, and earn income to buy fun things.

The loot obtained is divided into white, green, blue, and gold levels, with higher value for rarer items!

Check your catalog, there are captured collectibles inside!（waiting for translation....）

Everyone loves fishing and farming.

You can entrust the mayor to take you on a car tour of the town (similar to a fast trip) and have the player control the car themselves!

if you have internet, you can upload a beauty map to social media, get a comment and attention to the good news, make more exotic population travel to the town, and it is likely to get more town income.

A sea view room of your own! Love comes from the residents of Hot Spring Town!

If you feel tired, you can also spend time at home and improve your character's attributes by resting and relaxing.

Enjoy a cup of green tea every day to enhance your character's insight points! Insight points can be used to observe potential development opportunities in small towns and establish new buildings!

You can donate your money to establish and develop the town, and the town's income will also be returned to you!

Managing your residence and placing treasures can enhance various outputs of the town, and even change some gameplay

In the game, need to pay attention to your physical strength and thirst level, which can be supplemented by consuming food and drinks. Otherwise, you can only go home early to rest!

Vending machine, waiting for translation....

Go meet new friends! Solve their problems, and become good friends!

Fishing with friends.

Helping at Tanaka's sushi restaurant *(this part is from a first person perspective)

Manage your small supermarket well...

Attend a grand gathering with friends！

The game is under continuous development....

about_the_game:
Dark Legends surround the old abandoned Blackwood house, secluded far away in the northern wastelands.
For writer Michael Arthate, this cold, solitary atmosphere is fodder for his restless imagination. But Michael soon becomes distracted by the mysteries offered up, as he follows a trail exploring and delving into the secrets of the past. As he is drawn deeper into the story, his sleep is shattered by mysterious noises, and he is plagued by nightmares that cross into reality.
Whose shadows lurk in the dark corners? Is that lonely house inhabited by restless spirits of the past or something more sinister? What is that sound that chills to the very bone...scratching?
Join Michael in a suspenseful adventure, as you explore beautiful and chilling environments. Prowl dark corners and solve puzzles leading to the solution of a tale begun with obsession, and ending with madness and murder.

Features

  • Eerie and immersive story
  • Haunting soundtrack
  • Full 360 degree panoramic viewing
  • Puzzles and challenges throughout
  • Numerous hours of gameplay
  • Explore a Victorian mansion, sinister chapel, forbidding crypt, musty rooms, greenhouse…

Director’s Cut includes:

  • An alternate ending that might be more shocking than the original
  • A new chapter: “The Last Visit” will have you back at the house 10 years after the events of the original game
  • Michael’s diary with more clues and thoughts from the main character
  • Upgraded graphics and an eerier soundtrack

This is the long-awaited conclusion of the 80's classic "Montezuma's Revenge!" by the original developer. It has been 40 years since the release of the original classic game.

Please note: This game will be included with Montezuma's Revenge - The 40th Anniversary Edition.

Avoid the spiders, skulls, snakes and bats as you guide our hero, Pedro, in exploration of Montezuma's Pyramid to claim its treasure! This is the classic 2D open-exploration platformer where you run, jump, climb and fight your way to the finish! There are 9 levels of pyramids to explore!

Every room has been renovated and updated with new treasures, new room elements like trampolines and exploding pots, and finally the confrontation with King Montezuma Himself! Explore the chambers of the mysterious Aztec pyramid! Climb the stairs and ropes, collect keys to open doors! Collect the jewels & swords, and the coveted torch! Beware of the snakes, skulls and spiders! And finally, find the treasure room at the end of the underground labyrinth!

It has all the original key features of the original Atari classic plus a number of interesting new improvements.

Featuring:

Totally new gameplay - It's the first all-new Montezuma game in decades!

New features like trampolines, elevators & exploding pots

6 Tutorials to quickly learn the gameplay

6 game save slots

CRT effects, Scanlines, Bulge and Blur

Fullscreen or Windowed mode

Wide/Narrow display options

User-configurable input

about_the_game:
■ Story

When Meina returns from a walk,
she finds the Slug Snail Village overrun by parasitic slimes!?

The village elder—the only one who wasn’t infected—tells her:

To bring everyone back to normal, you’ll need two things...
Fresh slimes and hydrangeas.

To gather the ingredients, Meina heads into the mysterious garden...

■ Game Overview

Watch those corners...
Dash through a maze-like garden as a slug snail,
evading enemies while collecting slimes in this gooey, dot-eating tag game!

The keys to victory are:

  • The Slime Dash, a high-speed move to zip around the map

  • The Slime Trail, which restores the moisture needed for dashing

Use the slime trails left behind by enemies and other slimes to move more efficiently—but be warned, doing so puts you at greater risk of an encounter!

Collect all the blue fresh slimes before time runs out to clear the stage.
Will you dash to attack or escape?
Master the timing and routes to aim for a high score!

One Perfect Day is an immersive first-person adventure game where you help Andy escape a mysterious time loop.

By solving engaging puzzles and exploring different time periods, you’ll uncover the secrets of Andy's past. Use unique tools and cherished mementos to piece together his story, discovering what really happened and what could have been.

Dive into a gripping narrative of self-discovery and healing, perfect for anyone who loves a good mystery and wants to experience a heartfelt journey. No gaming expertise required—just a curious mind and a love for a great story.

  • Talk to and listen in on conversations and gossip among your fellow classmates.
  • Solve non-linear chronological puzzles like a true time looper would.
  • Bask in calming visuals and ASMR ambiences of a dreamy school environment.

about_the_game:
Run and jump, collect coins, confront enemies and avoid traps, open gates and find secret stashes. It's a simple 2D platformer with a twist: You're not a hero from the castle about to slay an evil dragon, you're a goblin cook working for the dragon! It starts slowly but things get more and more complicated as you go.

Story

Your master has been robbed by a pesky rogue, and it's kind of your fault. Follow them through 5 different settings, from the dragon's lair in the Fiery temple of Doom, all the way to the Castle Keep, and return the stolen treasure! But beware, the closer you get to civilization, the more dangerous it becomes for a defenseless goblin.

Features

  • Over 35 levels filled with enemies, traps and secrets.
  • Unique game mechanics for every world.
  • Two difficulty settings (casual & old school).
  • Ability to save & continue later, for casual players.
  • Keyboard (You can rebind the keys) and gamepad support.
  • Cool music by Kevin MacLeod
  • Legend: Find out more about the world, unlock recipes, check achievements!

Using the keyboard to navigate and the mouse to aim and shoot, you'll explore a galaxy where our civilization has transcended the boundaries of its solar system. In this universe, central governments have given way to private space research agencies, and you, as a brave 'Sciense Soldier', will be hired to unravel the mysteries of unknown planets. With the keyboard, you will direct your character through challenging environments, while with the mouse, you will shoot at enemies and overcome obstacles that stand in your way to discovery.

The game features:

Top-Down Isometric Gameplay
Dual Control
Linear Narrative Scenarios
Varied Challenges
Space Science Fiction Environment

Prepare for an experience that combines action, skill, and an immersive narrative.

about_the_game:
Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt. In diesem umfangreichen mittelalterlichen Fantasy-Abenteuer bist du nicht nur ein einfacher Reisender, sondern ein Gestalter deines eigenen Schicksals.

Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist. Von den schneebedeckten Bergen, die die Heimat tapferer Zwergenklans sind, über die geheimnisvollen Wälder, in denen Elben ihre uralten Magien weben, bis hin zu den trostlosen Ödlanden, die von gefährlichen Kreaturen und Banditen heimgesucht werden – die Welt von Drachenquell ist reich an Vielfalt und Gefahren.

Stelle dich unzähligen Audgaben, die dich in die dunkelsten Ecken der Welt führen oder dich in die Intrigen der hohen Politik verstricken. Kämpfe gegen furchterregende Kreaturen, untersuche verborgene Dungeon oder enthülle die Geheimnisse längst vergessener Ruinen. In den tiefsten Dungeons warten Schätze auf jene, die mutig genug sind, sich den dort lauernden Schrecken zu stellen.


Jedes Biom in Drachenquell bietet ein einzigartiges Erlebnis und Herausforderungen. Ob du durch die kargen Aschewüsten wanderst, die von Sandstürmen heimgesucht werden, oder dich durch die dichten Dschungel kämpfst, in denen jede Pflanze und jedes Tier eine potenzielle Gefahr darstellt – die Welt ist voller Wunder und Schrecken.

Wähle, ob du als einsamer Wolf in einer selbstgebauten Festung lebst oder ob du dich in das pulsierende Leben einer der Großstädte stürzt. Handwerke, handle und interagiere mit einer Vielzahl von NPCs, die alle ihre eigenen Geschichten und Bedürfnisse haben.

Entscheide dich, für welche Seite du kämpfen willst. Als Verbündeter der Menschen, Elben und Zwerge verteidigst du das Licht und die Ordnung. Oder vielleicht lockt dich die dunkle Seite, und du schließt dich den Untoten, Orks und Dämonen an, um Chaos und Zerstörung über die Lande zu bringen. Jede Fraktion bietet ihre eigenen einzigartigen Fähigkeiten, Waffen und Kulturen.



Bist du bereit, in die Tiefen von Drachenquell einzutauchen und dein eigenes Epos zu schreiben? Das Abenteuer wartet auf dich!

Your job is simple: You must sort human body parts into bins for use in repairing zombies. Make sure you sort the parts into the correct bins! You don't want a zombie with a foot for a head, or a liver where the heart is supposed to go.

As you advance in level, the speed of the conveyor belt increases, and new parts are thrown into the mix. Good luck!

about_the_game:
About the Game


Gwiryungdan is a 3D action RPG set against the backdrop of Korea's prosperous Joseon Dynasty,
immersing players in a unique cultural and historical experience.

Embark on a journey as [Maru], a young man earning a living by impersonating a revered member of [Gwiryungdan],

about_the_game:
Choose your mech, customize your loadout, and build your perfect deck. Experiment with cards to find powerful combinations as you enjoy the tactical combat and deckbuilding in this roguelike adventure!

Customize your mech


Choose your Mech frame. Every pilot approaches combat differently, choosing from the melee-oriented assault frame, the stealth sniper frame, or just opt-in for raw laser firepower. Mech frames can be upgraded during the game: by installing new equipment and upgrading the frame to a newer variant.

Build your perfect deck

Collect weapons, shields, and equipment by destroying your opponents in battle. Victory serves you with new 'toys' for your mech, swapping out these ‘toys’ will adjust your combat deck.

Test your Mech on battlefield


There are countless weapons and items to discover and try out: lasers, machine guns, plasma rifles, sniper cannons, swords, hammers, drones, mines, force fields, jet engines, as well as more unique ones like: rocket fists, whips, scythes, cloaks, pile bunkers or mini-nukes!

Enjoy the tactical combat


Predict your opponent's actions and adjust your tactics to the situation on the battlefield. Flank, assault, ambush, hide behind cover, or precisely target most valuable components on enemies.

Find powerful card combinations

Discover unique card combinations that will give you an edge on the battlefield. Or try to find the one that will break the game: one-turn boss battle victory or no damage. Test your combos on the highest difficulty levels.

Protect your mech body parts from destruction


Each body part of the Mech has its own armor and health. Balance your equipment to keep your deck efficient and provide enough protection. When a body part is destroyed, you can’t play cards attached to it!

Choose your path

Choose your path on the campaign wisely, avoid fights not suitable for your current loadout. Take greater risks for better rewards, or just complete your objectives. Discover the origins of the alien AI that is corrupting the machines.

about_the_game:
"Buddy Bug" is a creative rogue-lite adventure game where players step into the shoes of tiny insects exploring a miniature world within a bustling city. Experience their struggles for survival and immerse yourself in a vibrant and refreshing journey.

Explore a Microscopic Insect World:

Embark on an extraordinary adventure as a humble little bug in a parallel world that exists alongside the human realm yet feels entirely unique. Face countless challenges and seize unexpected opportunities as you uncover the surprises hidden in every scene. Along the way, you'll meet diverse insect companions and experience a whimsical journey filled with wonder and imagination.

Local & Online Co-op Mode:

Buddy Bug introduces a special two-player co-op mode available both Local and Online, allowing you to team up with friends and face challenges together. Players can choose two distinct insect characters and combine their unique abilities through teamwork and synchronized strategies to tackle more complex missions. Each character has its own special skills, and how well you utilize these abilities to complement one another will determine whether you can successfully overcome the game's many obstacles.

Various Combat Gadgets:

The game is filled with ingenious, handcrafted tools. Whether it's turning thumbtacks into roadblocks or transforming a lighter into a weapon, you'll creatively utilize resources that insects can find to overcome challenges and complete your adventure.

Diverse Skills and Gadget Combinations:

As you progress through battles and exploration, you'll become familiar with a variety of skills and tools. Each skill branch has its own unique traits, offering distinct advantages. In two-player co-op mode, clever combinations of abilities can help you overcome even stronger enemies and conquer more complex environments.

The game is currently in its DEMO stage, and as development progresses, player feedback will play a vital role in shaping a series of major updates. These updates will introduce new features, characters, weapons, tools, regions, and much more. Welcome to Buddy Bug! Step into the insect world, team up with friends, and create your own heroic legend!

about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in ANGEL, a narrative driven racing adventure, where digital climate change threatens the eCho network with extinction. As eCho faces its extinction, the ANGEL protocol - EXPLORE, CREATE, REFLECT- persists. Embark on a journey that questions what it means to be connected.

In this Alpha-Demo players are granted access to the first two worlds of the opening story mode, averaging roughly 1-2 hours of gameplay. You will connect to the eCho network, develop your input capabilities with new combos and abilities, and learn how the game is structured. This Alpha-Demo is an opportunity to provide direct feedback to me (the developer) so that I can make the best possible full release. All reviews and feedback are encouraged!

ANGEL imbues the flow state of racing with the complexity of breakbeat music enhanced by a soundtrack from MyraTV, and many other breakbeat enthusiasts.
detailed_description:
Alpha Demo - Testing for feedback

Please note: - As a solo developer working on my first game - ANGEL - I'm using this demo as a way to directly interface with you the player. It should be (mostly) feature complete, and represent what you can expect from ANGEL BUT is very much subject to change depending on your player feedback. Please leave any feedback and all of this will be considered before the full release in late 2025. Thank you!

about_the_game:
Bloodletter is a strategic deck-builder where cunning and craft are needed to vanquish evil. A deck-builder most strategic, its roots lie entwined with the arcane art of tarot, remedies of the flesh, and the surrounding superstitions.

Evil entities have crept into the hearts of the common folk, who teeter upon the brink of madness and death. Only thy bathhouse stands as a bastion against the creeping corruption. 

Will thy dubious methods offer them salvation?

As moonlight falleth, malevolent spirits stir. Take up the mantle of a barber-surgeon and protect the villagers from their vile influence.

Use thy deck of cards to heal villagers' bodies and minds from the entities’ attacks and ready them for another cursed night.

In exchange for thy help, villagers offer strange new arts and powerful boons — but beware: trust, once broken, shall not be mended easily.

GAME FEATURES: 

  • Over 80 cards bearing unique incantations, illustrations and titles

  • 6 blessing and curse cards capable of turning fate itself upon its head

  • 10 villagers with their own talents, oddities, and eerie animations

  • 4 dreadful entities, each a foul spirit with its own wicked design

  • 1 fantastical realm, steeped in medieval myth, mystery, and dread

Take heed, barber-surgeon: the path of the bloodletter is not for the faint of heart — salvation or damnation await.

about_the_game:
A sequel to the legendary Japanese free game "Elona," which has inspired countless tales and adventurers who never returned. While retaining the traditional roguelike gameplay, Elin introduces crafting, survival elements, and base building/management, creating an even more open and chaotic experience.

Live freely as an adventurer with your companions and pets. The marks you leave and the scars you inflict upon this world are entirely up to you.

Key Features:


  • A sandbox, open-world RPG based on roguelike gameplay.
  • Live your life, survive, craft, build and manage bases and towns, enjoy housing, fishing, theft, music, farming, livestock breeding, childbirth, setting up shops, tourism, and much more.
  • A seamless blend of endless randomly generated content and carefully crafted fixed content faithful to the world setting.
  • A continuously expanding world and gameplay. Updates will continue even after the early access.
  • The prologue to an epic story revolving around humans and the Elea.

about_the_game:
The original bug-blasting arcade game is back! Centipede: Recharged has been reimagined for modern gameplay, with vibrant visuals designed for modern screens, a 16:9 field of play, and an original soundtrack from award-winning video game composer Megan McDuffee.

Aim for a high score in the old school arcade mode and earn bragging rights with your name at the top of the leaderboard. Or test your skills and rank on the boards in one of 30 intensely creative challenges, which twist the gameplay in new and exciting ways.

A dozen new power-ups can give you an edge by introducing abilities like screen-clearing explosions, rail guns, and even slowing down time. Every mode and level is playable in local co-op mode with a friend.

Key Features:



  • Old Meets New: Classic Centipede gameplay updated for smooth control, and visuals for modern PCs and consoles

  • Powered Up: A dozen power-ups are yours for the taking - scare enemies away, catch them off guard with a side-shot, drop a row of bombs, and more

  • Challenge: Compete in a series of 30 challenges designed to put even the most seasoned players to the test

  • Compete: Reach the top of country global leaderboards for arcade and individual challenge modes

  • Bring a Friend: Play local co-op with a friend in every mode .. blast bugs and chase scores together

  • Get in the Groove: Get into the rhythm of a good run to the original score by Megan McDuffee

about_the_game:
A Mobile-Enhanced Local Co-op RPG for 1-4 Players

Explore the lavish dungeons and tunnels that stretch below Tarnum Fortress and conquer dozens of unique quests and challenges. Prove your worth on a tactical battlefield, and overpower your foes with strategy, magic and martial prowess. The Eon Altar’s defenders are many and they are deadly.

Choose to cooperate with your allies or deceive them. Engage them in player to player dialogue to expose the truth in myths and legends, and guide your hero to their ultimate destiny or defeat.

Your smartphone is your character

  • Receive personalized secret thoughts from your character direct to your smartphone
  • Choose whether to share personal information with your friends or use it against them
  • Upgrade and manage your character without interrupting other players
  • Control the action from your smartphone with context sensitive information

Couch co-op role-playing game

  • Connect your mobile devices to a central platform to coordinate tactics and movement
  • Play together with up to three friends, or play by yourself in solo mode
  • Work with your friends, or betray them as you race to fulfill your destiny
  • Defeat legendary enemies in exciting tactical turn-based combat

An epic story of friendship and betrayal

  • Experience an epic quest in nine episodic installments filled with action and surprise
  • Explore a deep, compelling, and original sword-and-sorcery fantasy world
  • Interact with enemies, allies, and your friends by acting out your character's lines
  • Make impactful choices and forge your own destiny

Fully-realized, immersive gameplay experience

  • Gorgeous art and atmospheric environments
  • Intricate, ancient, and original fantasy setting
  • NPCs are fully voice acted, but you voice your own character
  • Epic soundtrack by composer Tom Salta, known for his work on the Halo series

An ancient, malevolent presence stirs within the depths of the Eon Altar, and only a small band of heroes can stop it from consuming the world. What mysterious force brought you here together? Are you strong enough to stand up to your gods?

about_the_game:
WRAIN is a single-player cosmic adventure where your end is just the beginning. Solve intricate puzzles to appease Death, learn from lost souls in the Spirit Realm, gain forbidden knowledge, and unravel the dark secrets of a mysterious island. Tread carefully—or else you may become another lost voice in the chorus of the damned.

Discovery through Death

Embark on an unconventional path to discovery, where each unique death is a stepping stone to unravelling the island's secrets and your place in it. Embrace your mortality to visit the Spirit Realm, solve puzzles, unveil new pathways, and manipulate the world around you in ever-more ingenious ways.

Forbidden Knowledge

about_the_game:
We set out to create the ultimate high seas action rogue-lite. Perma-death allows us to capture the intensity of smuggling a cargo hold full to the brim with valuables across the sea, knowing that if the wrong pirate ship crosses your path, you could lose everything.

If you can just make it to port, and smuggle your ill-gotten goods past customs, the windfall of coin could be just the thing you need to survive.

Key Features

  • Sail Seas Your Way: With three playable Captains, you can use whatever combination of play-styles you want to get to the end. Will you be a ruthless pirate? A dastardly smuggler? or a peaceful trader?
  • A Smuggler's Paradise: Risk your skin smuggling valuable goods across the sea for great rewards.
  • Light The Fuse, Blast The Hull: Our real-time naval cannon combat means you have to use timing and angles most of all to maximize your damage, and survive relentless cannon volleys yourself.
  • Powerful Sacraments To Obtain: Each Unholy Sacrament provides a great boon and a curse to match. You must adapt your ship to the ever-shifting challenges that different Sacraments will provide.

about_the_game:
Rokatusch is in development. It is an RTS-like game but from First-person point of view. You will be able to build buildings like e.g., walls and towers or houses. You will be able to create multiple forts on a huge map. After ordering buildings via pre-defined blue prints your workers or you build up the buildings.

Planned Key Features

  • First-person view
  • Collect materials (Wood, Food, Stone, Iron, Gold ...)
  • Build buildings, walls, ...
  • Hire people as workers or soldiers
  • Choose look/weapons of your people
  • Simple RTS elements like command people (Defend position e.g.)
  • Fight against AI and real players (Up to ~4-8)
  • Day / night cycle

Development Plan

There is no fix release date yet. I will post update news as often as possible.

about_the_game:
Play as a former captain (of a space ship) on the run in the frist part "painful days at home" when your ship crashed and you had to hide inside the home of some unknown guy. Enjoy a gameplay with no hassle, as time doesn't matter here, promise. Just combine items you find to make your way back into space.

This is a promotional shortgame where you can expect a playtime of around 25 mins. But it heavily depends on you. If you're a hardcore progamer, experienced in all historical p&c adventures, this is a simple walkthrough for you. If so, be our guest and consider yourself a patron of the next part, which shall have a playtime of 10-20 hours estimated. Your comments will greatly help us making a much more accurate guess about that as well.

For the not-so-hard coregamer, just enjoy clicking around and guess what to do next. There are some hints and some "hidden" items to combine. Have fun and post your thougts about it, as they will influence the next part quite a bit which is planned to come this year.

What's in the game:
*graphics
*animations
*sounds
*music
*story

What's not:
*lootboxes

Medium important note: Be sure to check the "manual" included, especially about using the inventory by clicking the top black bar in the game... !

Story background：



This is a world where a man and a monster coexist.
Before 1000, human beings and monsters fought for the war in the territory, although the two generals of the monster "Star""Moon" were far more capable of fighting than humans, but somehow the war ended with human victory.
After the war the monster settled in the monster forest and humans occupied most of the territory and the monster was isolated.

As time goes on, the barriers between the monsters and humans gradually melt away, thus merging with each other and starting to live in harmony.
Unfortunately, 20 years ago, there was a small conflict between a man's army in a routine patrol of the monster forest with cat monsters, but the cause was unclear, and the relationship between the man and the monster became terrible.

As a soldier, I am 40 years old, but I did not participate in the conflict because of my leg injury.
Today, when I was alone as a captain, I lost my way in the monster forest.

about_the_game:
Game Introduction

  • Hallways is an exhilarating escape and pursuit game that challenges you and your friends to navigate treacherous corridors while evading relentless pursuers.

Game Modes

  • Solo Play: Test your skills and survival instincts by going solo in the game, where you must outwit and outrun the relentless pursuers.
  • Two-Player Mode: Collaborate with a friend as a dynamic duo, working together to outmaneuver the lurking threats and prove yourselves as the ultimate team.
  • Four-Player Mode: Assemble a team of four players and embark on an adrenaline-pumping adventure to find the quickest escape route while dodging the relentless pursuers.

Matchmaking System

  • Pit your skills against other players in the exhilarating matchmaking system, comparing your escape prowess with others and striving for the top ranks on the leaderboard.

Private Game Lobbies

  • Create private game lobbies to challenge your friends and set your own rules. Customize the game style and difficulty level to create a unique and thrilling experience to share with your friends.

Game Features

  • Stunning 3D graphics and dynamic corridor designs that keep you on the edge of your seat.
  • A diverse range of characters to choose from, each with their unique abilities and customization options.
  • Equip your characters with special powers and gear to aid in your escape from the relentless pursuers.
  • Strategic gameplay and challenging levels that require tactical thinking and teamwork.
  • Engage in online competition with both computer-controlled pursuers and other players through the matchmaking system.
  • A leaderboard system that showcases the top players and allows you to track your progress.
  • The ability to organize private games with friends and set your own custom rules.
  • Embark on an adrenaline-fueled adventure in Korridorun Pursuit, where quick thinking and strategy are your best allies in navigating perilous corridors and evading relentless pursuers. Whether you're competing with friends or challenging players from around the world, aim to become the ultimate escape artist and top the leaderboard. Get ready to run, strategize, and conquer the most treacherous corridors!

about_the_game:
Harmonia is a digital novel made by visual novel studio Key.
There are no story branches based on choices. The story proceeds as if you were watching an anime or movie, or turning the pages of a novel.
Enjoy a touching story with beautiful music and graphics, realistic and colorful performances, brought to life by talented voice actors.

Game features
・With support for full HD resolution of 1920x1080 dots, you can enjoy the moving story in high-definition visuals.

・The text can be set to English, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese (audio only available in Japanese). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

・Protagonist Rei, as well as twenty-six background characters, are all given voices for the first time.

・Touch gestures can also be used if you're playing on a tablet PC or a Steam Deck.

THIS IS A STAND ALONE SINGLE PLAYER VERSION OF THE DLC "Call of the Tenebrae" for "Two Worlds II" (It does not require the main game and no prior experience with Two Worlds titles is needed, but it is only recommended for experienced RPG Players)

In this new RPG adventure, the shocking murder of DarPha sets in motion a chain of events that reveals a powerful new magic and a creeping evil with sinister designs for the populace of Antaloor. about_the_game:
Offroad VR is an exhilarating virtual reality experience, offering a challenging physics-based offroad driving game. In this game, players must navigate difficult terrains, using gears effectively to overcome obstacles and demonstrating timely reflexes to progress. With different tracks, changing weather conditions, and various vehicle options, this game brings the realistic offroad experience into the virtual world.

Game Features:

Physics-Based Challenges: In a game where players encounter real offroad challenges, mastering vehicle control is essential to navigate through challenging terrains.

Diverse Vehicles: Offroad VR provides a variety of vehicle options, allowing players to explore different experiences—from ATVs to offroad vehicles, delve into various classes of vehicles to conquer the tracks.

Different Tracks and Weather Conditions: The game offers an exciting offroad experience with varying track difficulties and different weather conditions. Conquer challenges in snow, rain, mud, and more.

Explore Offroad VR:

Offroad VR combines adrenaline-pumping offroad adventures with virtual reality, providing gamers with a realistic driving experience. Explore different tracks with various vehicles and push the limits of your offroad passion.

about_the_game:
Command your Bacteria in a war against the Cell Defense Force! Invade their territory, conquer their bases, and turn their own footholds against them in a world where your Units are your only resource! Fight battles across the a variety of unique maps where attacks could come from any direction, and know that any battle could be the difference between victory and death!

Oh, but it's not just mighty CDF you have to worry about. You must hold your ground against the armies of your fellow Bacteria, watch your back during the Late-Game event, and pray it isn't the Zombie Cell option that you selected!

Key Features:


  • Your Units Are Your Greatest (And Only) Resource:
Each player receives a continuous income of resources based on the number and type of units they have in their army. As your army expands, so too will your resource production... but be warned that the loss of your units will reduce your resource production, and your stockpile is limited in quantity.
Victory is therefore not likely to be achieved by simply throwing your units – your precious resources – at the enemy!

  • Mobile Bases:
Take the phrase "Adapt or Perish" to the next step! Static immobile bases are easy targets in a maze of tunnels that are constantly being patrolled by CDF forces. Every unit under your control may be moved around at will. Make good use of this newfound flexibility!

  • Late-Game Stage:
Spice up the late-game experience with a customizable Late-Game Event! From a fifteen minute rush to a one hour long-play, and from the entrance of a fourth player to the arrival of a nigh-unstoppable zombie plague, this event will surely mix things up. Up the difficulty and atmosphere by enabling Dark Mode, which disables all ambient light when the Late-Game Event starts.

  • Upgrade and Specialize Your Units:
Each Unit can be upgraded to better perform certain tasks, from increased detection range or faster production, to becoming an unstoppable juggernaut!

  • Customizable Unit Formations:
Adapt your units' formation to any situation on any terrain. If you're surrounded on all sides, will you circle up into a defensive ball, or bunch together into a devastating hammer and blow through to relative safety?

Become a Hybrid


Hybrid Instinct is a action fighting puzzle platformer. Collect all Magic Fruits and unlock special powers. Defend your territory against challenging enemy's.









Game Features


  • Discover atmospheric Worlds! Explore flying islands, crystal ruins, misty jungles and magic forests as you collect all magic fruits.
  • Dive deep, fly high, defend your territory, climb walls or drive motorcycles.
  • Gain new abilities and master an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, traps, and mechanisms to confound your enemies and explore new heights.
  • Solve challenging quests! Search for lost treasures to unravel the secrets of the hybrids. Prepare for the unexpected!
  • Discover over 100 Levels and test your skills in a fast paced parkour mode.
  • Play with your friends! Controller support for 1v1 Fighting and up to 4 Players in Parkour Mode.

XP Soccer is a love letter to the classic soccer games from the NES era!



We wanted to use pixel-art in a way that is faithful to the 90's console limitations, only breaking those rules sparsely to enhance the player's experience and customization.

Simple and tight controls will give you a variety of moves with a combination of the classic A and B buttons!

56 National Teams:

Play Modes:

■ Exhibition Match (Single Player, Local VS and Local Co-Op)



■ 8 Tournaments (Single Player and Local Co-Op)

Features:

■ 56 National Teams
■ 4 Grass Stadiums
■ 4 Alternative Stadiums
■ 40 Achievements
■ Formations and Substitutions
■ Curve Shots
■ Fouls, Free Kicks and Penalties
■ Simple controls

about_the_game:
Jump into the music industry with Music Wars Empire! Take the role of a manager or CEO of a record label, and try to make your mark on the music industry! Whether you want to start small and create your own indie record company to cultivate quality releases, or aim big and pursue the more lucrative commercial pop markets while buying out the opposition, the choice is yours!

Game Features
  • The built-in editor makes it easier than ever to add you and your friends, real life musicians, or create your own original mod from scratch!
  • Release Studio Albums, Singles, Music Videos, EPs, Greatest Hits Packages, Compilations, Live Albums, DVDs, Promo Singles and Mixtapes.
  • Over 50 music charts to track the performance of your bands all across the world, including new digital streaming charts.
  • Hundreds of detailed record labels, bands, and artists!
  • Deal with egos, personal relationships, and behind the scene developments that can help and hurt your production schedule.
  • Manage multiple record labels! Whether you want to launch your own imprint label, or buy out and manage a competitor, the choice is yours!
  • Send your bands on the road to tour or perform in music festivals around the world.
  • Realistic record sales influenced by population, economy, piracy, seasonal and music trends
  • Sign new bands or form your own through talent search.
  • Use the new Discover Talent feature to recruit new members to your signed bands.
  • The new Chattr feature allows players to keep up with the latest news in the industry across all the different music genres.
  • Ever wanted to have a band experiment with a different genre? The new “form side project” feature allows players to do just that – let your band’s creative juices flow.


Note: This game is no longer supported and will not receive any new updates.

about_the_game:
Experience bustling regional and commuter operations from aboard modern and well-known traction with Train Sim World: Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr. Drive your trains over a rail network represented how it is today, complete with both routes between Essen and Bochum that are populated by different trains and services. Reproduced in exquisite detail, every station, signal and milepost feel so real you could almost reach out and touch them.

It’s your job to carry passengers along Deutsche Bahn’s ever-busy Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr. Manage the complexities of keeping to the timetable, picking up and dropping off passengers in a timely yet safe and comfortable manner. Whether you’re driving, riding along or watching the action, experience all the sights and sounds of a modern commuter line.

Take control of a duo of DB multiple units, the hard-working DB BR 425 which is used on regional services by the dozen throughout Germany, and the DB BR 422 that works exclusively for the S-Bahn Rhein-Ruhr. Together the two work passenger duties along the route. Featuring authentic AC EMU simulation underpinned with expert technical knowledge and real-world data, the performance, sounds and feel has been accurately reproduced to make them feel just like the real thing.

Train Sim World: Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr caters for players of all ability levels with accessible training for beginners and advanced procedures for experts. Whether you're looking to get started driving trains or refreshing your expert knowledge, Train Sim World has it covered. Feel the detail as you step into the cab, take control then live out your dreams exploring the highly detailed and immersive environment of the Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr!

Choose how you want to play in Train Sim World: Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr. Take control and master modern multiple units, running-to-time or carrying out important tasks or riding along as a passenger and watching the world go by. Why not watch all the action unfold and capture amazing screenshots or go exploring and complete all the Jobs? Whatever you choose to do, there's lots to see and experience in Train Sim World: Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr.

Key Features


  • 46 km (28 mile) route between Duisburg and Bochum
  • Includes both the regional and S-Bahn routes between Essen and Bochum
  • DB BR 425 EMU in DB Regio Red livery
  • DB BR 422 EMU in DB Regio Red livery
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs with accurate true-to-life performance and handling
  • Authentic and detailed sound recordings, recorded from the real multiple units
  • Journey Mode featuring over 20 hours of activities for you to master
  • Five detailed and engaging scenarios for the route
  • 100 Jobs for you to complete including placing route maps, installing ticket machines, restocking fire extinguishing points and placing advertising posters
  • Accessible Training Modules to get you started quickly
  • Extensive 24-Hour Timetable
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 2.1GB

about_the_game:
The Plot:

After find a powerful living crystal, the Kingdom of Fire began to rises. But this power carries with itself an curse, with time its was found an addiction that slowly disintegrated the bodies of those who lingered too close.

The King then, after find about the curse, decide to enslave the entire race of Greenins who had a natural aptitude with the crystals, due to them be born on the same forest.

Yet... Even with the slavery of the weaker, the kingdom couldn't resist to the curse of the crystals and began to fall. the crystals drove them to madness... death... leading the Kingdom to the catastrophe.

Features:

  • The combat is focused on being offensive, and punish your enemies whey they missing they attacks

  • Melee Combat, Skill Power, and Magic Spells, mixing weapon attack with skills to create better combo and strategies.

  • Environment with procedural elements that change in each run.

  • Play co-op or alone.

  • Create your own character, choose your style

  • Permanent Death for some npcs and some actions will carry to other paths.

  • Upgrade your level to get stronger and be able to use new skills

  • Purchase items with sellers and learn skills sorcerers and warriors.
detailed_description:
The Plot:

After find a powerful living crystal, the Kingdom of Fire began to rises. But this power carries with itself an curse, with time its was found an addiction that slowly disintegrated the bodies of those who lingered too close.

The King then, after find about the curse, decide to enslave the entire race of Greenins who had a natural aptitude with the crystals, due to them be born on the same forest.

Yet... Even with the slavery of the weaker, the kingdom couldn't resist to the curse of the crystals and began to fall. the crystals drove them to madness... death... leading the Kingdom to the catastrophe.

Features:

  • The combat is focused on being offensive, and punish your enemies whey they missing they attacks

  • Melee Combat, Skill Power, and Magic Spells, mixing weapon attack with skills to create better combo and strategies.

  • Environment with procedural elements that change in each run.

  • Play co-op or alone.

  • Create your own character, choose your style

  • Permanent Death for some npcs and some actions will carry to other paths.

  • Upgrade your level to get stronger and be able to use new skills

  • Purchase items with sellers and learn skills sorcerers and warriors.
