SURVIVE

It's a cruel world.

  • Make sure to stay hydrated and fed.

  • Use medical supplies to heal up.

  • Stay safe throughout the night.

FIGHT or RUN

The only other option is death.

  • Unload your guns into hordes of zombies.

  • Try to keep a low profile by using silenced weapons and melee.

  • Run away.

GET BETTER EQUIPPED

The bigger the better.

  • Find civilian-grade weapons in towns.

  • Get military-grade weapons from military outposts.

  • Find supplies to survive.

  • Find and harvest materials to rebuild.

EXPLORE

Find what civilization has left behind.

  • Roam the world destroyed by the disease.

  • Find the best places to gather supplies.

  • Explore what's left of the old world.

about_the_game:
Overdungeon is a completely new style real-time card games that has combined elements from rogue-like, tower defense and card games, which is full of random elements, and easy to play!

To defeat formidable enemies and clear the dungeon in the end, you need a deck of powerful cards! Alpaca, Dog and grand Chicken Coop, which one is your Joker. Play it out!

■ Dynamic Deck Building

Abounding cards of different types, such as animals, buildings, spells, traps, and so on; and they are still expanding! A card do make a difference with its unique features in a deck. Create your own powerful deck, and make it to the top!

■ Playful Cards with Memes

Cards are not just useful in the battle, but also playful with memes! Cats, Dogs, silly Alpacas, Carnot cycle and grand Chicken Coop, this is the Craziest Dungeon ever! Summon the poultry and pets to fight, witness and enjoy the stacking fun! A warm reminder, Trypophobians are advised to avoid!

■ Breathtaking Real-time Battle

Play the card right to wipe the enemy out! We combined RTS with card games to make Overdungeon a semi-real-time strategy game. Ensure you have enough cards to draw and play endlessly in a single run! Come and experience the thrill of crushing a Boss!

■ Everchanging Map

Random and changing are cores to a rogue-like game, so does Overdungeon! The map changes every time you play. Every time you enter the dungeon, there is always a brand new adventure awaits you! As the circumstance varies, will you risk your life to challenge elite monsters for the greater loot? Or just take a nap for the forthcoming journey? With more than 50 types of events, you’ll never know what will happen this time!

■ Various Relics

To improve the strategy and randomness of Overdungeon, we created the fabulous Relic System! Various relics drop in random, they may upgrade your deck or change draw order, and may further reverse the situation.

You'll need all your skills and dexterity to overcome the enemy and destroy the alien threat once and for all.

about_the_game:
DIY MY GIRL (PC version) is a creative game that combines AI and VR technology. Because it allows players to choose the gender, age, and dress of their characters in VR, they can also add new anime characters, or use AI technology to upload their own photos and customize their favorite avatars. In addition, it has a rich resource library and interactive mode to release the creativity of players.

1. Customize a personalized girl

Players can customize a cute girl avatar in VR and upload photos from their computers to generate faces of their choice. The AI ​​technology used in this game ensures that players upload a complete copy of the photos.
Players can also choose the original avatar that comes with the system, or add favorite anime avatars, or even change the gender of the girl. These functions are in the right menu bar as shown in the figure below.

Players can match girls with suitable hairstyles on this page.

Players can adjust many details of the avatar. As shown in the picture below, players can not only change the appropriate hairstyle for their avatar, but also adjust the color of the hair.

All head designs customized by the player will be stored in the VR 3D menu. Players can drag any head from this menu to their girl avatar for easy access.

Players can choose clothes for their girl portrait.

2. Let's start dancing
Players can choose the action of the girl's avatar. The game provides a library of more than 200 daily actions and 60 groups of dance actions for players to set combinations.

3. Interactive games
The player can interact with the girl's avatar, as shown in the following example. They can choose to throw a ball at the girl, shoot a water gun, or set off fireworks through the function keys on the right side of the game page, and their girl portrait will respond accordingly. During the game, her emotions towards the player will change, and she will respond differently according to her preferences.

The player's reaction to the girl after she fired a water gun

The player's reaction after throwing a ball at the girl

Firework stick

Fireworks that bloom after the launch of the firework stick

This is a DIY game full of creativity and interactive fun. Players have a lot of maneuverable spaces in it to give full play to their creativity.
At the same time, watching the girl's reaction in the interaction is full of unknown interest. It is a very casual and relaxing game. The rich costume resources of the game library are also very suitable for players who want to have their own design characters.
detailed_description:
DIY MY GIRL (PC version) is a creative game that combines AI and VR technology. Because it allows players to choose the gender, age, and dress of their characters in VR, they can also add new anime characters, or use AI technology to upload their own photos and customize their favorite avatars. In addition, it has a rich resource library and interactive mode to release the creativity of players.

1. Customize a personalized girl

Players can customize a cute girl avatar in VR and upload photos from their computers to generate faces of their choice. The AI ​​technology used in this game ensures that players upload a complete copy of the photos.
Players can also choose the original avatar that comes with the system, or add favorite anime avatars, or even change the gender of the girl. These functions are in the right menu bar as shown in the figure below.

Players can match girls with suitable hairstyles on this page.

Players can adjust many details of the avatar. As shown in the picture below, players can not only change the appropriate hairstyle for their avatar, but also adjust the color of the hair.

All head designs customized by the player will be stored in the VR 3D menu. Players can drag any head from this menu to their girl avatar for easy access.

Players can choose clothes for their girl portrait.

2. Let's start dancing
Players can choose the action of the girl's avatar. The game provides a library of more than 200 daily actions and 60 groups of dance actions for players to set combinations.

3. Interactive games
The player can interact with the girl's avatar, as shown in the following example. They can choose to throw a ball at the girl, shoot a water gun, or set off fireworks through the function keys on the right side of the game page, and their girl portrait will respond accordingly. During the game, her emotions towards the player will change, and she will respond differently according to her preferences.

The player's reaction to the girl after she fired a water gun

The player's reaction after throwing a ball at the girl

Firework stick

Fireworks that bloom after the launch of the firework stick

This is a DIY game full of creativity and interactive fun. Players have a lot of maneuverable spaces in it to give full play to their creativity.
At the same time, watching the girl's reaction in the interaction is full of unknown interest. It is a very casual and relaxing game. The rich costume resources of the game library are also very suitable for players who want to have their own design characters.

about_the_game:
In the dead of winter, a major corporation threatens to seize control of the farmland to build a new mall. The whole town will need to come together to make enough money to buy it back, or face extinction. But in the coldest winter in decades, the conditions make farming almost impossible.

Ancient farming secrets must now be unlocked as you are forced to learn to grow crops in winter and make friends and enemies in an equally icy social climate.

Player Options


Play as either gender and choose a partner who will help you put a stop to the megamall and keep the tension between the townsfolk down amidst the stress.

Explore Exotic Lands


Take to the skies in an air balloon to holiday in exotic lands under the guise of seeking out new farming secrets.

Story-based Gameplay


Character development, varied dialogue and side quests break up the joyous monotony of farming.

Barn and Breakfast


Give the old barn and chicken coops a second life by allowing visitors to stay in them to make a few extra dollars for the town. Wait on them hand on foot and feed them daily just as you would a real chicken or cow.

Special Abilities


Explore ancient caves to unlock access to additional ancient caves and attain greater winter farming and cooking mastery.

A Yeti


Many doubt the existence of the yeti, but there are those who have seen him with their own eyes. Will his legend be confirmed, or is he just a false beacon of hope?

Market Days


Come together with the community to put on special themed market days, where buyers emerge from faraway lands for a chance to buy rare delicacies like mushroom soup, and hand-crafted furniture.

Parties


Bad weather won't keep anybody at home as a new party will be held every week. Parties represent a chance to woo girls (or boys) and help you get to know people (which leads to quests).

Critter Connection


Befriend wild critters and gain their love by feeding them expert cooking recipes lovingly crafted in your own house. Collect a variety of animals on your farm and nurture them so they will in turn help you unlock ancient farming secrets.

An additional scenario for the War Chronicles mode of the "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV: Diplomacy and Strategy Expansion Pack Bundle".

Note: This product is included in the "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV Season Pass 2". Be careful to avoid making a redundant purchase.

▼War Chronicles scenario
Clash of the Warmongers

Background:
A scenario where the armies of Lu Bu, Zhang Fei, and Ma Chao fight one another to determine the strongest force in the Three Kingdoms period.
Lu Bu's army sets up the main base in Xiapi, with Zhang Liao and Dian Wei as subordinates. Consider increasing your movement speed once the dearest person replenishes supplies.
Zhang Fei's army is based in Shouchun, with Guan Yu and Taishi Ci joining the ranks. Once a warlord second to none in the era comes to your aid, use their intellect to the fullest extent.
Ma Chao's army have Zhao Yun and Gan Ning under the command, and its base is in Chenliu. A sworn friend will arrive as reinforcements and set traps around the main base to fortify the defense, so feel free to go out and attack.

about_the_game:
The Dark Tones: Loss — tells and shows you tragic events inspired by real life and people's stories.

Attention to detail and surroundings

All game levels were created from scratch in order to provide the player with a unique environment, rather than the same type of locations purchased on marketplaces and reused in other games.

All the contents of the game were arranged manually with great attention to detail and detail, in order to create a lively, filled and interesting game world.

The Dark Tones: Loss is an atmospheric story-oriented work

The short duration of the passage is compensated by the saturation and variety of events in the passage.

Here you will not find the same type of riddles, hours of searching for objects or aimless wandering around locations.

All the efforts, resources and time spent on the development of this work were aimed at creating an interesting, vivid and meaningful work in which the duration of the gameplay plays a secondary role.

History and the surrounding world filled with images and metaphors

Here you will not have to escape from zombies, run from ridiculous ghosts and crazed maniacs.

Living the life of the main character, you will encounter something much more terrible and frightening.

But, everything that is happening has a much deeper meaning than it might seem at first glance.

You have to get to the truth and put the puzzle together.

An adult story about choice, despair and the human soul

The plot of the game was not invented at random, it contains both personal experience and the experience of other people's stories.

The game does not aim to scare you with harsh sounds, monsters or ghosts, even if it also has that, but it encourages you to think about something more important and valuable that can really scare, but not reflexively, but mentally and emotionally, because it's not strange or scary things that really scare, things scare ordinary, real and real, which surround us every day, but which at the same time begin to look strange and therefore become scary.

Modern game engine and technology

The game is made on the latest version of the Unreal Engine 5 using a realistic Lumen lighting system.

The world of dark tones will meet not only with a gloomy story and atmosphere, but also with pleasant realistic graphics with high detail of objects and textures!

Among the features of the game it can be noted:
- Pleasant and detailed graphics.

- Professional voice acting of female characters.

- Unusual and atypical visual style.

- Cutscenes and directing.

- Various and beautiful achievements that carry their own message and meaning.

- More than two thousand words of text and dialog system with all the characters of the game.

- Nowhere involved unique locations.

- Saving progress in the middle of the game.

- Good optimization and stability.

about_the_game:
Over 150 unique monsters! A massive RPG with an abundance of rich content.

Train your monster with the goal of becoming the champion!

Only the main character's partner possesses the cheat move called "Cheat Tackle".

It ensures a guaranteed first strike and a one-hit kill.

In the easy mode, you can even use it endlessly!

In this world, there exists mystical creatures known as "Yarimon".

Known as the loner protagonist with the weakest Yarimon... until now, that is.

In a surprising turn of events, the protagonist's Yarimon partner learned a godly-powerful move with a power level of 800,000 called the "Cheat Tackle".

With this, the protagonist's world completely changed, as this move will one-shot any opponent in battle (though it is only usable once per battle).

Of course, it would be foolish to believe that one can become the champion with just a single move. Therefore, a trainer must continue to hone their skills and diversify their strategies.

With that said, defeating my childhood friend for the first time is already a crazy accomplishment.

I can finally get back some of the money I lost to her...

Afterwards, I set out on an adventure after my childhood friend told me she was going on a journey and pressured me to do the same.

As I am adventuring, I slowly unravel the secret of this world.

This is when I felt like my journey had really begun.

Aim to complete the Yarimon Encyclopedia (Yaridex)!!

Monster-taming RPG

Collect a variety of Yarimon and strive relentlessly towards the championship!

Gain EXP by battling either wild Yarimon or trainers.

With the advent of EXP shards, you will also be able to freely allocate EXP to your favorite Yarimon!

Uncover the truth and secrets that are hidden within this world!

Explore the secrets hidden in this world, gradually unveiling it's truth!

  • Over 150 monsters

  • Pixel art for each character

  • Illustrations for each character along with various facial expressions

  • Having a monster index

about_the_game:
Akanemachi is a quiet, idyllic town where residents enjoy peaceful lives... That is, until an earthquake hits and eerie occurrences suddenly begin to plague the town. People start disappearing, crime increases dramatically, and all the townsfolk seem on edge. When her friend joins the list of missing persons, it's up to Aya, an ordinary resident of Akanemachi, to investigate the mysterious incidents, rid the town of a dangerous evil, and bring peace back to her town!

Explore Akanemachi to gather information and key items that will help you with your investigation!

By interacting with the townsfolk and roaming the town, you will gain new information and items that will allow you to unlock events and access new areas in the town, bringing you closer to unraveling the mysteries of Akanemachi.

Charming Pixel Art

Enjoy the look of a classic pixel game as you explore the town.

Adventure Puzzle Game

Use the items and information you gather to devise plans to explore new areas and get yourself out of trouble.

about_the_game:
Twisted Screens invites you to step into the boots of Tessa Gracelyn, a mercenary hired by ATR Industries to explore a long-abandoned science facility — one now overrun with horrifying experiments to shut down their nuclear reactor.

Teaming up with Legsy-0, a sarcastic A.I. assistant from ATR’s golden age, you’ll navigate the metal halls through a mix of parkour and puzzles. Legsy’s sharp wit and questionable guidance will either help you survive. or make you go insane.

In this first-person sci-fi adventure inspired by the Mascot Horror genre, you’ll leap, climb, and sprint through puzzle-filled environments, uncover absurd lore, and make use of strange gadgets to progress. The world is twisted, the humor is questionable. welcome to ATR Industries.

about_the_game:
Your family has been poor for generations, and now you have grown into manhood with one goal: free them from poverty and struggle. Take control of Jack as you begin a journey with one goal...and it becomes something very different that shakes your family to its foundations.

Features:

  • An exploration RPG with over 150 items to use and equip, random loot and over 25 monsters to fight. Each game is different.

  • Custom designed, detailed parallax maps with immersive sound and music design throughout. Over 4-6 hours of gameplay on average.

  • Over 20 skills to learn, each with different effects and advantages. No 'magic' used here, this is a strictly practical, real-world based RPG.

  • Over 20 quests to complete, many important to progress in the game, with on-screen tracker. Strong writing and narrative twists used to propel the story forward.

  • OTB based combat increases strategy needed to win fights consistently.

Enter the world of pirates, treasure and adventure today with Sea Of Secrets!

about_the_game:
Clashing swords and piercing spears - the medieval war is upon us!

Created by Murray Atkinson from VGM Library, Medieval Warfare is a musical odyssey into battle and war. Inspired by both classic films such as Lord of the Rings and modern favorites such as Game of Thrones, with a couple bonus Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim flavored ambient, icy, other-worldly drones, the themes in this pack visit the idea of war - from intense action-packed battles to brief respites of calm and beyond. This pack features 25 songs, including alternative versions of several key themes. Murray Atkinson's masterful blend of melody and vocalizations adds an extra layer of intensity to several themes, making them fitting for a variety of settings and moods.

Features:

  • 25 BGM themes
  • Composed with high quality instruments and vocalizations
  • Alternate versions of key themes included
  • .M4A, .OGG and .MP3 formats included
  • Tested in and formatted for use in RPG Maker MV

about_the_game:
"MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN!"

Within the United States, civil unrest fueled by racial tensions reaches even higher than in the 1960's. To China and Russia, the new US President seems so unpredictable and reckless that it seems logical to make a pre-emptive strike rather than wait for him to have a 'bad hair day' and launch a strike against them. In Western Europe, leaders are shaken by their new reality and realize they may have to make concessions to Russia now that America can no longer be relied upon. The European Union itself is in disarray as the UK prepares to leave and forge its own relationships. In Mexico, and even in Canada, militaries are brought to an unprecedented level of readiness over concern of Trump's ambitions.

How will this play out? Will you assume Trump's role as the new US leader and guide America to renewed Greatness? Or will you instead lead another nation and take advantage of a potentially dysfunctional America to further your own ambition?

This DLC adds the following to Supreme Ruler Ultimate:
  • New Sandbox starting on US Inauguration Day, January 20, 2017
  • Updated "Modern World" relationships, leaders, and regional economies
  • Take control as President Donald Trump, or try to minimize the damage as another World Leader
  • Build the Trump Wall - although you may have to pay for it yourself
  • Encourage regional growth with the Trump Tower economic development zones

about_the_game:
Mech Academy is an adult visual novel based on multiple-choice decisions. The player will assume the role of the protagonist in this story and will encounter "several characters, and try to develop your relationship with them. The player's decisions will have an impact on the evolution of the story.

"It's the year 2175, and you are the pilot of a Guardian Mech. These are gigantic war machines built to defend Earth from the Noxa, a ruthless alien race intent on conquering your planet. However, you don't belong to this time; you are actually Lieutenant Knight, a highly decorated soldier who lived in the 1970s. Due to a mysterious experiment, you have been catapulted two centuries into the future. Everything is new and complicated for you. Your world, the society in which you grew up, is profoundly different from the one you find yourself in now."

Following a bizarre series of interconnected events, you have been chosen as a pilot. Your new home is now Section 2, a training center led by Elara Sardana, a captivating commander who is as strict as she is attractive. Elara is a hybrid, half-Earthling, half-alien.

You are not the only pilot at the base;

Mei Maede is a rebellious girl with a sensual attitude. From your first encounter, she will show a strong attraction toward you.

Drana, on the other hand, is a Vorlanian, a princess from a people light-years away from Earth. Drana pilots the Ghost Mech. It will be very difficult to establish a good relationship with her; her strong, determined, duty-bound, confrontational, and especially hostile attitude toward you won't make life easy, but it will certainly be worth trying to win her over.

Lydia Helmer is a dark-haired girl with a delicate face. Lydia is the fourth pilot from Section 2. Like Drana, she also doesn't hold you in high regard. Lydia is a very reserved, shy, and closed-off girl. Getting her to open up to you won't be easy, but when she does, it will make you very happy.

Irina is the chief scientist. she is very intelligent, a genius, but she is also very distracted and forgetful. She has a too-accommodating nature. In Mech Academy

you'll have the opportunity to meet many beautiful women, all with complex and well-defined nature and behaviour. Interacting with them, seducing them, making them fall in love with you, will not be so easy and straightforward. Especially because you will be busy defending Earth from extraterrestrial invaders!

Features:

- 5000 Full Hd Images

- 180 Full Hd Animations

- 140.000 words

- Multiple choices

- Music & Sound effect

- You Can Decide the Name Of the Character

- Ren'py Engine

.

Lydia is a Sparkle Mech pilot, is a third-generation pilot, and is a pilot with a higher connection value than all 95% pilots; both her grandfather and father were skilled and respected Mech pilots. Their family has a natural genetic predisposition for Guardian Mechs.

Mei is a pilot of the Wonder Mech, She is considered the bravest pilot when it comes to "getting serious" she never backs down, in fact, she is reckless. Mei was part of Section 5 (the Europe section, the most important and prestigious section), but due to an incident caused by her act of insubordination, she was suspended.

.

Elara is the director of Section 2 of the IDA agency. Loyal to duty, rules and tradition. Elara is one of the first women born from an alien mother (Cruvians) and an earthly parent. She is entrusted with base 2, a base that enriches the pilots' experience, but rarely joined battle until now

Irinia is a technological genius. Lives for science and research. Passionate about ancient pre-contact technologies (in her spare time she tries to repair the engine of an old car)

Drana is a pilot of Ghost Mech, her is Vorlanian. Haughty alien. She despises Earth both past and present. She considers Earthlings to be underdeveloped creatures. Hers was a people of mystics and noble warriors.

Are you hungry? Do you want some yakiniku?

Let's play this game! Simple and easy!

Simulate to eating a yakiniku with no more calories!!!

Just chill out and simulate eating yakiniku!

This game is so simple you can play with only 1 mode but can apply to several types of play.

1. Plain play
Nothing to do so much.. just play for fun or chat with friends.

2. Play with rice
If you hungry, you can enjoy your meal with only rice bowls. (You can add more sauce or salt for a good taste.)

3. Play with beer
Enjoy the yakiniku atmosphere with cold beer. It'll make you relax.

4. Play with salad.
Do you want to diet? Don't worry, this game will make your salad's taste better!!! Try it!!!

5. ETC
You can enjoy our game in a lot of ways. Please share with us for your play!

1. keep raw meat on the stove.


2. Flip meat when you think it's OK.


3. Beware it's OVERCOOK!


4. Throw away burned meat.


5. Keep perfect meat to sauce and eat it!


*This game is not support any controller BUT support with rice and beer!!!!

Enjoy your meal!!!!!!!

about_the_game:
Blood Pivot is an electrifying pixel top-down indie game. Immerse yourself in a harrowing tale, beginning as a child selected as a sacrifice by your own parents, both devout members of the sinister cult known as "The Children of The Breathing Cross". As you struggle to escape their clutches, you are forced to defend yourself and inadvertently take the life of your own father. But that's only the beginning.



As you search the labyrinthine depths of your home, you uncover a foreboding and insidious underground world that will test your sanity and challenge your very existence. Your religious paranoia will drive you to the brink of madness as you embark on a treacherous journey to save the lives of all those who have been sacrificed.

✞ GAMEPLAY ✞

As a young child, you'll explore a dark and eerie world filled with unsettling environments and disturbing creatures. Armed with only your wits and a small arsenal of weapons, you must navigate through the game's top-down levels and fight against the members of a sinister cult that seeks to control you. Along the way, you'll encounter challenging puzzles and obstacles that will test your problem-solving skills and courage. The game's haunting soundtrack and minimalist visuals will immerse you in a world of psychological horror, leaving you on edge until the very end.

✞ EXPERIENCE TRUE HORROR ✞

Blood Pivot will thrill and terrify you with a multitude of enigmas, obstacles, along with constant battles against the fanatical members of the cult, determined to keep their twisted secrets buried forever. The game is infused with an eerie, suspenseful, and amazingly captivating storyline that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

✞ RELIGIOUS PARANOIA ✞

If you're ready for a challenging and spine-tingling gaming experience, then Blood Pivot is the perfect choice for you. And the best part? This heart-stopping game is available now on Steam. So, brace yourself and enter the world of Blood Pivot, if you dare.

about_the_game:
A Pathfinder compatible adventure for 4-6 PCs of levels 6-8


Sometimes it is the simplest of tasks which end up taking much more of time and energy than they should. When the party is asked by the local sage to collect some rare flora, it feels like relatively easy money; a journey into the woods they’ve traveled before, a conversation with someone they’ve met before and then on to gather the crop. The characters can hear the Thirsty Serpent tavern calling them after a brisk afternoon’s work.

But the PCs’ plans go awry when it turns out nothing is quite that straight forward. Deals have to be struck, foes defeated, anger and scorn dealt with and then the whole process gone through again. When there is duplicity at every turn and double-crossing is done with relish, the PCs have to keep their wits and weapons equally sharp. Dealing with someone who is prepared to cross the line between humiliation and harm at a moment’s notice is a tough challenge; this quickly becomes about much more than mere mushrooms!

Also included in "Alchemist's Errand":

  • Maps by 3x ENnie Award winning Cartographer Todd Gamble
  • New Monster: Tri-Tongued Horror
  • 7 New Traps
  • 1 High Resolution Battlemap
  • 3 Full Screen Cave Maps filled with illustrations
  • New Magical Item: Jaamuuri's Amulet of Icy Defense

Requires: A Fantasy Grounds full or ultimate license or an active subscription and the included Pathfinder ruleset (3.5E Compatible).

about_the_game:
Guns, Gears & Giddy-up! 

Form a crew of bounty-hunting robot cowboys to take on dangerous contracts from the Town Sheriff. Team up with friends in 1-4 player co-op to track down dangerous targets, take them out, and bring home the bounty. It’s a dusty job, but someone’s gotta do it!

The Wild West, But Weirder 

This is the Wild West, but not as you know it. Alongside dusty saloons and endless deserts, you’ll encounter haunted mines, reanimated skeletons, and deadly storms at every turn. Complete daring contracts, explore cursed lands, and watch out for the giant ghost train.

Shoot Fast, Spell Faster & Survive Together. 

Switch seamlessly between six-shooters and fireballs, customize your gear, and combine your spells as you face waves of enemies and powerful bosses. Work as a team, adapt on the fly, and push deeper into the unknown to unlock bigger challenges and better rewards.

Customise, upgrade and gear up 

Trade at town to upgrade your guns, spells and abilities. Pick your perks to build the ultimate bounty hunter. Specialise in spell damage, healing or headshots. Customise your robot cowboy and beloved steed with unlockable skins to traverse the Far Far West in style.

What you must do is FIND WHO YOU ARE. There are 13 stories that you can find. Through the 7 days activity, you can see a total of 13 egos(ending). Based on this information, the player can choose a choice. That option can affect the next day or the ending.
Also, you can find interesting rumors and elements in it, and maybe it resembles an aspect of the society that we live in.

about_the_game:
Run your bicycle workshop and repair bicycles by your own hand. Tighten the screws, adjust the chain, and then do some personalized printing. Ready to assemble frame, derailleur, flywheel, pedal, brake, handle... . It's not just your sweat that makes you a bicycle repair master, but your attention to detail and skills.

Highly realistic parts for assembling


In Bicycle Mechanic Simulator, we reconstruct a large number of parts in detail, including frames, spokes, flywheels, chains, disc brakes, pedals, and more. The parts you know and the parts you don't know will give you the fun of assembling a bike in the game. Use different assembly tools to transform a bike from a scattering of parts into a shiny, stylish bike.

Experience the whole process of bicycle repair


Test, repair, maintenance, assembly, painting, conditioning. Complete the bicycle repair process in your bicycle workshop and immerse yourself in the sweat and smell of engine oil. Every order is a challenge. Don't forget to expand your workshop and buy new tools and parts so that you can get more orders and business.

Collect lots of different types of bicycle


As the owner of a bicycle workshop, you are also a collector of bicycles. When you see a bicycle you like, don't hesitate to buy it and make it part of your garage collection. Every unique bicycle may have a unique story behind it. A bicycle made with your hands can also become a hot work of art in the market.

Roll up your sleeves! You must be professional enough to create a shiny perfect bike.

about_the_game:
(if you're fast enough)


ENDER is a game about going fast, but doesn't punish you for taking your time.
In essence, it is a 3D platformer focused on teleportation. The reason so few platformers have straight up teleport mechanics is cause they usually break every platforming game design principle known to man when introduced. But this game and its levels are made from the ground up to support this break in convention. Use them to get to places you wouldn't reach. Use them as a makeshift checkpoint to teleport back to. Hell, use them to get 2 meters forwards slightly faster than by walking.

There are timed bronze/silver/gold medals, these are not needed to advance in the game, their main purpose is to let you know that level you are fast in... well... you are REALLY fast in that one. Good job.

While not the focus, there are also some some light, open-ended puzzles, and a smidge of combat (that will be expanded upon on the full release).
There is also an optional collectathon element with a heart hidden on every level, as a little easter egg hunt.



ENDER has hand drawn animated cutscenes, but the story itself is rather unconventional. It's a way for me to express some questions I don't know the answers to.

This game is in public alpha so a lot of things (including Steam integration and controller support) are still in the works.
The alpha is playable as the "Demo" here on Steam. Upon full release this game will have a free demo too, but for now I'm using it for you to play it early access for free without any hassle. This game will not be monetized until it is actually done.

about_the_game:
In the twilight of the solar system, some beats never die.

Ageless beings cling to relics of a distant past, chasing shadows of shelter from the ever-creeping Red Dwarf our Sun has become. Among the cosmos, one substance still sets the universe on fire—Mercury. Mysterious. Musical. Magnetic. Forged only on the last terraforming stations, it fuels immortality for some and endless energy for others. And its power? Transmuted by sound.

Welcome to Fi—a symphony of survival and sound.

Command your vessel as it gallops above a garden orbiting Mars. Build your base—make it a sonic sanctuary or an unbreakable fortress. Grow, gather, or groove at your own pace. Then plug in and amplify—use MIDI inputs to bend the world with your music.

Once your stage is set, dive headfirst into the secrets of the Precursors. Scavenge rare plants and treasure to upgrade your Drum and Bass. Or switch gears—toss your drummer in the backseat and shred across space with Rock and Roll. Whether you're a solo act or leading a Capitol Ship packed with your crew, you'll be blasting away while blasting away.

Fi blends cozy base-building with a beat-driven multiplayer twist. A relaxing jam session with friends—or a full-throttle concert of chaos. With percussion and concussions, it's rhythm meets rebellion.

From Novice to Rockstar, Fi drums up a way for everyone to play—even the most unlikely of bandmates.

about_the_game:
Up high in the Northern Atlantic Ocean, between Iceland, Norway, and Great Britain, lie the Faroe Islands – an archipelago of 18 islands. Here, helicopters are important for traffic in areas that buses and ferries do not reach, while visitors from abroad arrive at Vágar Airport.

The scenery Faroe Islands XP now recreates the entire archipelago for XPlane 11 – Maps2XPlane have developed the terrain mesh of Faroes4XPlane, while Albert Ràfols has contributed the airport Vágar and the helipads.

Thanks to seasonal adaptations the high-resolution terrain mesh always perfectly fits the current time of year, while the autogen has been realised in a uniquely Faroese style by both designers. In addition, there are hundreds of custom objects, 3D vegetation, and night lighting.

Virtual pilots can approach Vágar Airport (FAE, EKVG) that mirrors its real-world counterpart to great detail – like the runway that is realistically sloped. The eight helipads spread over the islands are included in this scenery as well.


  • Realistic recreation of the complete Faroe Islands with an area of about 1.400 km²
  • High resolution terrain mesh with various texture sets for a seasonal representation
  • Customized local terrain details, e.g. realistically sloped runway at the Vágar Airport
  • Detailed rendition of the Vágar Airport and the eight helipads spread over the archipelago
  • Faroese themed autogen, navigation obstacles and dynamic traffic on the islands
  • Hundreds of custom objects with PBR materials, 3D vegetation, night lighting

about_the_game:
THE DOWN BELOW is a short adventure horror fps inspired by titles such as Dusk, The Pony Factory, Half Life, System Shock 2, and other similar titles. The Down Below focuses on mystery and story-telling with some bloody combat. You'll face various different horrors as you explore the underground labyrinth of dark and mysterious experiments.

The Down Below features 4 distinctly interesting levels to explore, each with their own thick atmosphere. Fight your way through over 10 uniquely horrific enemies. Experience an immersive and interactive game world with detailed environments. There are over 30 items you can interact with such as ammo, food, and explosives you can find to continue exploring deeper, as well as plenty of physics based props that can be picked up and moved.

With your wits and your trusty lever action shotgun, uncover the mystery of the missing mercenaries and the grotesque experiments of a research team gone rogue.

EPIC FANTASY BATTLES
Command valiant warriors and vicious demons in BattleLore: Command, based on the board game BattleLore Second Edition. Lead the noble Daqan army as they fearlessly defend their homeland from the invading hordes of the Uthuk Y’llan– demon-blooded barbarians spreading chaos and destruction wherever they go. Or, lead the Uthuk Y’llan and channel their fury into military supremacy.

PREPARE FOR WAR: Muster armies suited to the mission at hand and support your strengths as a commander. Deploy them strategically and order them unit by unit.

WIELD ARCANE POWERS: Lore powers give each army unique tactical and magical advantages you can use to surprise the enemy and turn the tide of battle.

FIGHT A HEROIC CAMPAIGN: Take charge of the Daqan army in a multi-mission single-player campaign to vanquish the Uthuk Y’llan and save Terrinoth.

MULTIPLAYER: Choose from multiple battlefields and game modes and play either the Daqan Lords or Uthuk Y’llan in battles against a friend or the computer in multiplayer.

EXPAND YOUR GAME: Purchase the all-new LOCUST expansion to add even more units and battlefields to your game!

What is the truth? The heretics open the gate to the Other-world, and the dissimilated come to this land. The catastrophe caught people in ruins off guard. They were either imprisoned to death, or enslaved as a host. Sedley became the land of rampant dissimilated monsters.
Unknown horror invades this dangerous deadland in darkness. As a person who is trapped here, who are you going to do?

1. There are a variety of roguelike-like elements.
2. Maps and monsters procedurally generates in random.
3. Different weapons and equipment have various weapon skills.
4. Each characters has their own unique story and class ability.
5. Diversified general perks and perk materials work on all characters.
6. Different kinds of Mark of Hollow has various effects.
7. Specific items bring novel battle experience.
8. Sanity system increases gaming difficulty.
9. Local dual-player model with difficult challenges, testing operational and cooperative ability

about_the_game:
After years of scorching heat, an incoming frost is on the horizon, putting half the planet into another Ice Age. Most of the land has been taken over by ice, which forced many cities to relocate. The mining industry has been severely impacted by the lack of space. With demand for more mining on the rise, you set out for the arctic to start your mining industry.



Your goal is to build a colony of workers to mine resources and manufacture parts while surviving the harsh climate. Research new technologies, build up your industry and survive with limited resources.



In Death By FrostByte, it’s a constant arms race between you and mother nature. Build up an array of heaters and wind diverting walls to combat windshield. Research better tech while expanding a successful mining company. Throughout this journey, you will need to manage:

  • Temperature & Other Weather Elements
  • Workers
  • Food Production
  • Power and Water Systems
  • Currency
  • Contracts
  • Research
  • And More!

Are you up to the challenge? Or will your company fall to the frost?



As Death By FrostByte is currently in Early Access, here is a list of all the major mechanics and features already added to the game.

  • Fog of War / Exploration - You will be given a drone to use to explore the map for resources. Uncover the fog to expand your starting area and grow your industry.
  • Game Challenges - Challenge yourself by picking up to 5 different challenges.
  • Objectives - Complete all 13 main objectives.
  • Weather & Snow Storms - Make sure your base doesn't freeze over with the help of heaters, Unfreezing Crews and wind mitigation.
  • Crafting - Craft components and Buildings to expand your industry.
  • Market - Buy and Sell items when needed
  • Utilities - Build up and maintain your Water & Power Grids.
  • Laboratory - Research and Upgrade new tech for better items and better quality of life.
  • Shift Management - Assign workers to either day or night shifts
  • Workers Skills - Speed up production with higher level workers
  • Contracts - Complete Contracts to earn currency and gain reputation
  • Automation & Mining Resources
  • And More!



Death By FrostByte will have many new mechanics and features added throughout Early Access. Here is a list of new content that we will be adding next to the game.
The list of future content may change during Early Access. They are to provide you an idea of the future roadmap of this game.

  • Lore / Story
  • Expand on late game items (power production, heaters, walls, etc)
  • Expand on Automation (providing longer links, improving on the existing system)
  • Quality of Life Improvements / Polishing
  • And More!

about_the_game:
The Seven Enchantments

The Seven Enchantments is a first-person psychological horror game set in the village of Pradonin, a forgotten place deep in 1800s Eastern Europe where religion, folklore, and sin intertwine. You are Józef, a fraudulent exorcist sent to help, only to realize something real and terrifying awaits. What begins as a simple con spirals into a psychological descent as you uncover the dark truth behind seven cursed villagers, each consumed by one of the seven deadly sins.

A Dark, Twisting Story

Some revel in sin. Others suffer from it. But all who give in are changed, twisted, and cursed. As Józef, uncover the intertwined stories of the villagers of Pradonin—their secrets, their sins, and their fates.
Why did this village fall? Who is truly behind the evil lurking here?
As you search the shadows… some may begin to look back.

Seven Characters, Seven Fates

Each villager you investigate represents a deadly sin. Explore their homes, trace their memories, and uncover clues. The truth might not be what you imagined, but Józef must face it all.

Secrets Hidden in Every Corner

In this world, stories are buried under rocks, behind doors, or in the quiet hum of the forest. But are you ready to discover how this story ends?

Gameplay & Features

  • Explore a cursed village: Every house, shrine, and shadow holds a secret tied to one of the seven deadly sins. Navigate dense forests, decaying huts, and sacred ritual sites.

  • Day/Night cycle gameplay:

    • By day, gather resources like candles, ritual tools, and scent-based stealth items.

    • By night, survive the hunt. The Leshy, a deadly creature from Slavic folklore, stalks you. Sound and light are your enemies—or your only hope.

  • Investigative horror: Find journals, ritual objects, and subtle environmental clues that piece together each villager’s story and reveal the curse at the heart of Pradonin.

  • Puzzle-based storytelling: Ritual circles, grotesque remnants, and ancient relics are keys to solving the mystery. Your curiosity may be your salvation—or your undoing.

  • Environmental storytelling & puzzles: Ritual sites, cursed relics, and grotesque scenes slowly reveal the truth—if you’re willing to look closely.

about_the_game:
◆Story


Four or five o'clock in a bar.
A man puts his hand on my shoulder and digs into my pocket, while his other hand picks up the broken gold from the table and puts it in his own pocket.
"Come with me, it's quite a lot of money after all ...... huh... I can get you something extra."
He opened the door in front of him, and at the door ...... was a cat demon girl.



"In this world, although the demon is rare, but the matter of buying and selling them is already strange, I'm not easy to get one, although the bloodline is not very pure ...... but this appearance as you can see, the top quality goods!"
The man lowered his voice and leaned close to my ear...
"I'm sure your dead friend would have accepted it..."
I tugged at the man's collar and pushed him aside, wondering what he meant by that, while the cat-demon girl on the floor gave me a frightened look ......

"She's been on a hunger strike since she came to me, and I'm afraid she won't live much longer if she continues like this, so ...... apart from trying to earn some more... by giving it to you, I'm also doing a good deed.
"No matter what happens, I'm your saviour too, loosen your hand and take her back, you won't regret it and I believe in you as a person.
"Hey, he's your master now, go back with him."



The young girl mumbled ...... the word master ......
In the end, I took the young girl back to the residence...
"If you are willing to trust me, I will be your ...... master from now on, and you won't have to hurt yourself so much by going on hunger strike. "
"Master ...... man ......"

In the days that followed, I continued to live my life as a postman ...... except that there was another cat demon girl with me.
And this cat demon girl, her name is Suzu, is a ...... girl I will never forget.

◆How to play


The game is mainly a simulation of the type of gameplay by selecting certain 【Interaction】 to drive the time and certain values to trigger the event!
【Interaction】 can be performed several times a day.
【Interaction】 includes 【Talking】 【Working】 【Going out】 【H】 【Dressing up】 and so on.



There are also many H and non-H events that can be unlocked with certain actions.
In addition, 【H】 has many costume differences and poses.



【Work】 There is a special time mechanism.
【Interaction】 There is a function to give and use certain items.
【Dress up】 You can change your clothes and expression in some CG.

◆Game features


◇23 basic CGs, CG difference 250+.
◇The game text is 90,000+.
◇Drama oriented game
◇Game ending: 3 types
◇Medieval timeline style gameplay

about_the_game:
"Students of Psionic Power" (Original title in Japanese : "心の力の生徒達" [Kokoro no chikara no seito tachi]) is RPG based typing game.

This game is single-key based Alphabet typing, and focuses to aquire or master the touch typing method.

  • If you would like to type words or sentences, please check "Students of Light Bonds - Typing RPG with Character Creation -" which is another typing game in this series.

----
[About English support]
Currently, except Tutorial stage, story texts (such as narrator's texts, conversations, etc. in message window) are not translated, still remain in Japanese.
But, other texts (such as UI texts, explanation texts for game system & mechanizm, etc.) are already supported.
This is the reason why 'Subtitles' in 'Languages' is not checked in English.
----



[Rules]
- You can deal damage to enemy when you can type random specified alphabet key.
- You will get damage from enemy when you mistook or could not type specified key for long time.
- You cannot defeat enemy if you could not deal enough damage within time limit.

Changing party member's name


You can input each party member's name with your keyboard, or copy and paste (Ctrl + V).



You can use around 7500 characters for member's name. (Including Latin alphabets, Greek alphabets, Russian alphabets, symbols, Japanese Hiragana/Katakana/Kanji characters defined in JIS X 0208 character set)

Changing party member's portrait


You can choose each party member's portrait from 20 portraits (10 school boys and 10 school girls).



In this game, all of your party members are young students.
All of your party members can use PSI (such as psionic power) ability.

Astral monsters have suddenly appeared in a city in Japan.
You need to defeat all astral monsters to save our peace.

Let's create your party members to defeat all enemies from our city!
Ofcourse, it could be included yourself in your party.

Covers from typing newbee to typing specialist


You can use keyboard guide when you are fighting with mob monsters.
So, this game is applicable for training touch typing.



- In early levels in game, the random range of alphabet key is narrower. So, typing newbee can play this game.
- For typing specialist, you can choose difficulty named "HARDEST" and "INFERNO", but you might not be able to clear these difficulties if you have not acquired touch typing.

Equipment, Alchemy with enchanting.


You can acquire equipment items named "Psycho Stones".
You can forge each Psycho Stone in Alchemy menu.



You can also enchant special abilities to your Psycho Stones.
Once forged and enchanted your Psycho Stones, you can defeat "HARDEST"'s and "INFERNO"'s enemies easily even if your typing skill is "EASY" class.

Score attack for well-leveled players


Once you cleared all levels in story, and forged, enchanted Psycho Stones perfectly, let's try the special level for score attack.



You need to continue to type alphabets until time limit even if enemy HP has reached to zero.

If you have "INFERNO" class typing skill with perfectly forged and enchanted Psycho Stones, you will be able to deal several ten million total damage!

about_the_game:
Trapped between the walls of your family home and the trenches of World War I, you try to piece together your past and take back control of your life.

BREAK THE CYCLE


Will the nightmare of the war ever end? Will you find inner peace one day? In Ad Infinitum, you play as a German soldier haunted by the horrors of the Great War. While your mind grapples with memories of your family home and the trenches on the front, you try to break the endless cycle of suffering.

BETWEEN A DREAM AND REALITY


You wake up in your bedroom, unchanged from your teenage years, in a run-down and deserted manor house. Suddenly and inexplicably, you are transported to the trenches where the horrors of war are overshadowed by vile and even more terrifying creatures. Unable to distinguish between reality and nightmare, you must fight to regain control of your life's narrative.

NIGHTMARES THAT BECOME REAL


Unspeakable nightmares come to life in the recesses of your mind. To escape the death traps and terrifying creatures, you must understand the source and motivation of each monster and solve the puzzles that stand in your way. From blind demons who can hear your softest footsteps to hideous disjointed puppets who move in the dark, horror is around every corner.

A FAMILY TORN APART


The fallout of the war is felt far from the front. Peel back the shroud that hides the secrets of your family, torn apart by the Great War, and try to remember your past. Through exploration and by solving riddles and puzzles between the walls of your home and the barbed wire of No Man’s Land, you ultimately reveal a chapter in the story of a German family torn apart by war.

about_the_game:
🚒 The Game

You’re not a firefighter, but you’ve always wanted to experience the intensity of a real emergency medical response?
Pompiers Simulator puts you in the shoes of a first responder, right in the heart of rescue missions, in a simulation created by actual firefighters.

No random gestures or unrealistic mechanics here: every action is based on the real-life protocols used by French firefighters in the field.

Take charge of victims, assess their condition, perform the right actions at the right time, and manage your action points to be as efficient as possible.
At the end of each mission, the game offers a detailed debriefing to help you improve your reflexes and deepen your knowledge.

Pompiers Simulator is mostly played using the mouse to interract with pictures. Through a clear and intuitive interface, you can talk with the victim, perform assessments, track vital signs, and of course carry out life-saving procedures—just like firefighters do every day.

TALK TO THE VICTIM

When the victim is conscious, you can ask them questions. These interactions help you understand what happened, identify possible pain, discomfort, or symptoms, and tailor your response.
Choosing the right questions allows you to complete a more accurate assessment, guide your actions, and avoid wasting valuable time or action points.

PATIENT ASSESSMENT

Measure the victim’s vital signs to evaluate their condition. Adapt your assessment based on your observations and stay alert for warning signs of life-threatening emergencies.
Your ability to interpret these indicators will be essential to prioritize your actions, make the right decisions, and operate efficiently in the field.

LIFE-SAVING ACTIONS

Perform the most appropriate rescue gestures for the situation—every action counts.
Learn to prioritize emergencies, manage your action points strategically, and ensure the victim is treated in the best possible conditions, while avoiding unnecessary or ineffective actions.

Immersive Simulation

Follow precise and realistic emergency protocols, and experience cardiopulmonary resuscitation as close to real life as possible.

Adventure Mode

Learn every step of first aid, progress from level to level to improve your skills and knowledge, face increasingly complex situations, and complete a variety of rescue missions.

🔥 Key Features

  • Realistic interventions based on real-world emergency care protocols used by firefighters on the field.

about_the_game:
There exists a library where books rest without words. Instead, those who read these books see what the authors themselves imagined. It is within this Great Library that the protagonist, Felix, makes a deal with the reaper Shifa: if he can show her the difference between romance in the worlds of fiction she's lived through, and how romance plays out in reality, she'll allow him to add a single book to the Library's collection.

With a newfound hope, Felix accepts the deal so that he can add a single book to the library: the diary of his late girlfriend.

Will he move on and find a new partner, or will he find the ending he's always wanted for himself?

The choice will be yours as you explore the lives of students at Lilia Matsumoto University to satisfy the reaper watching over your life, all so you can find true love! Though, that's only if you make the best choices, and being able to trade your lifespan for all the knowledge in the universe might not be the best idea...

In Once More, you'll be able to foster relationships and maybe fall in love (or out of love!) depending on how you interact with the characters. Unfortunately, love takes work, and Felix is going to have to prove his love is true if he wants to reclaim the happiness he once lost.

Characters




You'll be wearing the shoes of Felix, our unlucky protagonist who has made a deal with death itself. Whether or not he's able to move on and reclaim the happiness he once held is entirely up to you, so please take good care of him. His personality is very subdued, but if you can help him meet the right people he may just find himself again.



Shifa is a reaper who works in the Great Library, where she categorizes every text written throughout history. Her tendency to act like the main character of the last book she read comes from her current dilemma of being unable to tell fiction from reality, the former of which is her only understanding of Felix's world.



Mima used to be Felix's girlfriend, but a great tragedy separated them. In order to reclaim the future he never got to have with her, Felix has decided to make a deal with the reaper Shifa in order to one day see her again should he be unable to move on. She was the type of girl who was always smiling, and had a big impact on Felix's life.



Yuria grew up playing piano and has a tendency to push others away when they try to get close to her. Even though she's not easy to get along with at first, hidden underneath her ice cold exterior is an incredibly caring girl. Though depending on who you ask, she's less of an icy queen and more of an awkward girl.



Cami is a film student and is a super upbeat girl who's always willing to help others if she's able to. Her passion for film is what motivates her as she sets out to find her own goals in life, even if hindered by her past ones. She seems to shine when she's in front of the camera, but for some reason she prefers to stay behind it.



Nia is the childhood friend of Felix and has a passion for making games. While she tends to make jokes at Felix's expense, she does have a serious side to her that comes out when she's passionate about something, or someone. Her current AI project has her overextended, perhaps you can lend her a hand?

Features


- High Quality Character Art, Backgrounds, GUI, and CGs
- Original OST composed by some of the best contemporary artists
- Multiple endings, with impactful choices
- Professional Voice Acting
- Extra features like a Music Room, CG and Background Viewers, and Scene Jumping
- A story-rich experience

about_the_game:
Space Colony Alert Bulletin!

The Necromonads are at it again!! Colonists must in a orderly fashion proceed to the nearest shelter while the highly trained star pilot provides cover. Inspired by classic arcade shooters but with a twist. Captured colonists become infected and spread it to others. stop the Necromonads infection invasion now!

Features


  • Blistering Arcade Action
  • Keyboard or Joystick Control
  • Lasers, and yes that's right, Bombs!
  • Multiple Enemy types
  • Steam Leaderboards & Steam Achievements
  • Space Zombies

Gameplay


Each level of Necromonads consists of a number of Colonists and Infection shelters that the colonists try to run to. The Necromonads will attempt to capture and infect the fleeing colonists. To accomplish this they upduct them as the flee and bring them to the top of the screen. Once to the top of the screen the colonist becomes infected and dropped back down them.

Once infected they spit virus bile to nearby colonists causing the infection to spread. Your job as Star Pilot is to stop the Necros long enough for the colonists to get to the shelters, Moving to the next level occurs when all colonists are accounted for and more then 50% of the remaining colonists are safe in the shelter. The Necros will send various different forms after you to stop you as you progress.

Tips


Bombs can change Colonists Direction
Necros are not affected by Crystal Barriers
Crystal Barriers can be helpful

about_the_game:
Let's Beer together: Co-op Tavern Owner simulator

Welcome to your medieval adventure! As a tavern owner in a fantastical world, you’ll brew beverages, cook meals, manage resources, and fend off marauders hired by envious competitors. Invite your friends to join you and work at the tavern, creating a lively and collaborative experience.

About Game

Your goal? To rise as the top tavern in town by achieving a 5-star rating. The rating is influenced by customer satisfaction. It's not just humans you'll be serving—fantasy creatures like orks, dwarfs, and elves are also frequent visitors of your establishment, each with their own satisfaction indicator. Factors such as the tavern's temperature, service speed, and quality directly impact customer satisfaction. Yet, your path to success is filled with challenges. Competitors will try to thwart your progress by sending marauders to attack your tavern. It's up to you to defend your property and maintain your tavern's reputation.

Quotes

"It is Absolutely Insane!" - Hakim, CEO of BlackBox

"Oh My God!" - Tima, Visual lead Tasked

"Anything for Doner" - Amirkhan, 3D artist

Key Features

Realistic Tavern Management

Craft and Serve Drinks: Perfect your drink-pouring skills and prepare a variety of dishes to delight your customers.

Atmosphere Control: Keep your tavern warm and inviting with a cozy fireplace and by performing as a bard.

Upgrade Your Tavern: Expand and improve your tavern with additional rooms, unique decorations, and new facilities.

Defend Your Tavern: Protect your establishment from marauder attacks and pacify upset customers who might also cause trouble.

Repair and Maintain: Watch out for your furniture as enemies may try to destroy it.

Financial Management: Keep a close eye on your budget since many tavern activities come with a price. While you'll earn money from serving customers, the most significant expense will be reviving yourself or your team members.

Customer Satisfaction System

Keep Customers Happy: Monitor how satisfied your customers are and adjust your approach to improve your ratings. Unhappy customers can be more of a headache than marauders!

Boost Your Ratings: The higher your ratings, the more customers you'll attract, helping your business thrive.

Personalized Service: Serve the right food to the right customers—elves love wine, while orcs crave meat.

Team Play Mechanics

Team Up: Play on your own or join forces with up to 4 players. Only the tavern owner needs to have the game, so friends can join in the fun without needing their own copies.

Synergy: Collaborate with your team to cover all essential roles in the tavern, from waiting tables to acting as the security guard, ensuring smooth and efficient operation.

Your Tavern, Your Way: Whether you choose to specialize in serving the perfect beer or expand into an entertainment venue with a performer, security, an enhanced kitchen for cooking, and various activities for your team members, the choice is yours.

about_the_game:
The classic of arcades has returned!

The classic of arcades has returned, and better than ever!
Solo or with friends, in TETRUX: Online you can play in a wide variety of modes.

Experiment all the Possibilities

TETRUX: Online offers a wide variety of optional tweaks to the gameplay, which are sorted into several groups:

  • Gamemode: change the objective of the game.
  • Piecesets: change the pieces you play with, from the classic pieces seven we all know and love to pure madness.
  • Power-Ups: special blocks that do stuff when eliminated.
  • Starting Speed: change the starting speed; from 1X to 100X. Also includes Infinite Speed and Constant 0X.
  • Battles: to spice thing up in multiplayer. Basically, when you clear lines you make another player's life more difficult.
  • Garbage: just like Battle, but for single-player. Life will periodically get harder as garbage lines pour from the sky.
  • Moving Pieces: when a piece is locked, the entire grid will move depending on the settings.
  • Play with friends: TETRUX supports local multiplayer with up to 6 players and online play with up to 17. You can even play online with multiple local players at the same time!
  • And many more, that don't fall into these categories, including Hidden Pieces, Rotation modifiers and Hold Modifiers.

Credits

Music made by Neocrey Studios

about_the_game:
An adventurer pulled out a roll of paper from under his garments. That was the map that a man in the tavern gave him. The map depicted the castle, and among its rooms, the path to the treasury was marked. They say that the treasury contains a lot of jewels and gold, but the most valuable of them is a diamond. They also say that it is the largest diamond in Dorgan, and maybe even in the entire world! Someone even said that for this precious stone one can buy a small castle, and for the rest of the money — be fairly well-to-do until the end of their days. It was these stories that led the hero to the mysterious castle. You may ask, who is this adventurer? They call him Swordbreaker!

The story of the game tells about the adventures of the Swordbreaker, full of blood and mystery, before his appearance at the mysterious castle. The hero has to go through many trials before he finds what he came for, that is, if the luck is on his side.
Swordbreaker will have to destroy hordes of enemies and solve a lot of puzzles to make his way to the castle. Upgrade Swordbreaker’s skills, find unique weapons and armor. And most importantly — move toward your goal!



- Dynamic battles in the vast areas of Dorgan
- Mysterious locations full of enemies and secrets
- Character upgrade system
- RPG elements — change weapons, armor, and spells
- Dynamic change of music depending on Swordbreaker’s karma
- Survival mode

about_the_game:
Our heroine awakes to find herself in an unfamiliar land. She has no memories at all, not even knowing her own name.

To make matters worse, the first person she meets is out to kill her.

Our heroine runs for her life through the unknown streets, only to run headfirst into another stranger. Fortunately for her, this man is the don of the mafia famiglia Oz. With no love for would-be murderers of innocent women, he drives off her attacker and takes her underneath his famiglia’s wing.

This is hardly the end of her troubles, however. Famiglia Oz is but one of many different mafia famiglie in town, and bitter conflicts for territory rage eternally between them all. Only on Sundays does peace return to the town by a mutual compromise, and come the next day the battles continue anew as if they had never ceased.

It is in this war-torn town that our rootless heroine must find her way. Who amongst the mafias simply seeks to use her for their own ends, and who can she truly come to trust... and even love?

about_the_game:
Cooking Live combines elements of business, time management and cooking games. Progress through the plot step by step and unlock new themed cafe shops and beautiful locations. Whether it's a pizzeria, bakery, or diner, every chef has their own unique taste and their own recipes and stories. Show off your cooking skills and help save every cozy restaurant from the hands of soulless corporations! In this game, you will be traveling around the world in an attempt to revive the failing restaurant business.

Be ready to discover stories and help people make their dreams come true. Each episode develops its own unique story. Here are some of them:

Episode 1. Good Morning!

Good Morning is a cozy restaurant in Amsterdam. The owner, Leah, had gotten tired of her monotonous job at a bank. One day, she decides to change her life and rents an empty building to create a sunny restaurant. But the new work feels too hard, and Leah is about to give up and turn over the location to a fast-food chain. Jane and her cooking show are the last hope to save the restaurant and make Leah’s dream come true!

Episode 3. Get Cool
Get Cool is a retro drive-in cafe in Atlanta, USA. After college, a happily married couple returns to the city of their childhood to buy a drive-in cafe and breathe new life into the place where they met. But nothing goes as planned, and the once-happy couple is facing a relationship crisis. A junk-food company is ready to buy the place for a song. Jane is there to turn things around and make the drive-in cafe more popular than ever before, so the couple can work together and be happy again.


Episode 5. Shell

Shell is a seafood restaurant in Tokyo, Japan. Kaito hears about the sale of an old aquarium complex, and he and his wife Asami decide to buy it. Kaito’s dream is to make a restaurant where Asami can put her many years of experience as a restaurateur and culinary ideas to use. But things get complicated when they are forced to sell their house to pay their bills. Desperate for help, Kaito asks Jane to come, hoping she might make a difference.


We are currently working on:

New episodes:
- Detective Story
New characters for each new episode and their unique stories.
The beginning of Jane and Mike’s story and his betrayal.

about_the_game:
The full release of All in Abyss: Judge the Fake is now available, with refined balance, skills, and systems.
This evolution offers an even more exhilarating poker battle experience with sharper gameplay and a heightened sense of challenge.


【Jan 21 2025 Demo Version Update!】
・Poker battle - skill system reworked
・New mode "Poker Royale"
・Opened "club ALL OUT"


…Bet your all, may victory be yours.

In this game, you adventure to become a successful gambler by challenging others at the game of Texas Hold‘em Poker.

Use various skills to achieve victory in poker, expose the hands of the witches, All-in to steal their winnings, and become the ruler of the gambling district.

ーーーーー

Poker Battles

An "anything goes" Texas Hold'em style 1v1 poker-like card game.
Become victorious by reducing the enemy chips to 0.

  • ACTIVATE SKILLS

The “gambling prodigy” Asuha is capable of turning the tides of battle using various skills, sourcing from her aptitude in gambling.
Limit the opponent’s play, gain insight beyond their hand, and much more… stay victorious with skills that expand the pool of decision-making.

  • ALL-IN

“All-In” is a command that puts all chips on the table and your life as a gambler on the line.
Use various means to put yourself in a favorable position, and use this command to slam the final nail in the coffin.

Showdown vs The Witches

A “Witch” is a Boss Character present in each chapter of the game.
All Witches excel at poker, but with enough preparation, the player can expose the Witches’ fraudulent acts and sink them to the depths of hell with a deadly All-In.

  • THE CITY

The scene is set in The City, where various information can be gathered.
Find sources to help unveil the secrets behind the Witches’ cheats and frauds to achieve sweet vengeance.
Additionally, you can hustle the gamblers around town to rake in quick cash, or go on a winning streak in “Poker Royale”—which rewards you after achieving a set number of victories—to earn the points needed for acquiring new skills and to obtain rare items, thereby increasing your standing as a gambler.

The only appropriate sequel to cashing out, is to spend big.
Your earnings can be spent deservingly at "club ALL OUT" to party your heart out.
Should you catch lady luck's eye, you will be treated to bonus luck for your next battle.

  • EXPOSE THE WITCHES’ HAND

Your finesse in poker may earn you some cash in The City, but the Witches - who rule the districts, will not allow for a fair victory. Their methods of cheating seems to be fool-proof, but the evidence you uncover will say otherwise.

Explore every inch of the city and expose the cheaters of their tricks.

STORY

Asuha Senahara, a self-proclaimed genius gambler, is a wanderer.
Amidst the tables of cards and dice, it is she alone who snatches the chips at stake.
One day, she learns of the gambling district “the city”, a special ward where gambling holds influence above all else.
In this city run by the strongest gamblers known as the “Witches”, Asuha experiences the first defeat in her life.
They exercised not luck, not skill, but dirty tricks, such that felled Asuha to the depths of the abyss.
As a self-proclaimed genius gambler, Asuha becomes determined to take down the Witches.
The Coliseum is the battlefield. The challenger is Asuha Senahara. The chips are on the table, and the Witches are ready to be exposed.

Characters

  • Asuha Senahara

Self-proclaimed genius gambler. A failure of a human being, but has a strong resolve and is determined when it comes to gambling. A pretty young lady on the cover, a middle-aged old man on the inside.

  • Mina

A girl who saved Asuha after her defeat against the witch.

  • Ulu

The First Witch. Uses her mysterious powers to easily defeat Asuha.
Loves snacks and sweets.

Credits

Planning & Development ACQUIRE (developers of “Octopath Traveler”)
Scenario Shusei Sakagami (Scenario of “Heaven Burns Red”)
Art 藤田川晴昭
BGM　Feryquitous
Production WSS Playground (Planning & Production of “NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD”)

about_the_game:
STELA BOSS is a roguelike that combines intense action and strategic exploration in a dark, mysterious world. Use unique elemental weapons to defeat enemies and clear the island infested with dangers in each cycle.

FIGHT TO DEFEAT THE BOSSES Face hordes of enemies and imposing bosses as you explore a macabre island. Each battle is an opportunity to grow stronger and get closer to victory.

DISCOVER OVER 200 WEAPON COMBINATIONS With more than 200 possible combinations of weapons and abilities, each cycle brings new challenges and strategic possibilities. Defeat bosses at the end of the island and clear the entire territory.

GROW STRONGER WITH EACH CYCLE Even in defeat, there is progress. Each time you face and defeat bosses, you become more powerful, unlocking abilities for future challenges. This is your journey to overcome the island’s shadows.

A UNIQUE PRESENTATION Immersive and engaging, STELA BOSS features a dark setting, an electrifying soundtrack and refined gameplay, all to bring a macabre island full of secrets to life.

about_the_game:
“The flying kettle powered by tea fuel is the future of humanity.”

Space Kettle is a challenging game where your main and only task is to reach the top of a surreal mountain using the power of the recently developed “Tea engine”. Select the direction of flight, hold the left mouse button, and start conquering new heights. Remember: despite the fact that the tea fuel is constantly replenished, its amount is limited, so use your opportunities wisely. Otherwise, you will feel the bitterness of falling down and constant loss of progress, as well as utter hopelessness. The game is made in the “Over It” genre, which became popular after the release of “Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy” back in 2017.



  • Challenge yourself to reach the top of the unyielding mountain.
  • Journey through the unique map with different locations.
  • Prepare your mental health for constant falls.
  • Fall over and over again, losing all your hope.
  • Accept your fate or keep struggling.
  • And finally, feel like a real Flying Kettle.

about_the_game:
Project Solar is an open-world puzzle adventure game with online and couch co-op, where you and a friend play as R.A.Y, a robot with a damaged memory core, and P.I.P, a small but resourceful drone. Set in a vibrant solar punk world, you’ll navigate through lush, green environments filled with remnants of advanced technology that harmonize with nature.

The game focuses on solving intricate puzzles scattered throughout the world, which will help you uncover important information about your surroundings and the events that have shaped this unique landscape. As R.A.Y and P.I.P, you'll explore an expansive, open world that encourages curiosity and discovery. Every corner holds a new challenge, from complex Sokoban-style puzzles to other brain-teasing tasks that will require both logic and creativity.

Cooperation is key—some puzzles can only be solved by R.A.Y’s strength and physical interactions, while others rely on P.I.P’s agility and ability to manipulate electronic devices. Whether playing solo or with a friend, you’ll need to work together to overcome obstacles and unlock the secrets of this beautifully crafted solar punk world.

Gameplay

Project Solar is our first title, an open-world puzzle adventure game designed exclusively for online and couch co-op. You and a friend take on the roles of R.A.Y, a robot with a damaged memory core, and P.I.P, a resourceful drone. Together, your mission is to explore a vast and intriguing solar punk world, solving puzzles, uncovering secrets, and piecing together the history of a forgotten civilization.

The gameplay revolves around cooperative puzzle-solving, featuring challenges like Sokoban-style mechanics that require teamwork, strategic thinking, and careful planning. These puzzles gradually increase in complexity, encouraging creative problem-solving and collaboration. Beyond Sokoban puzzles, you'll encounter a variety of intricate challenges that take full advantage of R.A.Y’s physical abilities and P.I.P’s agility and electronic manipulation skills.

Exploration is just as important as puzzle-solving. You and your partner will navigate diverse environments, discovering hidden paths, secret locations, and collectible Data Entries. These scattered pieces of information reveal more about the world and provide extra depth for those who love to explore every corner.

With its blend of cooperative gameplay, immersive exploration, and engaging puzzle design, Project Solar offers a unique and rewarding experience where teamwork is the key to unlocking the mysteries of a beautifully crafted solar punk world.

Imperial Playgrounds

At Imperial Playgrounds, a Sweden-based studio located in the vibrant city of Gothenburg, our core values are creativity, community, and inclusivity. We are driven by a passion for crafting immersive and engaging gaming experiences that not only entertain but also inspire and connect players from all walks of life. Our mission is to foster a collaborative environment where players are not just consumers but integral participants in the creation process.

Project Solar is our first release, and it embodies our commitment to this vision. From the initial concept, we have invited our community to join us on this journey, sharing ideas, providing feedback, and becoming a part of the creative process. By including our players in the development of Project Solar, we ensure that the game reflects the diverse perspectives and desires of our audience, resulting in a richer, more authentic gaming experience that resonates with everyone who plays it.
