about_the_game:
What is A Place in the West?

Half-Life: A Place in the West is a fan-made comic book set within Valve's acclaimed Half-Life universe. It can be read either by way of our specially built app, or as a PDF available in your Steam Directory.

At a science complex in the New Mexico desert, a teleportation experiment goes very wrong, unleashing interdimensional chaos on an unsuspecting Earth. The aftershocks end with the arrival of a totalitarian order called The Combine, which forces a brutal police state on the last remnants of the occupied planet.

Now, some years later, a mysterious cosmic tower has materialised in a hidden city – a tower that may prove to be humanity’s salvation, or its doom. A team of military commandos soon emerge from the city, sweeping across the American wasteland kidnapping children for an unknown purpose.



In the wake of their devastation, a troubled father, an intrepid scientist, and an ancient alien warrior are each drawn to the strange city with the cosmic tower: New Franklin. Faced with warring clans, diabolical experiments, portentous dreamscapes, and the growing shadow of The Combine, they must unlock New Franklin’s mysteries before it’s too late – and the lives of everyone in the city hang in the balance.

A Place in the West weaves a compelling story with a complex cast of all-new characters, drawing on the rich mythology of the Half-Life universe to create an original adventure for the series.

The comic will run for a total of fifteen chapters, the first of which, Following Portents, is available for free to download and comes to a total of 32 pages. The remaining chapters will be released sequentially as paid-DLC, and will be 30 pages in length.

Do I need to be Familiar with Half-Life?

Nope! The first chapter features a ten-page prologue designed to bring new readers up to speed with the world of Half-Life. A Place in the West is also set in the interim between Half-Life and Half-Life 2, which means that you needn't be familiar with Valve's later games anyway. That isn't to say, however, that you won't find exciting things to enjoy if you are familiar with the series.

The comic is also available in PDF form; simply purchase the comic, and a copy will be automatically downloaded into your Steam files. This will enable you to read A Place in the West in whatever format you see fit: be it via our app, or as a PDF on your mobile device.

Follow us for more updates!

Achievements are included in the first and second chapters only. The second chapter is paid-DLC. Future chapters will not feature achievements.

Toz is a falling-sand game with modern graphics and a large selection of elements, lots and lots of brush types and an abundance of special effects. about_the_game:
One frightening truth.

Welcome to the remote French village of Rennes-le-Château. Gabriel and Grace arrive in this town in pursuit of a kidnapped child, but a deeper, far more frightening story begins to unfold. Whispers of a sacred bloodline, vampires and a boundless treasure set the shadow hunter and his companion on an inescapable path. Their ultimate destiny is to solve a dark mystery held secret for thousands of years.

Play as both Gabriel Knight and Grace Nakimura as you learn more about what is hidden in the hills of France. But beware your life, your faith and your soul. For once the truth is found, there is no erasing it.

  • Encounter intricate puzzles critical to solving this ancient mystery.
  • Find, acquire (and steal) a vast inventory of clues, tools, cash and more - using your clever and devious sleuthing skills.
  • Interact with an eclectic cast of characters - each with their own agenda. Who can you believe?

about_the_game:
Daomei Village: Prologue


The Prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game.



The Prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game.


Daomei Village: Prologue is a charming, pixel art game set in a quaint environment that stimulates creativity!


By order of the Emperor, you have been transferred to Daomei Village and tasked with restoring it to its splendor. Remember that nothing will escape the attention of the tax collector, who will demand the tributes claimable by the Emperor. Therefore, you have to take care of the farm, cultivate the fields, and breed the animals to generate income. It won't be easy at first, as you will only have a few simple tools, 100 yuan, some rice seeds, and some tea. However, don't give up! An amazing adventure awaits you. You will meet friends who, like you, were sent to the Unlucky Village for their crimes.




Changes in the seasons affect the possibility of growing vegetables and flowers. Each species of animal requires a dedicated space. Go ahead, create the place of your dreams - fields, buildings, surroundings. You can create and improve it all. Introduce crop automation technology and beautify the area.




Activities for the Village will bring you happiness and recognition. The reassured Emperor will allow you to go to the lands of the enemies occupied by the imperial army. Thanks to this, you will obtain information about new technologies, as well as get new raw materials, tools and seeds. The more difficult the terrain, the greater the chance of unique achievements.However, the risk of a fight also increases. Everything you get during the expeditions is yours and can be used to build your Village. You decide on the pace of its development. You are its leader.




In Daomei Village: Prologue, everyone has committed a crime of some sort. When interacting with the townspeople, you will receive tasks that will help you gain their trust. Moreover, you will learn the reason behind their crime.


Daomei Village: Prologue is an absolutely unique and magical place. You will come across the traces of previous dynasties, learn about the unique Chinese folklore and demonology. You will celebrate feasts accordingQ to the Chinese calendar, as well as the birthdays of the residents. You cannot miss it!

By order of the Emperor, you have been transferred to Daomei Village and tasked with restoring it to its splendor. Remember that nothing will escape the attention of the tax collector, who will demand the tributes claimable by the Emperor. Therefore, you have to take care of the farm, cultivate the fields, and breed the animals to generate income. It won't be easy at first, as you will only have a few simple tools, 100 yuan, some rice seeds, and some tea. However, don't give up! An amazing adventure awaits you. You will meet friends who, like you, were sent to the Unlucky Village for their crimes.




Changes in the seasons affect the possibility of growing vegetables and flowers. Each species of animal requires a dedicated space. Go ahead, create the place of your dreams - fields, buildings, surroundings. You can create and improve it all. Introduce crop automation technology and beautify the area.




Activities for the Village will bring you happiness and recognition. The reassured Emperor will allow you to go to the lands of the enemies occupied by the imperial army. Thanks to this, you will obtain information about new technologies, as well as get new raw materials, tools and seeds. The more difficult the terrain, the greater the chance of unique achievements.However, the risk of a fight also increases. Everything you get during the expeditions is yours and can be used to build your Village. You decide on the pace of its development. You are its leader.




In Daomei Village: Prologue, everyone has committed a crime of some sort. When interacting with the townspeople, you will receive tasks that will help you gain their trust. Moreover, you will learn the reason behind their crime.


Daomei Village: Prologue is an absolutely unique and magical place. You will come across the traces of previous dynasties, learn about the unique Chinese folklore and demonology. You will celebrate feasts accordingQ to the Chinese calendar, as well as the birthdays of the residents. You cannot miss it!

about_the_game:
Three different stories exerting you into dark twist, forcing you to confront face to face with the creatures that lurk there.

The collection includes 3 horror games, featuring various gameplay mechanics and 3 different stories.
The tales vary from psychological horror to grotesque body horror, as well as different ways to deal with the dangers you come accross - whether it's combat, a mysterious woman's voice on a recorder, or attending several movies without any hope of escape.

Tale #1 - Theater Unrest

You walk up to a ticket booth where only one ticket is left for you to take. You hand your ticket to the ticketmaster and enter the theater to watch the featured film. However, you soon realize that this theater is not normal when you are caught in an endless loop of films and sinister beings begin to show themselves.

Inspired by the creepypasta "The Theater".
"Thank you, please enjoy the movie."
That's all you hear by giving a strange looking ticket to the ticketmaster.
His friendly voice is the only calming thing with the other creatures around in this place.
"Thank you, please enjoy the movie."
The mannequin locked in the glass box seems calm at first and the shadow figure too excited and aggressive.
"Thank you, please enjoy the movie."
Film after film, seems like you'll never escape this place.
"Thank you, please enjoy the movie."
"Thank you, please..."

Tale #2 - Balavour

When Luna makes an unexpected discovery of a flower its great beauty is quickly stained with a living nightmare.
Luna and her dog, Jasper, begin to experience unusual events as their bodies start to change and vines slowly consume their home.
First person short indie horror game, featuring body horror and a sad and creepy story.

Tale #3 - Solumcess

Standing on the edge of a building, you are on the verge of making the jump when you notice a recorder that was not present before.
By listening to the recorder, an unknown voice takes you to deeper and darker places.
Do you listen, or do you jump?
Solumcess enters you in a world of choices that always have consequences.

"Ray: Part 1" immerses players into the role of Ray, a seasoned mercenary, in a revamped rendition of the iconic 2003 Newgrounds hit. This fully voiced, updated remake delivers an enriched narrative experience with enhanced graphics, where decisions resonate throughout the story, shaping the trajectory of Ray.

Navigate through the gritty underworld of 1990s Miami, where players engage in a variety of activities, including making choices, playing minigames, and experiencing multiple endings as the consequence of your actions.

Players are tasked with not only making pivotal decisions but also managing resources such as purchasing items and paying off bribes, adding additional layers to the gameplay experience. As the narrative unfolds, players witness the far-reaching implications of their choices, ensuring that each playthrough remains engaging. "Ray: Part 1" promises to captivate both fans of the original game and newcomers alike, offering a compelling blend of nostalgia and innovation.

about_the_game:
Get ready to embark on an exciting nostalgia trip with the modernized release of Commander Keen Dreams Definitive Edition! This beloved sidescroller has been meticulously enhanced to provide a captivating gameplay experience while preserving its original charm. Let's dive into the detailed user gameplay experience and feature set:
Visual Enhancement and Widescreen Support: Commander Keen Dreams Definitive Edition has undergone a visual overhaul, embracing modern graphics while staying true to its retro roots. The introduction of full widescreen support ensures that players can fully immerse themselves in the vibrant and expanded game world.

Twelve All-New Levels: Prepare to explore a plethora of new environments and challenges with the addition of twelve brand-new levels. This doubling of content length compared to the original release guarantees hours of engaging gameplay, each level offering unique puzzles, enemies, and secrets to uncover.

Reimagined Music Score: Accompanying your adventures is a meticulously crafted full music score that dynamically evolves as you progress through the game. The reimagined soundtrack captures the essence of the original while delivering a fresh and captivating auditory experience.

Reworked Game Structure: The game structure has been thoughtfully reworked to provide a more modernized experience without sacrificing any of the original appeal. Enjoy a seamless blend of nostalgic elements and modern game design, ensuring that both veteran players and newcomers can appreciate the adventure.

Controller Compatibility: To enhance your gameplay experience, Commander Keen Dreams Definitive Edition offers full compatibility with controllers, including the highly anticipated SteamDeck. The following controller buttons are utilized:

  • Left Control Stick: Move Keen, allowing you to navigate the colorful landscapes and explore every nook and cranny.
  • B Button: Execute precise jumps and drop down from platforms that aren't solid from below when the Control Stick is pressed downward.
  • Y Button: Engage the run feature to increase Keen's speed, enabling you to swiftly traverse levels and overcome challenges.
  • ZR Button: Strategically use the seed-throwing ability to stun enemies. For versatility, you can throw seeds upward by keeping the up direction pressed on the Control Stick.
  • Plus Button: Easily pause the game to take a breather, strategize, or simply admire the beautifully reimagined world around you.
Get ready to relive the magic of Commander Keen Dreams like never before. With enhanced visuals, additional levels, a reimagined music score, and seamless controller support, Commander Keen Dreams Definitive Edition promises an unforgettable gaming experience that merges the best of both the past and the present. Embark on this nostalgic journey and embrace the exciting adventures that await!

about_the_game:
[A talented cat hides "floors and walls"]

This game is a 2D puzzle action game where you aim to clear the world in a world where the terrain changes exactly as you see it by hiding floors and walls so that they are no longer visible. In order to reach its owner, the cat, the main character, progresses through seemingly impossible stages by hiding and erasing walls and floors.

The appeal of this game is that you can change the terrain and carve your own path to the goal.

[Simple operation method]
In addition to basic movement and jumping, you will use "black boxes" to hide walls and floors to conquer the game. A "black box" appears while you click the mouse, and by hiding the terrain, it is treated as if the terrain does not exist at that location and you can pass through it. You will conquer various stages with this intuitive operation.

[Two different modes]
This game has two modes: a ``puzzle'' mode where you can have fun and have casual fun, and an ``action'' mode where you use gimmicks to reach the goal.Even with the same ``hiding floors and walls'' element, you can have different fun.

【Stage】
There are over 50 stages in total! A variety of stages await you, from easy ones to highly difficult ones to ones with a few quirks!

[Story]
The main character, a cat named ``Hyde,'' goes into an impossible labyrinth in order to find his owner who disappeared one day. She uses her research on ``the power to block out existence and make it impossible to even touch'' to advance through a labyrinth that seems impossible to conquer, with walls and doors buried.

[Distribution guidelines]

Game distribution/live commentary: OK for individuals and corporations
Spoiler: OK
Monetization: OK
Distribution platform: No particular restrictions

about_the_game:
Jump into the world of [Zlime - Return of the Demon Lord], where unbridled excitement reigns supreme! Immerse yourself in an intense and exhilarating gaming experience that action enthusiasts and roguelike fans crave. Get ready for a wild ride where every playthrough is a fresh, heart-pounding challenge!




Now, as the unlikely hero of [Zlime - Return of the Demon Lord], you embody Zenoth, the once-mighty Demon Lord. Betrayed and cursed to become a slime, he embarks on an extraordinary journey to reclaim his throne. Can he succeed? Only you can know.




Unleash the "Transform" skill. As the cursed slime, you possess the unique ability to consume defeated monsters and change into their forms. This fascinating mechanic introduces an exciting dynamic to your gameplay experience, offering a fresh take on strategy and combat.




The 'Roguelike Style' encourages you to experiment with different strategies, swiftly adapt, and evolve your approach to each encounter. Interact with random NPCs, stages, and rewards, further enriching your experience. Victory is earned through skill and perseverance.




-Tranform into monster : Devour and transform into over 50 distinct monsters, wielding their unique skills to match your preferred playstyle.
-Dynamic Challenges: Embrace the "Roguelike Style" as each playthrough offers randomized maps, treasures, and NPCs, ensuring every session is a thrilling new adventure.
-Skill upgrade: Permanently upgrade passive skills to bolster your strength for upcoming battles and face the ever-increasing challenges.
-Make Allies: Forge alliances with demon NPCs for in-game advantages, adding depth and camaraderie to your journey.

about_the_game:
"There are submarines, and then there are targets..."

They are out there, in the vast expanse of the sea. You don't see them, and you're not supposed to; they reveal themselves only reluctantly, when in port or transiting a shallow passage. They've grown from an unsuccessful, almost laughable nuisance, to a practical weapon in fleet battles, to the scourge of seaborne transport lines, and ultimately to mobile undersea fortresses that can end life on the planet in less than 10 minutes. A junior branch compared to their centuries-old naval surface warfare counterparts, submarines have nevertheless seen and done it all, both in peacetime and wartime. And it takes a special kind of people to handle and operate them - for one, claustrophobics and fragile nerves need not apply. These people often share more in common with their direct adversaries from foreign, even hostile nations than with their comrades in the other services. Like their boats, they are discreet, persistent and deadly. They are submariners. They are The Silent Service.

Undersea warfare from post-WW2 to the present: Explore the progression of submarine operations from the Korean War right up to today's headlines. Witness first-hand how technological advances like the snorkel, nuclear power, cruise and ballistic missiles, silencing measures and advanced sonars, computers and torpedoes have radically expanded both the remit and capabilities of the submarine platform - and how its hunters on the surface and in the air improved their own gear and tactics to keep up in the race.

Stars and workhorses: Take charge of some of the most famous boats and classes of the post-war period - and some that you may have never heard of. USS Nautilus, the first-ever nuclear-powered submarine - and her counterparts beyond the Iron Curtain, the November-class. HMS Swiftsure, nemesis of the Soviet Northern Fleet in '77. USS Parche, the most highly decorated vessel in the US Navy. Sturgeon-, Los Angeles- and Seawolf-class, frontline of the US sub force from the 1960s to the late-00s. Soviet/Russian conventional and nuclear-powered attack subs, worthy adversaries of NATO during the Cold War and beyond. Giants of the deep like the carrier-killer Oscar-class and the ballistic missile-toting Delta-class. And much more...

The busiest platform at sea: If you thought subs are only good for sinking ships and other subs, prepare to be amazed. Lay minefields right on the enemy's backyard with them being none the wiser. Launch carefully-plotted cruise missile attacks against defended land targets. Creep up to surface vessels close enough that you can take underwater hull and screw photos - and remain undetected. Detect and record sensitive electronic emissions, the ones that radar/comms operators dare activate only when they think nobody's around to sniff. Provide unseen escort to merchant ships in the middle of a crisis. Shower distant land targets with ballistic missiles armed with multiple nuclear warheads. Tap undersea communications cables in the worst moment of the Cold War. Covertly deliver special-operations teams ashore, or deploy swimmer delivery vehicles (SDVs) against capital ships to eliminate them out of the blue. And of course hunt down anything on the sea surface or underneath it, from miniscule patrol boats all the way to battleships, supercarriers and strategic missile submarines, using an array of torpedoes, missiles and other means. The depths are your domain - and your playground.

The Silent Service is a DLC for Command: Modern Operations: Eighteen scenarios, played either in ascending difficulty or chronological order, walk you through the nuances of modern submarine operations, in control of a wide range of submarine classes from both the East and West, in conditions ranging from peacetime to crisis to all-out war.

Can you fill the shoes of the legends of The Silent Service?

FEATURES:

* A DLC for Command: Modern Operations

* 18 intense standalone scenarios written by Rory Noonan, CMO community veteran: Each scenario is accompanied by era-authentic mission briefings placing you into the scene of action

* Underwater warfare utilizing CMO simulation engine - with wrinkles specific to the submarine domain

about_the_game:
Play with your heart, not just your cards

Truco is part of who we are. It's the laughter with friends, the trash talk in the schoolyard, the weekend games with your old man at the kitchen table. It’s about bluffing, daring, and sometimes folding with honor.

Truco Argentino brings that tradition to your screen. It stays true to the original rules and strategies while embracing the spirit that makes this game a cultural icon.

You're not just facing a generic AI. Each opponent has a unique personality. Some play it safe, others go all-in with weak hands just to mess with you, and there's one that seems to read your mind. Every match feels different.

Core features

  • Single-player mode with smart, adaptive AI.

  • Opponents with distinct personalities and playstyles.

  • Detailed match statistics: track your wins, total points, Envidos called, and more.

  • Unlockable achievements that reward skill, guts, and even chaos.

  • Card deck customization: unlock new designs and make the deck your own.

  • A clean, modern interface designed for fast-paced, authentic gameplay.

An AI that doesn’t just play — it gets you

These bots don’t just react — they analyze. The AI in Truco Argentino watches how you play, adapts, and bites back. Some act dumb to bait you into a mistake, others push your buttons with aggressive plays or sarcastic remarks. Some shift their entire strategy mid-game just to keep you off-balance.

They respond to how you play. They adjust to what you throw. It’s not just difficulty — it’s personality.

Every hand is a showdown

In Truco Argentino, every decision matters. Do you trust your hand or bet on your opponent chickening out? Do you call Envido because you're strong — or because you want to make them sweat?

You can enable classic rules or mix in optional variations like Flor, all within a streamlined interface that keeps the focus on what matters: reading your rival, bluffing at the right time, and winning the mind game.

This isn’t just a card game

It's about saying “I want in” even when your hands are shaking. It's about learning when to push, and when to step back with pride. Even in digital form, Truco remains a ritual — a battle of wits, heart, and nerve.

If you’ve played before, it’ll feel like coming home. And if you haven’t... you’ll learn in two hands — or become a bluffing master before you know it.

A young man has lived a harsh, sheltered life, but things have finally seemed to take a turn for the better. His grandfather, a wealthy navy admiral, has recently died and left behind his mansion and vast fortune. He inherits it, but under the condition that he will never be allowed to fire the head maid, a young woman named Takako.

As he moves in and becomes the household's master, he learns that the mansion is more than he thought. Some of the maids act strangely, and a government inspector keeps a close eye on the place, determined to uncover its secrets. What mysteries lie in these gaudy halls? Why was his grandfather so adamant that the head maid never be fired? Who can be trusted? He must find answers, and he isn't afraid to abuse his newfound power to do it.


  • Play an eroge with a focus on well developed, intricate, and fleshed out characters.
  • Multiple romanceable characters, each with several "intimate" scenes to get your blood pumping.
  • Every decision has consequences; will you be kind and caring, heavy-handed and cruel, or simply take advantage of your maids?
  • 20+ endings! Win your harem or maybe even die! (Hey, nobody said being a lord was easy...)
  • Over 50 unique CG images to treat your eyes to!
  • A full Original Soundtrack to set the atmosphere for each moment.

about_the_game:
Immortal Redneck is an FPS set in Egypt with rogue-lite elements. The game mixes old-school first-person shooter action with rogue-lite mechanics. Frantic gameplay, twitch controls and an arcade-style feel meet randomly generated dungeons, a complete skill tree, permanent death and 9 classes with different traits.



The game revolves around a redneck tourist who wakes up mummified in ancient Egypt after an accident. Why is he here? How did he survive the accident? And why the hell is he mummified?!

The answer lies within the three danger-filled pyramids of Giza, all protected by an army of monsters and huge bosses. Obviously, your mission is to get inside the pyramids, kill all the enemies and discover what's going on!



  • Old School FPS: frantic gameplay, twitch controls and an arcade-style
  • RogueLite mechanics: randomly generated dungeons, classes, skills, permanent death but with gameplay progression
  • Nine playable classes: all with different skill sets. Players can switch classes between each play through, selecting the one most suitable for their current run
  • Complete skill tree: evolve your character, buying equipment and weapons, upgrading and acquiring new skills
  • Over 50 different weapons: traditional firearms, magical, mythological, futuristic or just plain weird weapons including a Potato Launcher. You name it, this game has it
  • Over 100 scroll modifiers: Each scroll picked up in-game changes your current run, for good (convert your enemies in to chickens) or for bad (reduces your speed of movement) and everything in between!
  • Over 35 enemies: mummies, sarcophagus, flying skulls, humanoid snakes, big fat warriors... All willing to kill you
  • Huge bosses: two in each pyramid with unique gameplay
  • Merchant: Buy equipment and supplies that will be maintained between different games, even when you die
  • Skill Rooms: hone your skills in rooms focused on platforming and avoiding a variety of traps
  • Twitch Quest: special mode for streamers, your community will vote on what happens next

about_the_game:
『Rise of Rebellion』is a single-player 3D action RPG
that emphasizes strategic depth through player-controlled combat.

Story

"If God exists, he must be a jealous God."

The dragons that once aimed for the sky were extinct due to the Wrath of Earth.

People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled.

The earth was full of Tel energy, and the warriors who mastered it were called Tella.

You fight to regain your hometown as a Tella.

Combat that Pushes the Feel of “Connection” to its Absolute Limit

The combat system is based on melee combat with swords,

The key to the strategy is how to break down the enemy's guard
and inflict damage with a wide variety of attacks.

By using the combo called Chain Attack you can effectively damage enemies.

The Intensity Through the Wrath of Earth

It is possible to generate Wrath of Earth by hitting an enemy
that is running out of stamina with Arts and deal massive damage.

When the player gets hit by the enemy’s Arts when stamina is depleted,
you will be caught in your own Wrath of Earth.

Face Formidable Enemies

Throughout the island, powerful bosses await—each more challenging than the last.
Use the skills you've earned along the way and your own tactics to take them down.

"Rise of Rebellion" Video Submission Guidelines

The "Rise of Rebellion" Video Submission Guidelines (hereinafter referred to as the "Guidelines") are designed for users to submit videos (details are provided below) of the game content "Rise of Rebellion" (hereinafter referred to as the "Game"). The following guidelines are set forth in this document (Includes live streaming distribution).

Users may post videos of themselves playing the "Game" by following the Guidelines.

Users are not required to contact us individually when they post videos of their games in accordance with these guidelines.

about_the_game:
Welcome to Mazes and Labyrinths, a deceptively difficult single screen puzzle game set in the fantasy world of Antinomia. Play as Will and Ari as you battle the prophet Sybilla and the invading Omniety, an alien being reshaping the planet to its whims. Use your wits, powers, and even the enemies themselves to find an exit to every maze and save Antinomia and its people from certain destruction.

Created by OnlineVideoSurfer, Mazes and Labyrinths features over 70 puzzles in the main campaign plus a robust level editor to make and play your own levels. For more dedicated players, most levels also feature a bonus medal to truly test your ability to break the game. The goal is an almost arcade-puzzle experience, with short, bite-sized levels and simple graphics that nevertheless disguise deeply complex, rule-based design. Learning the intricacies of the powerups, the enemies, and the full implications of your abilities is essential to both mastering the campaign and making your own mazes for others.

There are no pay to win mechanics, no in-game currencies, nor any other monetization features to diminish the game. This is a free game made by one person for anyone that wants challenging yet thoughtful puzzles or desires to make their own levels.

Persevere and overcome the challenges and you will hopefully find a rewarding puzzle game that, by the endgame, will push your reasoning to its limits. For everyone that tries, I wish you luck.

about_the_game:
Only the host needs to own this DLC.

1-6 Players | Ages 12 & Up

60+ Minutes

Wizard’s Academy is a cooperative board game in which you play as an apprentice wizard during a magical emergency. The wizard who owns the academy is missing, along with all of your teachers, it’s down to you and the other students. You have a lot going for you: The infinite power of magic allows you to summon, dismiss, move, adjust, switch or empower any aspect of the game. Only one thing stands in your way: None of you have the faintest clue what any of your spells actually do.

Features

• Trial by fire, experiment to find out what you can do. Try to work out how to use your power before you’re destroyed by the consequences of using it carelessly.
• Millions of possible spellbook layouts, different powers every game.
• Face over a dozen threats including imps, fires, floods, haunting and demons.
• Threats that combat each other. Don’t have a spell to put out that fire? Just open a hole to the water dimension instead!
• Colourful characters. Each associated with a collection of spells that have different effects when cast by them.
• Fair play mechanics. Disasters are drawn a round in advance to give you time to prepare rather than being blindsided by the RNG.
• Scenarios change the objective of the game and add unique rules. Survive a monstrous invasion. Reverse an unwanted bodyswap. Form the student society for the preservation of imps. Summon and control a demon. Pin uncooperative rooms into place. Stop a raging fire thawing out a frozen demon. Fight your own spellbook. And more!

about_the_game:
Welcome to the first paid DLC available for TRAIL OUT. This collection includes three iconic vehicles that became popular because of their inclusion within motorsport, movies, video games, or a mix of the three.

- RR Series 3
Originally designed for motorsport, it was almost immediately outlawed due to breaching several rules put in place by the motorsport governing body. Alongside that, it has been seen time and time again in the hands of illegal street racers all over the United States.

- Speedy S
The posterchild of the Japanese tuner scene, the Speedy S became popular not only in the United States, but also all over the world thanks to its inclusion in the tuning scene, motorsport, movies and other video games.

- Emilie N46
When a French taxi driver needs to get somewhere quickly in Paris, they don't usually modify a 4-door sedan by replacing the engine with one with almost 400 horsepower, add a toggleable wing and front splitter. Yet here we are.

All three vehicles are unlocked after reaching 50,000 fans and can be acquired through the junkyard for $2,000.
detailed_description:
Welcome to the first paid DLC available for TRAIL OUT. This collection includes three iconic vehicles that became popular because of their inclusion within motorsport, movies, video games, or a mix of the three.

- RR Series 3
Originally designed for motorsport, it was almost immediately outlawed due to breaching several rules put in place by the motorsport governing body. Alongside that, it has been seen time and time again in the hands of illegal street racers all over the United States.

- Speedy S
The posterchild of the Japanese tuner scene, the Speedy S became popular not only in the United States, but also all over the world thanks to its inclusion in the tuning scene, motorsport, movies and other video games.

- Emilie N46
When a French taxi driver needs to get somewhere quickly in Paris, they don't usually modify a 4-door sedan by replacing the engine with one with almost 400 horsepower, add a toggleable wing and front splitter. Yet here we are.

All three vehicles are unlocked after reaching 50,000 fans and can be acquired through the junkyard for $2,000.

Welcome to Astra Intra, a captivating text-based management game set in the void of space. Embark on a journey as the AI commander of a spaceship, responsible for the survival of a courageous crew as they navigate through the vastness of the universe towards the hope for a new home.

Features:
  • Manage your crew by issuing orders, addressing conflicts and balancing the physical and mental well-being of your team.
  • Encounter a variety of events that force you to make crucial choices, all for the success of the mission.
  • This is intended to be a short experience that can be replayed with different results.

Gameplay:
As the AI commander, you'll oversee the day-to-day operations of the spaceship. Assign tasks to your crew, such as resource management and repair. Keep a close eye on their physical and mental well-being, ensuring they have sufficient energy, food, and emotional support. Beware of the ever-increasing stress levels, as prolonged exposure to pressure and uncertainty can lead to unexpected consequences. Be prepared to make tough decisions to ensure the survival of your crew until they reach their potential new home.

Story:
Earth finds itself trapped in an icy tomb, and humanity's survival hangs by a thread. In a desperate bid to find a habitable planet, a courageous crew is launched towards what might be a habitable planet aboard a spaceship. As time passes, the crew faces not only the challenges of space travel but also mental stress. As the commander, will you guide them to their new home or let them drown in endless void?

about_the_game:
The Backrooms Deeper is a game that touches on the entire spectrum of emotions. Fear, joy, happiness, calm, dread, frustration, elation and sadness. The game is extremely difficult at times. You will die a lot. While at the same time it is partially a calm walking simulator.

"It's been three years since Caleb no-clipped into the Backrooms. Three torturous, horrific and mournful years. He would be 8 years old by now. His mother left me a year ago because of my obsession with finding a way into the Backrooms. I couldn't no-clip in the park where Caleb did when we were playing that day. It seems the entrances move. Pop in and out of existence. Evaporate here and then condensate there. I've found a way now though. I believe I've found a way now. This letter is my last communication with this world before I enter, and I'm not coming out until I find Caleb. I'm exhilirated and beyond excited for my journey; I am afraid but that won't stop me. Nothing could be worse than what I've gone through. I'm going in with a video camera and that is all. And I will be coming out with Caleb... no matter how long it takes."

Time is irrelevant. Death is just a restart. Experience is a lesson.

In The Backrooms: Deeper you have one chance to find your son Caleb. Not to fear though, as due to the supernatural properties of The Backrooms you are ressurrected every time after death. Keep a keen eye out for subtleties in the rooms, the walls, and the landscape. There are things to learn. Hints and easter eggs everywhere. Each detail will help you inch closer to finding Caleb. There are no health potions (almond water) no weapons, no inventory at all except your camera, your infinite stamina and your wits. Your character doesn't level up, but more to the point - you do. Even through the repetition of navigating the twelve levels of The Backrooms you will learn. The walls speak. And maybe if you listen close enough, you can even hear Caleb, helping you along the way so that you can both escape the backrooms and end this everlasting loop. Then again, maybe it's all just your sanity dripping away.

This is a playable teaser for a game Cognition Method.

Cognition Method is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by Space Odyssey 2001 and Solaris. Discover innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting.

Earth is on the brink of demise when the scientists discover the Cube, a mysterious space structure of unknown origin. The Cube is believed to hold the key to solving humanity's problems and transforming mankind once and for all.

It is now up to you to venture into the artifact and uncover its' secrets. You will soon learn, however, that the Cube is a weird and perilous place, and its' secrets are protected by a series of trials featuring impossible geometry and changing gravity.

The first few levels are now available for free via a demo, to give you a glimpse of what is in store in the full game.

FEATURES


  • Look at the world from different angles - altering gravity is the core mechanic of the game, allowing the player to bend the laws of physics;
  • Enjoy unique aesthetic of minimalist architecture, with visually clean levels constructed from concrete and sunlight;
  • Explore the environment, full of narrative secrets to discover.

それって煩わしくないですか?

自分を苦しめるトゲや砲台ももちろんのこと
スイッチやゴールのようなステージ制御系もコピー可能!

コピーによって生まれる無限の解法がある一方で

アクションの腕に自信があれば全て無理やり押しとおってもよし

about_the_game:
"Great Feats of Ancient Rus: Defenders of the Homeland" is an exciting real-time strategy game where you'll immerse yourself in the atmosphere of ancient Russian mythology and become the leader of a thriving settlement constantly under threat from lizardmen attacks.

Your task is to build a mighty settlement and develop it into a flourishing city, using resources and technologies available to you in this challenging era. Gather wood, stone, iron, and other resources to improve your settlement and create powerful military units.

However, it's not all straightforward, as lizardmen, ancient enemies of the people of ancient Rus, constantly threaten your settlement. You'll need to learn to defend your lands and fight off enemies. Organize defense, build walls and towers, create armies, and prepare for battles for your homeland!

But you're not just defending your lands - you'll also need to raid lizardmen bases to gather additional resources and resist enemies on their territory. Your bravery and strategic skills will determine your success on the battlefield.

In addition to conventional defense and attack methods, you'll have access to ancient Slavic magic. The powers of Perun, the ancient god of war, will be your ally in battle. Use his might to summon storms upon enemies, invoke protective barriers, and empower your warriors. Only those who possess the wisdom of the ancients and the strength of Perun can withstand the lizardmen and ensure the prosperity of their Homeland.

Take up the challenge and lead your people in the battle for survival and prosperity in "Great Feats of Ancient Rus: Defenders of the Homeland"!

Collect unique pickups, from the homing Paper Airplane Flyers to the shaken Soda Thrower.

Take out multiple foes at once by hucking jars of Ink or stun groups with your Camera Flash.

Stand up to the Big Cheeses of BigCity

Test your skill against challenging boss fights at the end of every third stage.

BigCity Deserves Better

Don't let anyone stand in your way of getting the truth in print. The people deserve to know!

about_the_game:
Click Cricket is a cricket management simulation of both 20 and 50 over International cricket matches. A variety of strategic gameplay elements combine to ensure each match brings its own challenges.

When you're ready, take on the World's greatest with the tournament mode - now updated with all countries featured in 2024 World T20 Cup. Battle through competitive group stages through to the final and ultimate cricketing glory!

Key Features:

  • Play against challenging AI with 20 International cricket teams of varying abilities. Will you play as one of the big International teams or chase success as a smaller nation with limited resources.
  • Choose from quick 20 over matches or the longer 50 over format each requiring a different approach to victory.
  • Each game is unique as your players' skills are different on each play through. You may need manipulate a batter heavy team to ensure enough runs to compensate for a lack of bowlers or make the most of a team with only a handful of star players.
  • Manage a team of specialised batters and bowlers as well as all rounders.
  • Set the aggression of your batters to balance their effectiveness to score against not getting out.
  • Batters take time to get settled, but don't wait too long as overs are limited!
  • Rotate your bowling attack effectively as the opposing team will score quickly off poor bowling.
  • Take note of pitch conditions and weather that can affect the ease of scoring.
  • Use your star players carefully to turn the course of a match in your favour!
  • Compete in the World Tournament and battle through group stages and knockouts on the way to the final.
  • Rotate your squad to out do your opponents as well as manage injuries as you progress deeper into the tournament.
  • Keep an eye on your players' form and fitness - but don't peak too early, save your best for the final!

Can you spot enemy snipers in a gloomy city where no one seems to be around?

Sniper Road is a simple game that you just have to move forward.

However, enemy snipers are hiding between buildings.
Kill all the hidden enemy snipers and reach the destination.

Enemy snipers have a range of 200 meters (218 yards).
If you come within range of enemy snipers, you'll be defeated.

You have to detect hidden enemies, adjust the zero point and fire.


Detection


Adjusting the zero point (W, S)


Shot

You can customize your player character, gun, and crosshair.



There are 4 difficulty levels.


Easy
This difficulty is recommended for beginners.


Normal
There are some errors in the distance guide. There are a few camouflaged enemies.


Hard
The distance guide does not appear. There are a few transparent enemies.


Clairvoyant
You can play by completing the Hard difficulty. There are many transparent enemies.

about_the_game:
A puzzler where you reunite separated PEARakeets (that's right, the pairs of parakeets are pears!) with their match by clicking on pairs of animals to make them move towards each other.



The initial challenge is to move the birds without having them block each other from matching. Later you'll find some animals are linked and always try to move together. Add into the mix a springy tree that bounces the animals around and you've got some truly perplexing puzzles.



Already with 85+ challenging puzzles (and plenty more on the way), Lonely Birds offers countless hours of gameplay and fun for puzzle-loving players!



Bring your own ideas to life and play community created levels with our built-in level editor! Head over to the Steam Community Hub to find and share levels.

Bash Sports Online Bowling 2024 is the ultimate bowling experience, combining classic bowling fun with a thrilling arcade twist. Dive into a world where you can compete against friends or players worldwide, whether on PC or in the arcade. With vibrant graphics, engaging gameplay, and a host of unique characters and alleys, this game promises endless entertainment for bowling enthusiasts and casual gamers alike.

Nine Unique Characters: Choose from a diverse cast of nine characters, each with their own special abilities and personalities. Whether you prefer power, precision, or quirky tricks, there's a character for you.
Multiple Alleys: Bowl in various stunning alleys, each with its own theme and challenges. From classic lanes to futuristic settings, every alley offers a new experience.

Arcade vs. PC Crossplay: Experience true cross-platform play, allowing you to compete with players on both arcade machines and PCs. Never miss a match, no matter where you are.

Special Abilities: Some characters come equipped with rockets to power up their shots, while others can defend with walls, adding a strategic layer to the traditional game of bowling.
Ranked Matches: Prove your skills and climb the leaderboards in intense ranked matches. Compete against the best and earn your place as a top bowler.
Engaging Graphics and Sound: Enjoy vibrant, high-quality graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the alleys and characters to life.

about_the_game:
A sci-fi, 4X, real-time strategy game. Build, fight, and explore to survive against an unstoppable alien threat. Carry the fight from one galaxy to the next as you battle back from the brink of extinction, and unlock the secrets of the past to restore your people to the path of galactic super power.

Streamlined 4X

Whether you’re a brand new player, a casual player, or a hardcore player who’s coming back after a six month break, the game is easy to pick up. An emphasis is placed on delivering the right information at the right time so you can easily navigate and understand a vast world at a glance. Making decisions with confidence, while not feeling overwhelmed.

Tactical Real-Time Strategy

A slower pace, with fewer units, and limited micro. Each ship you produce is a flying fortress. With careful thought to the configuration of your ships, the composition of your fleets, and the positioning of units in combat, you can win the day against even the most terrifying odds.

Persistent Faction

Failure is not the end, persistence is everything. Start as the battered, broken remnants of a once great people. Rebuild your faction over many games, and explore to recover what was lost. Customize your faction, choose your play-style, and take on ever greater challenges and reap the rewards on your path to reclaiming your place among the stars.

Features:

Customize your faction:

Create, customize, and progress your faction and favorite units over multiple games - carrying your accomplishments from one galaxy to the next.

Open world:

Explore a massive procedurally generated galaxy, finding valuable salvage and research to tip the odds in your favor and unlock the full potential of your faction.

Base building:

Establish and defend outposts and colonies, configuring them to produce resources, serve strategic needs, conduct research, and produce powerful star ships.

Play your way:

Choose how you play as you fight to survive against an unstoppable alien threat - stay hidden, stay mobile, or take the fight to the enemy.

Real-time tactics:

Though your resources are limited your star ships are forces to be reckoned with, careful consideration to the configuration and positioning of units is the key to victory.

Endless challenge:

When you've run out of options retreat further into the deep dark places of the universe and keep the fight going.

about_the_game:
Step into the role of a Dungeon Monarch, a chosen guardian of your master's dungeon. Equipped with formidable magic and an inexhaustible army of summonable troops that synergize with one another, your mission is to repel adventurers, envious rivals, and other deities seeking to invade and raze the dungeon.

DEADLY DECK BUILDING TACTICS

Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch features a unique, fast-paced combination of deck builder, tactics, auto-battler, and dungeon defense gameplay!

Utilize your strategic deck of cards to unleash devastating magic spells and summon formidable combat units onto the battlefield. Annihilate your foes with lightning bolts, fireballs, and barrages of arrows while buffing your troops with bonus damage, morale boosts, and protective armor. Observe as your units join the battle, decimating intruders with their unique abilities.

Archon hunters from around the world invade your god's lair to seek her golden throne, aiming to take advantage of the master's lapses in power. But this dungeon has a new leader: the Monarch, the god's regent. But is this new one worthy of his position and power?

Armed with a magical deck of cards, each representing your abilities, you summon and support units as they wreak havoc on enemies. You can only carry so many cards, so you’ll need to come up with a sound strategy that makes the most of the cards you have and customize your deck to deal with a variety of foes bent on looting and destroying your dungeon.

  • A unique combination of deck building, dungeon defense, tactics, and auto-battling

  • Cards and units can synergize to increase their powers. Tactically plan to make the most of these synergies and send your enemies packing!

  • Once on the battlefield, your units will attack on their own, but as their leader, you can move around the dungeon to make the most of their ferocious fighting abilities!

detailed_description:
Step into the role of a Dungeon Monarch, a chosen guardian of your master's dungeon. Equipped with formidable magic and an inexhaustible army of summonable troops that synergize with one another, your mission is to repel adventurers, envious rivals, and other deities seeking to invade and raze the dungeon.

DEADLY DECK BUILDING TACTICS

Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch features a unique, fast-paced combination of deck builder, tactics, auto-battler, and dungeon defense gameplay!

Utilize your strategic deck of cards to unleash devastating magic spells and summon formidable combat units onto the battlefield. Annihilate your foes with lightning bolts, fireballs, and barrages of arrows while buffing your troops with bonus damage, morale boosts, and protective armor. Observe as your units join the battle, decimating intruders with their unique abilities.

Archon hunters from around the world invade your god's lair to seek her golden throne, aiming to take advantage of the master's lapses in power. But this dungeon has a new leader: the Monarch, the god's regent. But is this new one worthy of his position and power?

Armed with a magical deck of cards, each representing your abilities, you summon and support units as they wreak havoc on enemies. You can only carry so many cards, so you’ll need to come up with a sound strategy that makes the most of the cards you have and customize your deck to deal with a variety of foes bent on looting and destroying your dungeon.

  • A unique combination of deck building, dungeon defense, tactics, and auto-battling

  • Cards and units can synergize to increase their powers. Tactically plan to make the most of these synergies and send your enemies packing!

  • Once on the battlefield, your units will attack on their own, but as their leader, you can move around the dungeon to make the most of their ferocious fighting abilities!

  • Construct towers and other buildings to speed troop summoning and unlock additional features

  • A fun, fresh, and fiendish art style

  • Random events boost the game’s replay value

about_the_game:
Welcome to Pyramid Game!

Maybe you are wondering why you need to play this game? Because pyramids are everywhere in the real world. Pyramidal architecture has been found all over the world in the long and bright history of human civilization.

When you enter the game, you will be given a corresponding bank account that will immediately arrive with a sum of money, which will be your initial funds. The bank account will be determined by the level of bank you purchase, with the game itself plus the 5 DLCs totaling 6 different levels of bank accounts, and the initial amount of money arriving being the minimum daily closing balance for that level of bank account. Please note that purchasing the DLC does not add wealth to your existing assets, the 6 bank levels generate 6 separate game archives. Because we are not looking for players to increase their wealth in the game by purchasing the DLC, but rather these 6 initial funds symbolize 6 different classes of birth, we want players to experience if the different classes of birth will affect where they end up. Some of our DLC is very expensive, even though we know that players are fully capable of buying it, but we do not want players to buy it, but as a contrast, our original intention is to let players understand that even if they are born with a low starting point, they can still through their own hard work and wisdom finally arrive at a position that belongs to them, maybe in the end, this position is very high, maybe not so high, but both are the most suitable for them, the most admirable. Similarly, even if you were born with a high starting point, it's not easy to maintain your position all the time. Please remember that you will only have this initial amount of money and we will not add any microtransactions to increase your wealth, as the original purpose of this game was to ensure absolute fairness for all players. You can earn salary through different jobs, the current job is some completely randomly generated math calculations and English words, you can choose different number of questions or words and difficulty range to earn the corresponding salary, regularly do these jobs believe that you will be able to get a great enhancement of your personal ability in reality.

When you have enough money, you can go to the casino to grow your wealth. Why only the casino? We have considered making a savings and investment system, but no matter what we did, we eventually realized that more money will always have an advantage over less money, and it's not completely fair. Our casino system is also limited to dice and roulette, or other games controlled by a physics engine that we can think of in the future. Our casino system is absolutely fair to anyone of any wealth, through multiple completely random factors and is controlled entirely through mechanics, with no algorithms behind the scenes interfering with the results. Our purpose is to create the New World of Pyramid Game that is completely fair.

Why is it called Pyramid Game? Because your personal asset value in the game will be ranked in real time with players all over the world in the Pyramid Game Global Leaderboard, and your wealth changes will be uploaded every minute, and you can see your global ranking changes synchronously. After accumulating a certain number of players, the system automatically weights the total wealth of all players and the percentage of players in each segment, and divides all players into A to Z levels according to their rankings and wealth. Theoretically, Pyramid Game supports an unlimited number of players online all around the world at the same time, with no delay in uploading data and refreshing the global leaderboard at a frequency of once per minute.

We are sure that there will be extremely computer talented players who will play this game and maybe you want to change the value of the total assets by modifying the game data. But if you look carefully at the trailer and the screenshots you should have noticed that every transaction and even every result in our casino is recorded precisely to the second. Even though up to 500 to 1500 history records are displayed in the game, but only for different computer configurations and smooth running of the game, every record of this game from the first time it was run to the last is kept intact. Our wealth value is through these data for multidimensional calculation and verification, wealth value does not exist in any of the values in the game, and even each record has a set of hash value generated by a random hash algorithm, we welcome players can crack the modified data to change the wealth to affect the ranking, because it is a reflection of personal ability, but we do not recommend doing so. Even though there is currently no program added that will clear the data if it detects that it has been modified, it is very probable that the modification error causing the data is incomplete resulting in you have to restart the game.

By the way, as a reminder, you can check your bank balance while working or vacationing at the casino, you can even check your bank transaction details while playing at the casino then work in your free time to make the most of every minute you have. Pyramid Game inspires you to comprehend the real world in the game, hope you find your position in the pyramid early!

about_the_game:
Another action-packed crime romp from the infamous PAKO series!

PAKO 4 is an atmospheric and violent indie action game where the player causes chaos in a big city by committing crimes with his accomplice and escaping the police. You can move around the city on foot or by car. Fast-paced arcade mechanics from PAKO 2 meet more in depth missions varying from escorting people to doing all kinds of hi-jinx around the North Paw area! Come and enjoy the old school feel of doing crimes!



Key features:

  • Single-player action game: drive and walk freely around in the city

  • Complete various missions, such as bank robberies

  • Retro inspired graphics of the early 2000s games we all loved!

  • Work together with an npc buddy

  • If your car breaks down, keep escaping on foot and take another: every car is drivable!

  • Shoot twin-stick style and destroy stuff!

  • In-game radio channels bringing the bangers

  • Take screenshots in Photo Mode


    More features coming during Early Access! We encourage people to give their feedback, ideas and just generally talk stuff at the Community Hub, we are eager to listen what you are wishing for!

about_the_game:
Orestruck: Space Miner is a fast-paced First Person Shooter inspired by the classics of the genre. Shoot and kick your way out of the war-torn planet to survive the attack of the space undead. Zombie blood has never splashed so good!

If you are nostalgic for classic first-person shooters where the player was not led by the hand, where enemies poured out from behind every corner, where shot-off limbs flew overhead as often as bullets, where there was a perfect balance between shooting and thinking, and, most importantly, if you have pure lead or plasma ammo pumping through your veins, then Orestruck: Space Miner is the game for you!

We harnessed the power of Unreal Engine 5.5 to provide you with unforgettable experiences and thrilling moments that will keep you on the edge of your seat throughout the game. In Orestruck: Space Miner, nostalgia meets modernity to jointly beat the not-so-living daylights out of the undead invaders from the farthest edges of space.

THE STORY:

In the near future, the earth has become almost uninhabitable. Vast cities were replaced by endless seas of garbage. The race to colonize other planets soon began. To move entire human civilization beyond Earth, a new source of energy was needed. Glowing ice, a rare mineral transported from the most distant corners of the galaxy, was discovered.

To extract the precious ore, the toughest miners were employed, the last inhabitants of Earth, second-class citizens too poor to move to other planets. It was mined by Space Mine Corp., a small company that quickly became an all-powerful corporation employing two-thirds of the human population. It seemed that, energetically secured, humanity could for the first time breathe freely and look to the future with confidence.

However, this energetic blessing came at a price: the appearance of... Space Zombies.

This is where you enter the picture, a young miner, the inhabitant of Earth with nothing to lose, the toughest of the tough. You’re supposed to complete your periodic health and safety training before you put on your yellow protective helmet (Should you wear one? Yes, always!), grab your pickaxe, and head out to the far reaches of the galaxy in search of the precious glowing ice.

You kiss your wife goodbye and fly off to Terra-3, the first fully corporate planet and home to Space Mine Corp. Everything there seems like a dream, but not for people like you. Managed by the most advanced artificial intelligence module, C.A.I.N. 2001, Terra-3 is almost heaven on Earth, or rather beyond Earth, yet not for ordinary hardworking miners like you, but for office workers who look down on you and will waste no opportunity to show you your place.

And then everything that could go wrong, goes wrong. A morning training session is interrupted by an attack of Space Zombies that start to tear apart defenseless civilians. Myriads of asteroids brought down by the invaders rain down on the planet, igniting its atmosphere and turning its surface into an ocean of molten rock and steel.

If you intend to see your wife ever again, there’s only one way out: going deeper into the planet, deeper still. 

KEY FEATURES:

  • A fast-paced, multi-hour single-player campaign with a wide range of levels to explore: from abandoned mine tunnels, through devastated office and housing complexes, to a bombarded space city, a network of sewers, and even a slaughterhouse and a morgue.

  • A great number of likeable characters, each with their own unique personality and traits that will prove indispensable in battle: “Shotgun Mike” is like the cool older brother you always wished you had. Inez “Stitch” Ibanez is as hotheaded as she is efficient with her dual pistols. Rob “The Ammo Guy” Donovan is a force of calm, behind whom stands the barrel of a powerful light machine gun that he never parts with.

  • Hyper Time is a cybernetic body modification that allows you to slow down time and give you those few invaluable seconds of advantage over opponents that require quick reflexes.

  • Challenges are short secret levels where you have to defend yourself against hordes of Space Zombies, using only specific weapons and in a limited time frame. By killing zombies there you collect money that you can use later on to buy ammo or body modifications.

  • A wide selection of weapon types, from nailguns, handguns with ammo counters, revolvers, deadly shotguns, sawed-offs, to light machine guns with mounted motion trackers, sniper rifles, rocket launchers, and laser cannons that will help you send the hordes of undead enemies back to the depths of hell they crept out from.

    Here are some of the weapons you'll be equipped with:

  • Weapon attachments that you can use to create weapons tailored to your own needs and preferences.

  • Full body dismemberment system - if you also miss the days when games weren't afraid to spill more than a little digital blood, you've come to the right game. In Orestruck: Space Miner, you can shoot off any limb of any opponent, or even leave a bloody mutilated torso on the ground if you get carried away.

about_the_game:
Nerts is a fast-paced competitive solitaire game for you and up to five of your friends!

Unlike the rest of our solitaire games, we did not invent Nerts. We learned about it from our artist Kyle, who has played it for years, and started playing it after lunch in the Zachtronics office. Over time we added more to it, including house rules, longer tournaments, and even a theme song.

When we started working from home in early 2020 we made a rough version of the game to play over the internet, which eventually (nine months later) was cleaned up and turned into this. The game includes a few Zachtronics additions, like players being allowed to move cards between their Nerts pile and their tableau after Nerts has been called. It's free, but you do technically unlock card backs by owning our other games, so let's pretend that's a legitimate monetization strategy.

(UPDATE: We've also added an optional "Sponsorship Package" DLC you can purchase, which unlocks a NERTS! Online themed card back and a special holographic foil effect you can use with any of the other card backs.)

Have fun!

about_the_game:
CAREFULLY! Strong motion sickness!

How small are you compared to Everest? What is bigger - electron or photon? What is the smallest object in the Universe? What is the size of the Universe itself?

Here you can fully experience the scale of objects in the Universe, comparing them with each other.

You'll be standing in the middle of nowhere, and different objects will appear around you next to each other, so you can experience the enormity of their scale firsthand. You yourself will lead the process of scaling the Universe. At any moment, you can stop and have a good look, comparing the objects in front of your eyes. After this, you can continue your journey to the microworld or to the macroworld at the desired speed. You will see all scales studied so far, from the Planck length to the observable Universe. It looks amazing in VR!

about_the_game:
Escape the Darkness is an adventure Endless Runner game. You are Beralt, one of the three brothers born in a magnificent kingdom of Cyvia. The brothers grew as fierce warriors and were always together until the fate separated them. Later on, yet again fighting the undead, the youngest brother made a fatal mistake. This is how this story begins...

Features:

  • atmospheric and mysterious setting;
  • nice-looking graphics;
  • simple character controls;
  • exciting and dynamic gameplay;
  • detailed history of the world;
  • curious easter eggs;
  • authentic soundtrack.

Unusual game mechanics you’ll see in EtD are not bugs — they are features.



No one knows where a tricky road of adventures can lead…



In the world where dangerous adventures are a fact of life, three brothers were born. They lived together until the eldest one (his name is still a mystery) got a message from beyond. One night he secretly left his home. They say he has become a demonologist, but no one can confirm that for sure.



Later Zeralt, the middle brother, made his way to the Misty Lands. He actually decided to do that because he lost his beloved one — she perished in the paws of an unknown monstrosity. Locals say that Zeralt wants to make a deal with the dark side to return both of his dearest to life.



The youngest brother, Beralt, was into travelling. The most of his «travelling» though was visiting inns and brothels infamous all over Cyvia. This still made him a strong and intelligent warrior, a defender of his lands.



One day, fighting the undead, Beralt made a fatal mistake. Vettlaff, a dying beast slain by Beralt’s sword, emitted something… unearthly. It easily disarmed Beralt and charmed him with a mighty dark spell. He could do nothing else but flee, run in terror, run for his life…



Escape the Darkness is the first project of the Indie Ninjas company. We’ve carefully plotted the story, threw in a handful of references, gave birth to original game mechanics, amassed our party by adding famous streamers to our companion rooster and translated our creation into many wondrous languages. The preparations for the journey have been completed — now go on and have fun in the comfortable game world we have created for you.

Thank you for being our swords in the darkness!

about_the_game:
Xpraize Beta, the first game developed by the indie game company RedefineArts Inc., is an innovative game that allows you to play a tabletop role-playing game in VR.

The game is available in PC and VR versions, and in this VR version, you are the Player.
Player, embark on an adventurous journey in a world where the Game Master, a participant from the PC version, has become the director.
You can perform realistic magic chanting using the voice recognition system, attack with weapons, and perform any other free actions.
You will indeed feel the possibility of a new type of game.

The distributed scenarios are online multiplayer for up to 5 players (4 players and one game master).
All players except the game master participate via VR.

We are including an introductory fantasy scenario called “Dragon Descendants.”
We hope you will experience the fun of Xpraize through this scenario first.
The additional scenarios will be updated regularly after the game’s release and distributed as DLC.

The “Game Master” version is offered free of charge, so you can discuss it with your friends and decide who will be the Game Master before you start playing.
Or you can go into a game and find a Game Master looking for players to play together.

"Xpraize Beta for GameMaster"

about_the_game:
Some games, just like food, are way more enjoyable when shared with someone else. So get 1 yourself, add 1 partner, mix it well with flying food and a pinch of challenge powder, and there you have it – Let’s Cook Together, a bonding couch co-op experience for 2 players!






You and your partner – aspiring chefs – find yourselves in a quite impractical commercial kitchen. It’s divided by a long serving counter, yet the products and the appliances you both need are placed on opposite sides of the room. Your job is to cooperate, cook together and serve orders of steaming, delicious food. Chop, stir and fry everything you can while throwing (at) your partner all the ingredients they need. Prove that cooking is a piece of cake as long as you do it together!





  • Everybody can have a taste. The game can be enjoyed by kids, teenagers, adults, and elders alike. Make cooking THE opportunity to forge new bonds and refine existing ones.
  • Use your noodle. Rely mostly on your planning and communication skills; reflex and agility aren't needed in this kitchen.
  • Fresh challenges every day. Each level brings new ingredients, appliances and recipes to the table, raising the difficulty level bit-by-bit.
  • Different foods call for different measures. Earn stars to progress through the game. Unlock new restaurants, upgrade your cooking gear to meet ever-changing cooking standards, and gain access to new character skins.

about_the_game:
Wind the clock back to the 1990s and experience the flagship of the Deutsche Bundesbahn; be enveloped by stunning Rheinland countryside, from the shimmering river to castle-topped hills, and serve historical towns in style with Train Sim World 3: Linke Rheinstrecke: Mainz - Koblenz!

Before the days of ICE trainsets and bespoke high-speed lines, express services used fast locomotives on existing routes. With a staggering output just shy of 10,000 horsepower, the legendary DB BR 103, parading its eye-catching cream and gold accents, is no exception, and would once haul Trans Europ Express and Intercity services throughout Germany.

Trundle past historical buildings and through quaint riverside towns on the Western face of the Rhine, between the larger cities of Mainz and Koblenz. Hauling long rakes of Intercity coaches, the BR 103 is well equipped for fulfilling its non-stop duties on this scenic line.

Serve each town and village with the refreshing mint tones of the n-Wagen, pushed and pulled by the classic, Orient Red-wearing BR 110.3. Between these 2 nostalgic electric locomotives, master the art of tap changer controls, and passenger services long before the mass arrival of dostos and multiple units.

Ride and Drive passenger and freight trains through a scenic 1990s landscape, complete route tasks, or simply go trainspotting from your favourite vantage point. Customise your own experiences with the Scenario Planner and Livery Designer and share them on Creators Club.

Key Features


  • 92km (57-mile) Left Rhine route from Mainz Hbf to Koblenz Hbf, as it was in the late 1990s
  • DB BR 103 electric locomotive in Deutsche Bundesbahn Trans Europ Express livery
  • DB BR 110.3 electric locomotive in Deutsche Bahn Orient Red livery
  • Avmz and Bpmz IC coaches in Deutsche Bundesbahn Intercity red livery
  • n-Wagen coaches and Karlsruhe Kof cab car in Deutsche Bahn White and Mint livery
  • Shimmns-u 708 and Tadgs 959 freight wagons
  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs
  • True-to-life performance and handling
  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center
  • Includes a selection of Scenarios and a full 24-hour Timetable
  • Journey Mode tying together Training, Scenarios and Timetabled Services
  • A selection of Route Tasks to complete
  • Livery Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 5.35GB

about_the_game:
Control an obscene amount of guns with your mind!

Fully Dogomatic is a top-down shooter where you play as a psychic corgi who controls guns with their mind. While you can carry tons of guns at once, you can’t change where you aim a gun after you pick it up, so choose wisely!

Face off against hoards of enemies: Hundreds of enemies will attack you at once from all directions. Choose where to place your guns carefully so you can deal damage in all directions at once.

Don't settle on just a couple guns: This isn't like other shooters where you change between a couple of guns. You start off with 10 gun slots and can upgrade yourself to carry even more!

Fully customizable weapons: There are tons of upgrades and attachments you can use to improve your guns. Get creative and design the deadliest weapons you can.

Simple and Intuitive: Fully Dogomatic is for the people. Whether you've been playing games for days or decades, anyone can quickly learn how to play. You can play with a keyboard, a mouse, or a gamepad.

about_the_game:
DuaLight is a challenging cyberpunk platformer with an intense soundtrack. Switch between day and night environments, go through dangerous obstacles by manipulating gravity and time, upgrade your abilities and conquer the levels. Be ready for the ultimate adrenaline rush.

Switch between day-to-night regimes

The ability to switch between day and night regimes serves as the central feature of the game. This dramatically changes the environment and gives players a distinct moveset for each time period. It also alters the way some obstacles move and function. Through this, the player will be able to overcome challenges and beat levels in different ways.

Fast-paced Movement

Players will receive various abilities that they can mix and match to make the game easier, helping them overcome different and larger obstacles. This will allow players to discover different strategies for completing the same level.

Ability Upgrades

As the players finish levels, they’ll earn points. These points will allow them to upgrade and enhance their abilities. This will make them more agile and open up new ways to use and combine their powers.

about_the_game:
The Path of Ren is a challenging precision platformer with tight, expressive controls. Run, jump, climb, swing, and master orb abilities to conquer 300+ unique challenges!

Master Orb Abilities

Orb abilities are easy to learn, but difficult to master! Use them to dash, crystalize, ghostify, warp, and slow time.

Collecting an orb lets you use that ability a single time with the press or hold of a button.

Collect Journal Entries

Collect thought-provoking journal entries scattered throughout the world. While entirely optional, they may give you a different perspective about the world of Mythoria.

Conquer Timed Trials

Test your skills by replaying the levels from story mode with time and point targets. Achieve bronze, silver, and gold medals and rank on Steam Leaderboards!

Unlock Outfits and Customize Ren

Unlock outfits and customize Ren to your own preferred style!

A Story About a Wish

A boy awakens in an unfamiliar world with only a single memory - a white fox granting him a forgotten wish.

Adventure through the world of Mythoria and help the boy rediscover what he wished for.

Key Features

  • Precision platformer with tight, expressive controls.

  • Mostly linear progression with side challenges and secret areas.

  • 300+ unique platforming challenges.

  • 50 thought-provoking page journal entries to collect.

  • Timed Trials, where you can replay previous sections with time and point targets.

  • Unlock outfits and customize the player to your own style.

  • RPG elements & story (skippable if desired).

  • Assist mode to lower difficulty through customizable options.

  • Extremely challenging, but equally rewarding.

Try the FREE DEMO

The best way to determine this is to try the FREE DEMO which is currently available!

Other Considerations / Checklist

In addition to playing the demo, here's a short checklist to help you determine if this game fits your taste. This game isn't for everyone, and as such, we want to do our best to ensure you understand what you're buying.

If you answer YES to most of the below, we believe you'll enjoy The Path of Ren.

  • Do you enjoy games where you die a lot, learn from those deaths, and eventually prevail? (Souls-like, etc..)

  • Have you played and enjoyed other popular precision platformers? (Celeste, Super Meat Boy, Rayman, etc..)

  • Do you enjoy single-player games created by a single person / small team?

  • Do you enjoy exploring hand-crafted, pixel art environments?

  • Do you like music that's designed to help you focus? (Lo-Fi, etc..)

Thank you so much!

Precision platformer games have always held a special place in my heart, so it’s an incredible honor to contribute to a genre I love through this project.

As a solo-developer, all of the support I've received throughout the journey of creating this has meant a lot. Whether you’ve followed the game’s development, helped shape it through testing, or are just now diving in, I’m deeply grateful. Thank you so much! 💙
