about_the_game:
Expedition to Madness is a 1–4 player co-op cosmic horror experience that blends survival, exploration, and psychological tension. Step into the boots of an inter-dimensional explorer on a desperate mission to find your missing partner, Emily—lost somewhere in the folds of reality.

EXPLORE

Traverse unstable wormholes into terrifying parallel dimensions inspired by Lovecraft’s most iconic stories. From the icy ruins of At the Mountains of Madness to the cursed coastlines of Innsmouth, each mission takes you deeper into a multiverse of horrors and hidden truths.

EXTRACT

Collect primordial energy, recover ancient artifacts, and piece together clues from Emily’s scattered journal. But be warned: unspeakable entities hunt in the dark, and the deeper you go, the harder it is to return.

ESCAPE

Bounce your way up to the mysterious Summit, where eternal pinball glory and an awesome gift await. This journey demands absolute mastery in the art of The Flipper.

This is no typical pinball game. You must learn from every fall to overcome this transformative challenge. Endure the climb and you may emerge a... Pinball Wizard.

  • Hours of Challenging Gameplay

    Try to beat it before the refund window is over!

    No procedural generation here!

    It really makes you feel like a pinball!

    No one will judge you!

    You can make your pinball a cat!

    At least the music is relaxing!

I was inspired by the momentum-based gameplay of "Get To Work" and the other legendary "Foddian" games that came before it. My goal was to provide a fresh take on the soul-testing magic I felt while playing them.

about_the_game:
A fresh fusion of Poker and Puzzle! Arrange cards and complete poker hands!

【Game Outline】

Poker Solitaire - a new game that adds puzzle elements to creating poker hands.

The player rearranges 25 cards in 5 rows by 5 columns and completes a role within a row to erase a card, earning points.

This software has a “2-Minute Mode” in which the player aims for a high score within a time limit, and a “Mission Mode” in which the player creates the roles specified one after another and erases them so that the instructions do not overflow.

This is a game with simple controls, yet offers a variety of ways to develop strategies.

【Points】

  • An exhilarating brain game in which players create and eliminate roles!

The point of this game is to enjoy the brain game in which you have to decide how to efficiently use the cards on the table.

The exhilarating feeling you get when you make a difficult card or eliminate more cards as the limit is approaching is addictive!

  • Your strategic options are limitless!

In 2-minute mode, various strategies are possible. You can increase your score by taking advantage of combo bonuses.

In Mission Mode, you can aim for a high score by assessing the situation, such as what instructions are coming next and which instructions to erase first.

  • You can also participate in ranking!

By playing in online mode, you can compete with players around the world for scores.

【How to Play】

(1) After selecting the card you want to move with the Space key, use the WASD key to rearrange the cards.

(2) Select a row by pressing the E key, and press the Space key to confirm the role.

(3) Erase the selected rows to earn points.

Make hands, clear them, and aim for high scores!

【Two Game Modes】

  • 2-Minute Mode

Aim for the highest score in 2 minutes.

Clear the same hand consecutively for combo bonuses.

As the combos continue, bonuses will increase. Create your own strategy!

  • Mission Mode

Create the specified poker hands in sequence. Game over if missions overflow.

Earn bonuses by completing all missions.

The intervals between instructions gradually become shorter and the difficulty level increases.

Complete as many missions as possible while adapting to the ever-changing situation!

Simple yet profound, experience the world of this new brain game!

about_the_game:
Combat system utilizing official Unity assets

.
✧ This tool takes official Unity assets for 3D games that have been approved for redistribution and customizes them for use in VR
✧ As such, it has basic melee weapons, enemies, effects, stages, gimmicks, etc.
✧ You can modify the terrain of the stages by utilizing Unity's ProBuilder tool
✧ You can connect and configure your development PC and VR headset to check the operation on the Unity editor without having to build the game

Implement measures to prevent VR sickness

.
✧ VR sickness countermeasure is implemented by narrowing the field of view when moving or changing the viewpoint with the controller.
✧ General VR sickness countermeasures include using a warp to move, but we have adopted a method that narrows the field of view, taking into account the fact that this is an action game.
✧ This function also utilizes official redistributable assets from Unity.

Combat with monsters and robots

.

detailed_description:
Combat system utilizing official Unity assets

.
✧ This tool takes official Unity assets for 3D games that have been approved for redistribution and customizes them for use in VR
✧ As such, it has basic melee weapons, enemies, effects, stages, gimmicks, etc.
✧ You can modify the terrain of the stages by utilizing Unity's ProBuilder tool
✧ You can connect and configure your development PC and VR headset to check the operation on the Unity editor without having to build the game

Implement measures to prevent VR sickness

.
✧ VR sickness countermeasure is implemented by narrowing the field of view when moving or changing the viewpoint with the controller.
✧ General VR sickness countermeasures include using a warp to move, but we have adopted a method that narrows the field of view, taking into account the fact that this is an action game.
✧ This function also utilizes official redistributable assets from Unity.

.

  • Varied enemies and hazards
  • Player customization with colors and masks

Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to reach an exit as quickly and as lucratively as possible with the highest score... and your LIFE!!!

about_the_game:
Echoes is a visual novel / point-and-click adventure for PC/Mac/linux.



Follow the clues, question a cast of quirky and intriguing witnesses, and solve a mysterious murder case in the rural American North-West.
Uncover the secrets of the apparently sleepy little town of Greenhearth, where the deeper you dig, the more you risk awakening Eldritch horrors.
Will you crack the case with your sanity intact?




  • Gorgeous black and white hand-painted illustrations, with a style that evolves with the mood and tone of the story, from the soft gray scale of the first episode to the hard black and white style of episode four, before ending in a technicolor drenched finale.
  • A mind-bending narrative adventure, with four different endings, that seamlessly takes you from a film noir pastiche to an 80's horror flick.
  • Find clues in light point-and-click gameplay scenes, then confront persons of interest to uncover the truth.
  • Meet a cast of quirky and lively characters, from the badass sheriff to the strange car mechanic, the neurotic waitress, the jovial hotel manager and more. Question them, befriend them or betray them to crack the case.

about_the_game:
Kill Your Friends!
Grab a gun and be the last one standing in fast, frantic rounds. Play on over 30 stages with a variety of elements and unique mechanics. A unique modifier system will continuously stack modifiers which increase the chaos every round with new mechanics, effects, and items.

Couch-Worthy Combat
Play with up to 4 players locally as you ruin friendships to claim victory! Short rounds make for great party gameplay where you can hand off controllers to others. Also supports Steam Remote Play Together, where you can play with friends online.

Piles Of Guns
Featuring classic FPS staples like the pistol or AK-47 alongside weapons like the BOOMER, a 2d pixelated shotgun.

Mix It Up
In Classic Mode, you get to vote on modifiers which stack up and build the chaos of the game. And after several rounds of building chaos, you face off in a Ridiculous Round with a unique, bigger modifier. After this, all modifiers reset and you get to do it all over again. In Arcade mode, you get to choose all the stages, guns, and modifiers that you want to play with.

Retro Revival
Every stage is based off of a classic movie genre. Slash through your friends with katanas in the lush gardens of the Samurai area. Wallrun at ridiculous speeds through the totally rad Outrun area. Or drink potions in the Fantasy area for strong elemental powers with dangerous side-effects.

about_the_game:
Oh wow, I'm actually kinda surprised you scrolled down this far...that's awesome! My name's Chris, and I'm so excited to tell you about my game! It’s a ‘90s-inspired adventure platformer about the totally normal adventures I went on as a chubby kid back in 1995 - traveling the world, learning useful abilities, and, naturally, getting kidnapped and turned into a balloon by cartoon villains. Thankfully, I escaped and learned to use my transformation as a kind of superpower. I got to learn all kinds of cool stuff - how to throw fireballs and lightning, how to bounce around like a basketball and rocket around the earth. It's a neat story...I think. I really hope you'll enjoy it - I had a lot of fun making it!




  • Uncover a sinister story in a quirky, cartoon-like universe.
  • Explore 9 locations around the world in any order you please, plus the Kingdom of Lost Balloons and more!
  • Build Chris from a weak kid into the ultimate hero by upgrading him with unique special moves and abilities that you can customize to your style.
  • Learn (or purchase) increasingly powerful spells and techniques.
  • Battle bizarre villains across the globe, including samurai cats, cyborg penguins and whiny vampires.
  • Float or fall through unique platforming challenges.
  • Two additional full game modes, including bonus content - a more difficult and humorous Mean Mode, and Developer Commentary.
  • A variety of unlockable content and secrets to discover, including an in-depth backstory.
  • Numerous difficulty settings, including "Ridiculously Easy" for players who prefer to never die, and "Hard for No Reason" for crazy people.
  • Snort out loud with a game chock-full of laughs.

Step into Menticide, a survival horror game that plunges you into sinister investigations. Playing as a member of an elite special forces unit, you'll experience the action through a bodycam view, intensifying the immersion and fear. What starts as a routine mission quickly descends into a nightmarish struggle for survival, as you uncover horrors lurking beneath the surface.

Key Features:
Bodycam View: Experience the horror firsthand with a bodycam perspective, heightening the sense of immersion and realism.

Gripping Storyline: Engage in a deep and disturbing narrative that unfolds through intense investigation and exploration.

Atmospheric Environment: Navigate through meticulously crafted environments that enhance the game’s suspenseful and eerie atmosphere.

Survival Mechanics: Manage limited resources and make critical decisions to survive the horrors that await you.

Psychological Terror: Encounter unnerving scenarios that challenge your sanity and perception of reality.

Menticide is designed for mature audiences who crave a deeply immersive and terrifying experience. Prepare yourself for a journey into darkness, where the line between reality and nightmare blurs, and every step brings you closer to uncovering the malevolent truth.

Are you ready to face your fears and uncover the sinister secrets of Menticide? The investigation begins soon.

about_the_game:
Fishyphus is a horror fishing roguelite which rewards careful navigation, quick reflexes, and persistence. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones.

Sail the waves

Take command of a fishing vessel with momentum-based physics controls. Sail endlessly in any direction across abstract, colorful, and relaxing ocean waves.

Catch the fish

Track fish by their mesmerizing songs. Drop anchor and fish with a single button. The reflex-based fishing minigame is easy to learn—yet hard to perfect.

Battle the reaper

Beware the certain death which lurks beneath! Catch fish to awaken it, stun it, and strengthen its resolve. Only through death will you survive longer.

An accessible experience

Fishyphus provides a tutorial, high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, haptic feedback, adjustable difficulty settings, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.
detailed_description:
Fishyphus is a horror fishing roguelite which rewards careful navigation, quick reflexes, and persistence. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones.

Sail the waves

Take command of a fishing vessel with momentum-based physics controls. Sail endlessly in any direction across abstract, colorful, and relaxing ocean waves.

Catch the fish

Track fish by their mesmerizing songs. Drop anchor and fish with a single button. The reflex-based fishing minigame is easy to learn—yet hard to perfect.

Battle the reaper

Beware the certain death which lurks beneath! Catch fish to awaken it, stun it, and strengthen its resolve. Only through death will you survive longer.

An accessible experience

Fishyphus provides a tutorial, high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, haptic feedback, adjustable difficulty settings, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.

about_the_game:
The protagonist wakes up and finds himself trapped in a bird cage.

He doesn't remember why he is here,

why he was locked in the birdcage,

or even who he is in the first place.

Strangely enough, the key to unlock the birdcage has fallen at his feet.

He opens the key and explores the terrifying and strange Western-style house,

searching for himself and the way to escape from this Western-style house .....

◆◆◆◆◆

Play time is About 30 minutes to 2 hours.

Live action, distribution, and derivative works are welcome.

Some of the content is based on true stories experienced by the author.

◆◆◆◆◆

In addition to the normal ending, there are 6 BADEND

【Controls】

Space, Enter Z button: Decide, fast forward

X button: Open menu screen, cancel

ASDW key: Move character

Shift key: Dash

◆◆◆◆◆

When installing the game, you will be given a choice of startup options. For the Japanese version, please select [Play before you get trapped by the black lily], and for the English version, please select [English ver].

The only difference between the two is the initial display language, which can be changed after installation by going to [Settings] > [Language].

  • Rare – 9%

  • Epic – 0.9%

  • Legendary – 0.1%

These drops are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay, but offer a fun incentive for collectors and completionists alike.

about_the_game:
A man sits alone in a shack, deep in thought. Back and forth through the years his mind wanders. Forever a craftsman, he starts carving a mask. And as he looks at it, he remembers…

Unmasked: An Inner Journey is an emotion-driven adventure platformer that takes you on an extraordinary journey of self-discovery. You play as a manifestation of a mind fighting inner fears and painful memories. As you delve into the Craftsman’s consciousness, you will help him accept his past, ultimately finding closure.



The story of Unmasked: An Inner Journey is told without dialogue. Instead, the narrative unfolds through a series of carefully crafted vignettes that hint at events from the Craftsman’s past. The game explores themes of memory and identity, aiming to immerse the player in a state of longing and reflection.

While the game’s focus is its emotional impact and story, Unmasked: An Inner Journey blends action, puzzles, and chase sequences to achieve it. You will fight creatures that eerily resemble your hero, use wind gusts and giant machines to overcome various obstacles and confront monsters that guard the deepest secrets of the Craftsman’s psyche.

Unmasked: An Inner Journey features 5 distinct levels, each brought to life with beautiful artwork, immersive soundscape, and captivating music.

Key Features

  • A Story That Stays With You. Experience a touching tale of a life remembered. The emotionally charged narrative is conveyed entirely through visuals, music, and character vignettes — no dialogue needed.
  • A Beautiful World to Explore. Unmasked: An Inner Journey offers vividly colored, meticulously crafted levels that become windows into the Craftsman's inner world. From the shimmering beauty of a sunlit river to the cold darkness of forgotten caves, these small worlds will stay with you.
  • Psychology with a Punch. Run, jump, fight, and solve puzzles that test your skills and reflexes. While Unmasked isn’t meant to be a difficult game, it still provides a satisfying challenge.
  • Gorgeous Music. Nothing puts you in a reflective mood quite like music. Unmasked: An Inner Journey features an original soundtrack, with tracks ranging from soothing to bittersweet, perfectly complementing the story.

about_the_game:
This demo version includes only the first two levels, while the rest of the content is the same as the full version.

"Spin Foward" is a relaxing and casual roguelike slot-building game. It combines elements from Lucky Landlord and Slay the Spire, simplifying the mechanics. In the game, players only need to press the spacebar to experience exponential growth in game stats, delivering an exhilarating sensation of conquering everything in seconds. While pay-to-win games may require thousands or tens of thousands of dollars for the thrill of drawing an legend card, here you can feel that excitement by defeating just a few monsters.

Getting bored easily? Not at all. There are over 200 (in the demo phase) bizarre and unique runes and relics for you to mix and explore. You can use a helmet rune to stun monsters, use a shoe rune to kick them away, turn monsters into sheep with a staff, freeze them with a frozen staff, summon slimes, poison your weapons, and even get an automatic robot to turn the game into an idle experience. There's also a catapult, daggers, throwing knives, bows, dice, potions... Still not enough? The game even includes an 8-bit gaming system where you can collect cartridges to play mini-games.

Features:

  • Collect and combine symbols and relics with various abilities. Defeat monsters and bosses along the adventure path.

  • Click Spin to start the slot machine and randomly generate combinations of symbols. Combined with different relics, this will produce varying attack and defense outcomes.

  • Use specific symbols to create special effects on enemies. For example, the Shepherd's Staff can turn a target enemy into a sheep.

  • Explore a new map every time, with different symbols and relics, enemies and events, and and surprises along the way.

about_the_game:
Idle Pay-to-Win Mobile Game Simulator
Ever dreamed of experiencing the thrill of popular idle pay - to - win mobile games without spending real money? Idle Pay - to - Win Mobile Game Simulator is the perfect fit for you!

No need for actual recharges. You can still enjoy the pay - to - win - level excitement of skyrocketing combat power and full - screen item drops. Enter redemption codes like VIP666 and VIP777 at the start, and luxurious gifts will be yours instantly for a smooth - sailing, thrilling gameplay!

It not only immersively simulates the exciting gameplay of idle mobile games but also precisely captures the core experience of “your time is extremely valuable”. It's a great way to relax and start an addictive idle journey anytime. Come and experience it on Steam right away!

Core Gameplay Highlights

1. Simulate Real - Player Competition and Recreate Mobile Game Ecosystem

  • World BOSS and Competitive Ranking: Challenge the World BOSS, strive for a high rank in the competition, and fight for rare resources. It reproduces the intense sense of player competition in pay - to - win mobile games 1:1, letting you experience the most authentic “mobile game ecosystem” and see who can dominate the leaderboard!

2. Skyrocketing Combat Power + Map Looting, Full of Excitement

  • Rocket - like Combat Power Surge: No need for in - game purchases. Achieve a crazy breakthrough in combat power through strategic combinations and cultivating spirit beings. The 数值 growth with red numbers flashing all over the screen will fully immerse you in the excitement!

  • Map Looting + Idle Sweeping: Monsters drop abundant items. After clearing specific levels, you can “sweep the map”. Even when idling, you can collect rewards regularly! The higher the level, the more amazing the rewards. Who can resist the feeling of collecting resources while relaxing?

3. Summon Spirit Beings + Combine Synergies, Full of Strategy and Nostalgia

  • Summon Ancient and Modern Spirit Beings: Gather ancient Chinese spirit beings to fight side by side! From Guan Yu and Zhao Yun of the Three Kingdoms, Wu Song and Yan Qing of the Water Margin, Yang Jian and Nezha of myths, to Zhang Liang, Xiang Yu, and Hua Mulan in history... So many classic figures will evoke your nostalgia!

  • Combine Synergies + Strengthen and Cultivate: Different spirit beings can trigger exclusive synergy effects when combined. Strengthen and upgrade the spirit beings to create your own “overpowered team”. Strategic combinations determine the upper limit of your combat effectiveness!

4. Array Assistance + Exciting Lottery, Multi - dimensional Gameplay Expansion

  • Nine Types of Arrays, Strategize: There are 9 types of arrays with different effects built - in. Switch arrays according to different enemies and “arrange troops and deploy formations” to achieve miraculous combat results, maximizing the strategic depth!

  • Exciting Lottery, Everyone Can Be a Lucky Dog: Want to draw prizes but afraid of “going bankrupt from recharges”? Here, lottery tickets can be obtained for free by “grinding”! Enter WOSHIDALAO (I'm the Boss) at the start and get 100 free draws directly! Everyone can be a “lottery lucky dog” and enjoy the treatment of a boss as soon as you log in!

5. Research Technologies + Infinite New Games, Super Replayable

  • 68 Types of Technologies, Free Research: There are 4 categories and 68 researchable technologies designed. Whether you want to focus on “maximizing drop rates” (full - screen drops in the later stage, one monster drops a full set of items), “fast - paced combat clearance” (clear levels quickly and get a head start in the next new game), or “idle and win” (strengthen idle rewards, a delight for lazy players), there's always a technology suitable for your playstyle!

  • Infinite New Games, More Fun Each Time: All gameplay progress (tasks, kills, equipment, collections, lottery times...) will be converted into “start - up points” and inherited to the next new game after clearing the current one! Use the points to directly start the “high - speed level - clearing mode”, clearing one level per second and skipping the development stage. Each new game is a “peak start”, and the more you play, the more enjoyable it gets. Your combat power will always be on the “road to becoming overpowered”!

6. Collect Collections + Upgrade Artifacts, In - depth Cultivation

  • Collect Collections, Strategize to Defeat Enemies: Each monster has unique skills. Collect collections to “know yourself and your enemies”, and combine lineups, synergies, and arrays to achieve “victory in every battle”, a paradise for strategy lovers!

  • Upgrade Artifacts, Forge Divine Equipment: As a spirit master, you can upgrade artifacts to forge equipment of 10 major qualities and infinite levels, with attribute stats maxed out! Each point of “luck attribute” can also increase the monster drop rate, making “full - screen drops” easily achievable. The excitement of cultivation and looting is doubled!

what Kind Of Game Is This?


DongBeiZhiXia (a summer in the northeast of China)is a free visual novel, which tells the story that the protagonist followed parents' wishes to make one's living in Shenyang, met two online anchors Huniu and Daojiang by chance, and experience affairs one after another with Shamate.

What are the highlights of this work?



During preparatory stage, I selected CVs suitable for each role from more than 20 CVs registered

Among them, there are some veteran voice actors who have been in their career for more than ten years, and there are also some interns in the dubbing studio.

And some of the voice actors are native northeasterners of China.

Most of the backgrounds images in the game were illustrated according to the landscape of Shenyang.

Compared with the previous video version, the game includes additional scenes, CG, and enhanced visual effects.

More stories behind the scenes about the game can be searched in Bilibili

about_the_game:
This is the stand-alone sequel to the survival horror thriller Heaven Dust (it is not mandatory to play the previous game to enjoy this one).

After a press conference, a virus outbreak happens in the mysterious First Research Center.
In the meantime, deep inside the institute, Steve wakes up from his cryogenic pod.
He finds himself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by zombies, again.
He must fight his way out even when the dreadful truth is also approaching...

"Are you ready to escape from hell again, Steve?
Or should I call you... 'Second Host'."

  • Classic survival horror genre, featuring exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management.
  • Enhanced production value: Better graphics and effects, providing a brand new experience for players of the first game. Twice the content of the first game, prepare to embark on a 10-hour journey!
  • Collect and combine, use various items to solve puzzles. Upgrade your inventory. Weapons no longer occupy space.
  • Evolved combat system: Fight your way out with a dagger, submachine gun, shotgun, and grenades. Modify your weapons, upgrade them to the limit. Choose your weapon to counter different enemies, plan your strategy, seek their weak points, and destroy their defenses.
  • Except for ordinary zombies, all kinds of mutated monsters had joined the battle too: Heavily armored Bone Fiend, regenerating Blood Fiend, approaching boomlad. And, of course, epic boss fights.
  • Engaging plot, fun brain teasers. Players need to make an ultimate choice: Two escape routes will lead you to two different endings.
  • Casual, Normal, and Expert difficulties for you to choose, suited to all players.

Bloody Heaven 2 is a rogue-like action game with Rune-build feature. Based on 4 basic actions: light attack, heavy attack, skill and dodge , you will assign runes in your weapon among slots of these 4 actions to build your battle style.



Slash Into Hell

As the Revenge Agent of Heaven, you will be able to use more than 3 classes, 12 types of weapon to slash among demons.

4 Chapters, over 20 types of monsters

Growing Power of Weapon

Kill demons to collect gems, and then turn gems into rune inlays for your weapon. The runes could provide various of new abilities to contribute to your battle style.

Death Is Beginning

If you die in a fight, the weapon is also lost with all the runes inlay. Your can start another challenge and if lucky enough, you could find the lost weapon.

Permanent Upgrade

Win or lose, when you reborn back to heaven, all the gems you collect along the way will turn to dust. Make use of these dust to unlock permanent upgrade.

about_the_game:
A game of "arcane" strategies

"Arcano: The Trickery" is a trading card game that revolves around magic, nature, alchemy and fantasy themes. You can personalize your deck full of arcane treasures and spells, play against the computer to improve your skills or engage into online battles against other "alchemists" like you in order to receive prizes! Master the power of the elements and alchemy to defeat your opponents.
The game can be very tactic since most of your cards lay face-down on the table until you decide when it's time to use them. Most of the opponent's cards are face-down too, so you have to wisely choose your strategy since some of them may hide special effects that could potentially change the momentum of the game.

Simple rules

The rules are quite simple: the first player who accumulates 20 points wins. To achieve that you have to compare your own cards with the opponent ones. Every card has its own "value" which will grant you points, but of course they also have a "cost" in order to be played. Cards are also "linked" to 7 different elements: Earth, Water, Air and Fire (the 4 elements of nature) plus Sun, Moon and Occult.

Many cards, different effects

"Arcano" is a game in constant development since more cards can be added in future expansions. The starting pack will include a collection of about 80 cards with unique characteristics. Many more cards are going to be programmed to better enjoy the game.
Collect them all!

about_the_game:
Did you know that Minesweeper in Windows versions below 8 wasn't uninstalled like other programs? It was a "Windows Feature" and you had to go through extra steps to remove it from a computer back then. I know because I needed to know, or I might not have graduated. Now I've relapsed and made the version of Minesweeper that I've always wanted. One that I can sink hours into a single game and still have more to go. An endless mine field.

And for that, I apologize to my fellow Minesweeper addicts. (Sorry, not sorry)

Play on an endless field of mines or try a challenge mode if you want a more finite experience.
  • Blitz mode is a race to complete a number of chunks, the building blocks of each field; how well can you stay on target?
  • Time Trial pits you against the timer to see how many points you can earn before time runs.
  • In Survival mode, your score decays over time. Keep earning points to stay alive.
  • Classic mode lets you play a more finite field, up to 128 x 128.

Customize the look and feel of the game with different themes or flags. Turn off chording if you're a purist (there's also flag chording). Swap the mouse buttons if you're weird.

And yes, there are still 50/50 situations. I can't prevent them. BUT there is way around guessing: defusers. Earn defusers through consistent good play and you can use one to safely click any cell. If it was a mine, it goes away.

In Emojis Battle, you will battle against the renowned Bluemojis to save your kingdom. Take on the role of the Yellow Emojis and triumph in this year-long conflict between the Blue and Yellow Emojis, ignited by the king of the once-united lands refusing to grant the Bluemojis their own national day.

about_the_game:
In the second installment of the Stories of Submission anthology we open on William who expects more from his new life after a year of being Mistress Freyja's servant. Freyja tells him the story of Alex and Stacy to remind him that being needy and demanding makes for a bad sub.

Alex is the spoiled man-child of rich parents who has never made anything of himself. Cripplingly self-aware, he can't maintain friendships or relationships and goes from one woman to the next. That all changes when he starts dating Stacy. For once, a woman sees past his pickup persona and doesn't leave him immediately. What Alex doesn't realize is that Stacy has a hidden side as well and she's about to teach him a harsh lesson.

Features:

■ A fascinating story about NTR/cuckoldry and the kind of pathetic men who crave it.

■ Numerous sex scenes where the main character gets only to watch or listen.

■ Several Endings. Which one's the 'good' ending is up to you.

Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends! 
Discover a brand new world filled with amazing creatures, and set out to find the strongest. Test your skills in battle against other players with our battling system, designed to be easy to learn, yet hard to master. Train your creatures by levelling them up and select the moves you think work best for your playstyle.

Battle other players or other creatures in our combat gameplay! Put your skills to the test and aim to be the greatest!

Build your collection and customize their movesets to give you the exact creature you want to use. Tailor each one to your playstyle and level them up on your way to the very top!

Traverse the ingame world either alone or with your friends! Meet up in various towns or take each other on inside the Stadium! Find new and exciting creatures in the different biomes and discover hidden secrets.

The game features many social features such as Proximity Voice Chat and Trading inorder to enhance the multiplayer experience.

about_the_game:
Constructed between 1904 and 1920, the Victorian Railways DD/D1 class locomotives were designed as a mixed traffic locomotive, with capabilities of also hauling mainline passenger services. Eventually numbering 260 members, the DD class locomotives were constructed by both the Victorian Railways and outside locomotive builders, such as the Phoenix Foundry in Ballarat, the Baldwin Locomotive works in the USA, and others. The design evolved quickly, resulting in 5 major variations to the DD class, the fourth being the most recognized with the wide Canadian Cab and high running boards, which would be continued with the type 5 (superheated type 4) locos, and carried on when some members were rebuilt as D2 and D3 class locomotives.

This pack covers the Type 4 D1 class locomotives built by the Victorian Railways Newport Workshops betwen 1904 and 1920, in the all over black livery introduced in the 1920s, and worn by the class until their demise, classed as D1 as running in the 1930s through till the early 1950s, and as fitted with the distinctive VR 5 chime whistle.

VR D1 T4 Black 1 Npt - fitted with older style Serrif number plates, and Serrif style class plates, covering various numbers from 500 to 668, with a total of 51 numbers.

VR D1 T4 Black 2 Npt - fitted with newer style Sans Serrif style number plates, and Serrif style class plates, covering various numbers from 500 to 697, with a total of 39 numbers.


Features include:

  • 2 locomotives and tenders, with three optional levels of weathering (changed via the properties menu), in broad gauge
  • Down Passenger session with both locomotives agailable, with free roam option after completion
  • 6 pre-made consists, including light engine, goods, and passenger consists for both versions.
  • Texture swapping with clean, lightly weathered and heavy weathered options, each with individual specular maps and reflection maps to match the weathering
  • Scripted, animated, reverser and valve gear in exterior and interior views
  • LOD on all meshes
  • Scripted exhaust smoke effects, based off regulator and cut-off
  • Scripted and animated air compressor, with sound and smoke effects
  • Scripted cylinder drain effects toggled by ALT + D, and based off the steam chest pressure
  • Other Scripted steam and sound effects including injectors, and blower
  • Animated screwlink couplers, brake hoses/taps, and safety chains using ACS
  • Scripted Marker Lamps and Tail discs, with glow lamps (thanks to Bloodnok) - compatible with the VR Set Train Lamps driver command
  • Animated cab doors, cab windows, cab roof vent, weather tarp, smokebox door, and tender tank filler lid
  • Cab doors, windows and roof vent can be controlled from inside the cab as well as via the properties window.
  • Weather tarp matches in cab view and exterior view
  • Full custom interior view, with operational controls
  • Physique based coal load animation in tender, giving realistic deformation as coal is used
  • Automatic Numbering, with automatic tender numbering, with normals mapped number plates and matching builders plates (92 numbers available)
  • Snow mesh, using the snow altitude function in Trainz

Explore the opening of the shattered world of Eyjusheim and experience the core gameplay systems of this third-person, souls-like action RPG.

about_the_game:
This free demo contains some introductory content from the full version of Backseat Drivers.

You’re two hapless road-users in the world’s least roadworthy car, and you have a long, long drive ahead of you. The driver can’t see where they’re going. The passenger can see, but can’t drive, and desperately shouts directions from the back seat. All while the car falls to pieces and the world does everything it can to ruin your day.

Have an nice trip!

Gramma take the wheel! As the driver, you have to contend with the car working as hard as it can against you and listen to your passenger if you’ll have any chance of reaching your destination.

Ohhhh boy. Only the passenger can see where the car’s going, so you’re both at gramma’s mercy. Clear communication is key to keep the car from crashing!

Smash, shunt, and crash your way through one big detour of a journey taking you up mountains, down subway tunnels, onto insane highways and through secret government facilities.

Left! Left! No, RIGHT! Stop stop STOP!! The couple that jives together drives together. If the passenger gives good directions (and the driver can follow them) you’re guaranteed a smooth and blissful cruise. But when something goes wrong — which it will — it’s both of your faults.

The car may be an ancient piece of junk, but they don’t make ‘em like they used to. Every component is swappable with something else. No brake pedal? No problem. Just snap a cassette tape where the pedal used to be. Good as new!

Learn mindfulness meditation and breath based meditation – take our 4 step guided Virtual Reality tour. Each module teaches and expands your meditative skills using The VR environment to maximise your experience and learning.

Our balloon module teaches you about mindful body breathing and guides you through a meditative practice.

The other two modules develop and extend these meditative skills and teach you to practice your meditation and visualisation skills.

Once you have mastered the basics you are ready for the lake house and the sky garden our extended relaxation experiences and growth based visualisation.

about_the_game:
Last Wings is a fast-paced and dynamic air combat game, developed in a combined 2D and 3D environment.

Play alone or as a team member. In local mode you can create a team of up to 4 players. In online mode you can create a team of up to 10 players, and challenge the greatest competitors to a battle.



The game features 3 different planes with the following characteristics:

  • The Silver Bullet: This is an agile and fast, though vulnerable, plane with average firepower.
  • The Hawk: Inspired by World War I planes, it can withstand missiles and bombs and has a rapid fire rate.
  • The War Jumbo: This is a military cargo plane, capable of withstanding multiple attacks without losing strength. It has the highest resistance and firepower.

You can customize the weapons for each plane depending on your goals, making each battle a unique experience.

The game has 4 modes:

  • Score Attack: Individual combat, every man for himself, the winner is the player who manages to shoot down the most airplanes.
  • Team Fight: Team combat, the winner is the team that shoots down the most airplanes.
  • Team Fight Rounds: Team combat in rounds. Each plane has only one life per round, the winner is the team that wins more rounds.
  • Base Attack: Combat between teams, the winner is the team that first destroys the central enemy base.

about_the_game:
“Chymicalia - Change is Possible!”

So reads the glowing sign outside the suspicious door that just appeared out of nowhere between two boarded-up buildings on the rough side of town.

An ordinary Yorkshire town, like any other... but not for long.

Because Chymicalia is a sentient alchemy shop, roving across the cosmos, trapping one poor soul after another as its unwilling servant.

For the last ten years, that servant has been you.

But now you’re here, back in the town you thought you'd never see again, and maybe somehow, this time, things are going to change.

Make potions! Make friends! Make terrible mistakes!

Chymicalia is an alchemy sim with a choice-driven narrative, where you talk to customers, listen to their troubles and attempt to create a potion that will solve their problems. Or at least, give them different problems.

However, Chymicalia is a sentient shop, with its own sinister agenda for its customers. Keeping everyone satisfied isn't going to be easy.

Is change really possible, in this hopeless town? Can you really help any of these people change their lives?

And even if you do... who’s going to help you change yours?

about_the_game:
Your pod has been captured by a cruel marine park - only you can rescue all the orcas to reunite your family!

SWIM FOREVER


In this "Endless Swimmer" game, you play an orca swimming through the ocean, catching fish and avoiding dangers. The simple one-button controls are easy for anyone to learn!

EXPLORE VIBRANT BIOMES


Your journey starts in a beautiful coral reef, but the quest to save your pod from cruel SlamWharf will bring you across the seas. Discover new food (and dangers) as you progress on your missions.

RESCUE YOUR POD


Unlock 4 unique playable orcas - each has different skills, swimming stats, and personality traits. Bring your family together!

COMPLETE CHALLENGES


Through dozens of unique missions, master the seas to level up your character and unlock new sights. The challenge doesn't stop there - several stats are also tracked for each swim, so you can always increase your high scores.

UNLOCK COOL POWERUPS


Grab powerups from helpful bubbles to slow time, gain lives, shatter obstacles, and more! Catch 6 fish in a row and your orca will gain a special boost. Plus, as you level up, additional powerups become available, so there's always more to explore.

about_the_game:
Challenging Platforming!


Jump, dash and ground pound your way through everything the island can throw at you. Explore deserts, jungles, glaciers, caves, clouds and the depths of hell!

Loads of boss fights!


Dance Fights, Sidescrollers, and Spaceship battles await. Whether you’re running from a moustached killer robot or swimming through the caverns of electric eels, there’s always something right around the corner!

Meet the islanders!


After leaving the humble Clementine Market in search of the Sanguinicon, you realise there’s more to this island than you thought. Steal eggs from an eel, make friends with immortal picnickers and overthrow the tyrannical Gabriel.

Highlights

  • BAFTA YGD finalist game
  • Comedic single-player adventure, featuring a cast of eccentric characters
  • Hardcore precision-platforming over a collection of worlds
  • Unpredictable boss fights span genres from bullet hell to rhythm game
  • A soundtrack that begs to be whistled!

about_the_game:
ABOUT THE DEMO

Try out the Demo for a limited version of the full experience!

The demo includes full multiplayer support - play solo or with up to 4 players, just like in the full game.

All equipment is unlocked, so you can jump right in and get a proper feel for the mechanics. However, storage expansion is locked, meaning you can’t unlock additional warehouse space. Some items will also be restricted, so while you’ll get a solid glimpse of the full gameplay, higher-tier items will remain locked.

Progression is limited - there’s a cap on how many in-game days you can advance, and there’s no save system. Once you exit, you’ll have to start fresh.

ABOUT THE GAME

Storage Guys is a casual multiplayer co-op game where you and your friends take on the role of storage crew.


Your job is to receive items at the input ports, sort and organize them in your warehouse, and ship them out through the correct output ports. Every successful shipment makes you money! Each item is labeled with an output region, so you’ll need to sort and ship them to the matching output ports. But watch out for expiration dates, you need to send items out before they expire!



Manage a wide variety of incoming items, each with its own storage needs. Some require extra care, while others are easier to handle. Use specialized storage rooms called compounds to handle items with specific storing requirements, such as Freezer, Hazard, and UV compounds.



Hire and manage AI workers to assist with item handling, boosting productivity and automating your storage workflow. Manage the power room and ensure you have enough fuel for the engines to keep your storage running.


Access the Shop through the Storage Terminal to purchase Shelves, Compounds, Equipment, and Decorations for your storage. Customize your storage to enhance functionality and improve its look.

about_the_game:
Hollow ghost is a game in which you do not need to think much, your task is to fight monsters, ghosts and various enemies until you get to the boss level himself.
Your task is to destroy the birthplaces of enemies, destroy all enemies on the map and finally destroy the boss. After this completion, another level will be available to you.
Enjoy a nice lit and graphically processed environment in the fog, darkness, which looks like drawn horror environment.

Game Features


  • Classic side-scrolling action with all modern decorations.
  • Tightly tuned 2D controls that are controlled by stamina. Avoid, block with the shield, race and chop your way through even the deadliest opponents.
  • 2 types of attack, block shield and different jump heights.
  • Create your own hero and make your journey unique!
  • Over 10,000 options to create the main character from skin color through weapons, shields, armor.
  • Cast of cute and scary characters that have been revived by traditional 2D graphics.
  • Different types of enemies as well as different epic bosses.
  • You can destroy the walls of the game and this is how you can make the game easier.
  • First aid kits are located on the map, help yourself with them!

Do You Like Fighting Games? So Try Hollow Ghost!


More Levels, Enemies and Bosses Coming Soon!

about_the_game:
[Desert Mercenary corps] is an open-world sandbox adventure role-playing game. Players can recruit various types of partners in the game to build their own strongest mercenary group.


In the Monchi Desert, players will experience the entire construction process of the mercenary group, from recruitment, training to command operations, players need to carefully plan.


In addition to building and managing mercenary groups, players can also explore a variety of scenes, fight fiercely with various monsters in mysterious caves, and reveal the secrets hidden in them. Unlocking the mysterious tomb is also an important task, requiring players to use wisdom and skills to solve puzzles.


As a group leader, it is also crucial to meet the needs of partners. They may have various expectations and needs. While ensuring their comfortable lives, they also need to consider how to improve their combat effectiveness.


Traveling in the desert maze is an even more arduous task. The maze is intricate and full of dangers, and it is easy to get lost here. Therefore, it is necessary to find an oasis in this vast land.



In addition, it is also very important to arrange the positions of the players and choose the right equipment when setting up the formation. Only through a reasonable layout can you win a refreshing victory!

about_the_game:
Meet Cars Arena — a glorious far-future futuristic deathmatch action game with battle cars.

In the not-so-distant 25th century, the biggest show is RC car battles, watched and enjoyed by billions. Use different weapons, customize your car, explore the Arena, be the first to defeat your enemies and get the grandest prize of all — glory!
Challenge your friends to a battle, or find random opponents and show them who’s boss!
Battle cars can be equipped with classic weapons (machine gun, shotgun, laser gun, railgun, gatling gun and rocket launcher), each having a secondary firing mode.
Find the Rage pickup and turn the game around, soaring to the top of the rating with a temporary 4x damage boost.

Start a game with 1 to 7 opponents, find the best weapon (from machine gun to railgun), grab health and armor pickups and score the most kills.

Cars Arena is evolving and we can't wait to present you a new content: new game modes, cars and weapons customization.

Cars Arena is a FFA shooter for 2 to 8 players.

about_the_game:
DISCLAIMER:
This game's controls are pretty complex! Getting the hang of movement may be difficult. Play at your own risk! Check out the boxedworks YouTube channel to see some gameplay.

Physics-based movement
Playing this game is more than just running and jumping! Movement is feel-based in Rocket Cave Adventure- you'll have to master the controls and weight of each vehicle to be able to traverse deeper and deeper into the caves.

Brand new adventures
Explore procedurally generated levels every time you start a run! With each area bigger and stranger than the last, you'll have to pay attention to your surroundings to survive!

Randomized skill tree
Throughout each run, you will be given a skill tree that will be populated with different skills each time you play! However, you won't know the skills you are given until you unlock them by collecting enough XP from enemies- so don't rush too fast through the levels.

Meta progression
Gather mana throughout your runs and spend it on long-term upgrades back at the starting hub. Unlock new vehicles and skills in the hub!

about_the_game:
SAFA is a narrative-driven, third-person survival horror game. The endings as well as story change based on your decisions in each play through with every end of the game being open to player choice. There are no save states or autosaves in the demo so please be mindful and don't die. Death automatically leads to the demo restarting.  

Meet the town's people, explore a lovingly crafted environment, and scavenge for resources as you try to make your way to your son. Mina and her son were stranded on a desolate road after a car crash. Having passed out after it, Mina awoke to her son nowhere in sight. Now she searches through the closest town for signs of life and asks around for where he might be. 

Explore the town, knock on peoples doors and see if they answer. Search through a highly detailed environment created by a single person and navigate your way through your own senses. The demo for SAFA focuses highly on player engagement and is designed as a mix of old school horror and modern day horror games with a focus on player agency. Engage with the town's people and see what they want from you in return for helping you. Combat against unique enemies with each designed around the classic folklore stories they are based on. 

The demo is expected to take between 15 minutes to an hour to experience depending on your choices. You can take a number of approaches to get to your end goal or learn about the town and its history. Mina makes notes of things she finds as well as the creatures in her compendium. 

Whilst you are able to help NPCs and escort them to safe areas in the full game, this is not available in the demo. The demo takes place after Mina has awoken from the accident and ends once you've reached the school or the first boss fight.

about_the_game:
Become Ignis, a special coal tasked with liberating the world of Orbis, recently overrun by forces of darkness. Luckily, it just so happens that you're trained in the art of mortal combat! Learn how to fight, upgrade your abilities, venture through increasingly hostile worlds, and restore the Eternal Flame.

Adapt and take on enemies using a multitude of moves and attacks including punch combos, fiery dashes, wide area-of-effect stomps, and powerful finishers that deal decisive damage. But don't get too reckless - smart stamina usage is essential. Each biome in Flame Keeper is inhabited by unique foes and obstacles of increasing difficulty. Consult the trusty Bestiary as you unlock insight into the strengths and weaknesses of your enemies.

It's not enough to let your fists do the talking. Sometimes... you need a little pick-me-up. Upgrade Ignis to your heart's desire via skills and passive abilities. Collect seeds from defeated enemies to learn new skills and complete specific tasks to receive runes and unlock helpful passive abilities. Mix and match to create tons of different builds!

To restore the Eternal Flame, you must scour each environment for what remains of its energy and transfer it back into each stage's Fire Camp. Here's the twist: the energy you collect also acts as your health. You need to deplete it to charge up each Fire Camp, but you also have to stay healthy to explore ever deeper. Find the right balance and discover your best way to play.

At the start of each level lies Vulpis Village. The Vulpis are friends to a brave charcoal like yourself, so they're happy to provide a service. Here you can rest, enhance abilities, rebuild and upgrade structures thanks to the resources you collect. The village changes along with your progress and opens up all-new gameplay features each time.

about_the_game:
"Outlaws vs Aliens" is an innovative puzzle-shooter game that cleverly blends the rugged charm of the Wild West with sci-fi elements, creating an uniquely entertaining gaming experience. Set against the backdrop of a desert landscape complete with iconic cacti, red rock formations, and mysterious UFOs hovering in the vibrant sky, this game challenges players to think strategically while enjoying its distinctive art style.

The game's core mechanic revolves around a fascinating "less is more" principle, as indicated by its in-game message "The fewer shots you fire, the more stars you get." Players control a cowboy character who must carefully plan each shot to maximize efficiency and achieve the highest possible score. This scoring system encourages players to think carefully about their strategy rather than simply shooting at everything in sight.

Each level presents different challenges, from destroying ice blocks to dealing with alien enemies positioned at various heights and behind different obstacles. The game features an intricate physics system where players must consider angles, timing, and environmental elements to succeed. Metal structures, platforms, and various obstacles add layers of complexity to each puzzle, requiring players to think creatively about how to reach their objectives with minimal shots.

The visual design deserves special mention, featuring a stunning art style that combines Western aesthetics with retro sci-fi elements. The desert environment is painted in warm oranges and reds, contrasting beautifully with the cool blue sky and the otherworldly purple UFOs. The attention to detail in the background, from the layered mountain ranges to the scattered desert vegetation, creates an immersive atmosphere that enhances the gaming experience.

The game's progression system is based on a three-star rating, common in mobile puzzle games but implemented here with a unique twist. Instead of awarding stars for completion speed or point totals, players earn them by being conservative with their ammunition. This clever mechanic adds a fresh strategic layer to the familiar format, encouraging players to replay levels to find the most efficient solutions.

about_the_game:
Welcome to join our QQ group: 519072161 to discuss games together.

Game Introduction

"Detective Master's House" is a real-life detective puzzle game. You will play the role of detective "Henry", shuttle through the murder scenes of various Blizzard Mountains, and investigate each intricate case in depth. In Manor Mystery, you will experience the twists and turns of the murder and find out the ugly truth behind the death of the owner of the Rose Manor in the back room!

Gameplay

  • Search evidence
    In order to gain clues to the case, you will visit the crime scene to search for evidence and solve ingenious puzzles. Don't miss every clue of the scene! Those seemingly ordinary objects, under reasonable logical reasoning, may become irrefutable evidence to lock the real murderer!

  • information
    Is it a confusing lie? Or the unmistakable truth? Carefully examine the confessions of the suspects and capture the keyword information that the case really needs. This is the foundation of a detective!

  • reasoning
    When complex and interrelated fragmented clues are in front of you, how to connect them to form a complete logical chain to make correct inferences? Everything needs to use your strong logical reasoning ability!

  • Destroy the murderer
    You have seen the truth of the case, but the culprit has denied it. Use your ingenious and astonishing reasoning to bring out his irrefutable hard evidence and smash his undisguised lies!

  • Replay
    When the real culprit is reported, this is not the final victory. Step-by-step interpretation of the details of the case, to verify whether your reasoning is accurate, to restore the complicated and confusing truth of the case!

Game Features

  • Immersive detective tour
    Real-life case detection, on-site evidence collection, and trial of suspects... Rich reasoning links, in-depth experience of the whole process of a detective's case detection.

  • Complicated cases
    The logic of the case is rigorous, the case is ups and downs, the classic case of Blizzard Mountain Villa, and experience the original reasoning.

  • Featured reasoning system
    The visualization of the reasoning logic chain can help you clarify your thoughts in the complex clues, and find the real culprit.

About our studio

We are "Ji Xiang Ru Yi", an independent game studio from Chengdu. There are currently four team members, two planners, one program, and one artist.
The inspiration for making this game came from an accidental whim when playing a script to kill. How about turning these evidence-gathering links into actual scenarios? Can you restore every link of the detective's case-solving in a more immersive way?

detailed_description:
Welcome to join our QQ group: 519072161 to discuss games together.

Game Introduction

"Detective Master's House" is a real-life detective puzzle game. You will play the role of detective "Henry", shuttle through the murder scenes of various Blizzard Mountains, and investigate each intricate case in depth. In Manor Mystery, you will experience the twists and turns of the murder and find out the ugly truth behind the death of the owner of the Rose Manor in the back room!

Gameplay

  • Search evidence
    In order to gain clues to the case, you will visit the crime scene to search for evidence and solve ingenious puzzles. Don't miss every clue of the scene! Those seemingly ordinary objects, under reasonable logical reasoning, may become irrefutable evidence to lock the real murderer!

  • information
    Is it a confusing lie? Or the unmistakable truth? Carefully examine the confessions of the suspects and capture the keyword information that the case really needs. This is the foundation of a detective!

  • reasoning
    When complex and interrelated fragmented clues are in front of you, how to connect them to form a complete logical chain to make correct inferences? Everything needs to use your strong logical reasoning ability!

  • Destroy the murderer
    You have seen the truth of the case, but the culprit has denied it. Use your ingenious and astonishing reasoning to bring out his irrefutable hard evidence and smash his undisguised lies!

  • Replay
    When the real culprit is reported, this is not the final victory. Step-by-step interpretation of the details of the case, to verify whether your reasoning is accurate, to restore the complicated and confusing truth of the case!

Game Features

  • Immersive detective tour
    Real-life case detection, on-site evidence collection, and trial of suspects... Rich reasoning links, in-depth experience of the whole process of a detective's case detection.

  • Complicated cases
    The logic of the case is rigorous, the case is ups and downs, the classic case of Blizzard Mountain Villa, and experience the original reasoning.

  • Featured reasoning system
    The visualization of the reasoning logic chain can help you clarify your thoughts in the complex clues, and find the real culprit.

About our studio

We are "Ji Xiang Ru Yi", an independent game studio from Chengdu. There are currently four team members, two planners, one program, and one artist.
The inspiration for making this game came from an accidental whim when playing a script to kill. How about turning these evidence-gathering links into actual scenarios? Can you restore every link of the detective's case-solving in a more immersive way?
When I first came up with this idea, every member of the team was very excited. Although everyone had never tried a puzzle-solving game, everyone played Ace Attorney and watched The Kindaichi Case Files grow up.
We spent a lot of time on this product, from project approval to a little bit of implementation, we painfully found that the game we made was quite different from the original imagination. After two or three overthrows and redoes, it finally ended in face is presented before you.

I would like to thank every friend in the studio for their hard work and dedication after countless quarrels; I would like to thank all the classic reasoning games we have played for the inspiration, and I would like to thank all the family members and family members who have helped in the process of making the game. about_the_game:
《美少女万华镜 -理与迷宫的少女-》是日本资深美少女游戏制作商ωstar制作发行的
超自然神秘题材文字冒险作品。本作由实力派画师八宝备仁担任原画，
不仅仅在角色塑造的方面实力雄厚，游戏的背景及音乐更是与角色浑然一体，
处处透露出超自然的神秘感。游戏为玩家提供了一场充满悬疑神秘的视觉盛宴。
是一款不可多得的绝美佳作。


深见等人聚集于那家温泉旅馆，
参加人气作家——皇公晓的文学奖获奖庆功宴。

在旅馆享受着快乐时光的同时，
众人从月丘编辑处，听闻了某所女学园的离奇事件。

人气作家且同时也是名侦探的皇对这起事件充满了兴趣。
拉上了深见一起，决定前往位于这起事情核心的私立赞咲良学园进行调查。

本作品在揭秘离奇事件的同时，
也为各位玩家解明了万华镜与持有万华镜的少女——莲华的秘密。





・莲华

CV：真中海

“……真是的，让我等了那么久，这样抱怨一下也是理所当然的吧……”

深见在旅馆遇到的不可思议的美少女。
给人冷冷的感觉，嘴上有点不饶人。



・谜之少女

CV：？？？


・月丘 香恋

CV：雪村とあ

“正、正好是我也想做的事情，所以请不要在意……”

惊悚杂志「妖」的美女编辑。
工作十分认真努力，且与生俱来便是相当温柔的性格。
对恋爱方面的事情有些迟钝，且容易害羞。



・深见 夏彦


“即便是妖怪，现在要是做了太过的话，可能也会后悔的啊！”

新锐的惊悚作家。
非常喜欢各种怪奇的话题，听怪谈故事的话连神色都会起变化。
是个性格比较沉稳的草食系男子。
想法相对偏向理想浪漫，所以和同龄人不太合得来，朋友比较少。
虽然也算是个美男子，但不知为何人缘并没有很好。



・皇 公晓

CV：河村眞人

“你好像是个有趣的人呢。”

是畅销作家同时又是名侦探。
出身高贵，拥有如同希腊雕塑般的俊美外貌。
拥有丰富的心理学知识。作为侦探，名声也是广为人知。
不过由于自我意识较强，所以并不擅长人际交往。



・稻森 春

CV：葵时绪

“欢迎光临，真是好久不见。”

在温泉旅馆工作的美女接待员。
看上去是个沉稳文静的大姐姐，其实性格上有一些天然。



・高濑 舞斗

CV：深川緑

“小～萌～萌～，这是我特地做的便当，今天会吃的吧？”

私立赞咲良学园的音乐老师。
其实是萌世歌的远房亲戚，和失去家人的萌世歌一起生活。
丝毫不隐藏自己对萌世歌的喜爱之情，但在周围人看来则是一种过度保护。



注意：STEAM版本为简体中文版，包含日语语音。
声明：本作中的所有角色在游戏剧情发生时均已超过18岁。

about_the_game:
Heroine Anthem ZERO 2: Scalescars Oath When the world was freed of chaos, the Twin Virgin Saints started the circle of the seven doomsday. When the lands were flooded on the sixth doomsday, after the descendants of the Savior received blessings from God, they resurrected under the new born Tree of Life Terasyr, establishing the royal city of Vuzahem. But ichthyopagion still continued to grow, making clear that the Gods have not forgiven the world. People must find answers to the meaning of war while surviving the sins and punishments before Judgement Day. The story includes multiple subtle metaphors for the relationship between God and humans.

The game revolves around Shama, the young descendent of Gon Arrue who survived ichthyopagion. Living under the Tree of Life and becoming a priestess, then leaving the Tree of Life on the eve of the Star Ark Festival, she traveled to the far west to Uzato, the town of the Forest Keepers. She goes looking for the benefactor her mother told her of in hopes of finding an ordinary and simple home, but the only clue her mother left was a pin. What has Shama been through? Keeping her tears and loneliness secret behind her smile, leaving the place she promised to look for. But will her fate truly bring her peace?


Heroine Anthem ZERO 2 : Scalescars Oath is a real time 2D mixed with 3D side-scrolling story-based ARPG, simultaneously supporting controller and keyboard input. Unlock more skills by leveling your character.
The game’s producers have used their innovative creativity to bring you a long magical “duet”. The game combines legends of mermaids as well as Serbian and East Asian tribal culture to create its cultural world. Created over many years, it features nearly 400,000 words of dialogue, over 500 stories CG, 300 stages, and over 500 story performances. It has genuinely been brought to life a like a long TV series but as an adventure game. The soundtrack includes many songs from multiple music producers, which takes your experience to a whole new level!


  • Vivid Storytelling
    With more than 100s of CGs and 2D animation, each scene is carefully aligned with both visual and audio. More than 100 stages and 400,000 words, players can truly immerse in the world of Heroine Anthem Zero.

  • World-class BGM
    Music composition team includes Joe Chou, Japanese composer Motoki Ohno, Tetsuya Ueda, and Shigezo Kamimura who received the Highest-Kuninomiya International Culture Award in 2013. Heroine Anthem Zero 2 continues to bring some of the best BGMs to its players.

  • Unlocks Different Skills
    As the character levels up, players have a range of skills to unlock including dodge, perry, triple jump, jump attack, and more. With the desired combination, players can have their own style of combat.

  • Combat Companion
    There is a combat companion system in Heroine Anthem Zero 2. Combat companion levels up as the story progresses, thus unlocking more skills to activate during combat.

  • Puzzle Solving
    There are puzzles to solve in each map. Not only are they essential for stage completion, but also hidden treasures for players to explore. Some of the hidden treasures will considerably assist the players.
  • Crafting and Cooking System
    Players can collect loot throughout the game and craft different equipment, upgrade the weapons, or make them into a variety of food to enhance the character.

  • Equipment Passive Skills
    Weapons and armors have different passive skills. Players can choose any type of weapon depending on their combat style.
  • Special Event
    There are different options for players to choose during conversations. Sometimes by making a different choice, there might be a special event in the game.

  • Expedition System
    Don’t miss any suspicious areas in a stage! Crouching and exploring gives you a chance to pick up good stuff. In dangerous travel situations, use Cuckoo’s ability to look for suspicious exploration sites and command Cuckoo to further explore the area for a chance to obtain special loot.
  • Cooking and Crafting System
    Using materials gained from exploring to cook or craft can create useful weapons, gear, and meal boxes. These can be used to increase the stats of weapon and gear.
  • Other Items and Gear
    Character progress, weapons, and gear have a tight connection. Many weapons, armor, projectiles, runes, seals, food ingredients, and cuisine benefits not only provide atk/def to gear, weapons, armor, and rune effects but also adds a different attack move effect.
  • Easter Egg Questline and Multi-option Conversation System
    Story progresses through dialogue. To enable certain story lines, choosing different dialogue options are needed. Don’t forget to choose every option even if it may lead to death, as a different interpretation of the story may lead to unexpected events. Besides the main quest line, there are hidden stages as challenges for players to explore.
  • The game supports customized keyboards
    PS4/PS5/XBOX360 and up, as well as most controller brands. Provides a toggle option for PS controller settings (US spec/JP spec) and partial UI customization. (Ex: BUFF icon). Due to OS, some controllers may experience button setting errors under wireless mode. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

[Don’t worry about feeling out of the loop if you haven’t played the previous ZERO 2, we’ll catch you up on previous events in-game. Please have fun!!]

Main Characters:


Shama Kutami
Age 18 \ June 6th \ 156cm \ B90 W54 H83
A young girl descended from Gon Arrue, parted from her own mother by the age of 10. Having gone through slavery, stealing, acting, and wandering for quite some time, unfortunate things happen to people close to her. She has learned to not cry and to guard her secrets by being strange and weird. Accustomed to dressing like a young lad, with top notch lockpicking, singing, and cooking skills, she’s able to strike when needed. Being able to feast is her way of living. Along side Shama is Cuckoo, her best companion.

Wanin Sarem
Age 19 \ November 3rd \ 177cm
Descendant of one of the three largest families, the Uzato. Both parents died when he was young, and he grew up with younger sister Naire and Mormolia. Inherited his parents’ exquisite crafting and mechanical talent, finds peace in each time the hammer slams down in the workshop his parents left behind. Going deep into the Longhorn Forest to investigate crystals, he meets the long lost Evolous. Wanin and Mormolia both face a life-threatening encounter.

Mormolia
Age 19 \ March 27th \ 38cm
Nicknamed MoMo, grew up with BFF Wanin. Age is uncertain, but Wanin wasn’t born yet when he arrived at Sarem’s. Ever since, she has been an older sister figure and close with the Sarem family. Has a sweet elvish look but is tough on the inside -- drinking and fighting is right up her alley.

Welly
Age 21 \ September 15th \ 183cm
A temple guard who often travels between Starry Mountain and East Mountain Trail. Good at using javelins. Enjoys time alone and looks like SACRED TEMPLE GUARD CAPTAIN Sigud, thus getting the nickname Twin Spirit. Is often deep in his own world, and uses rational analysis to solve all problems. Cannot stop talking once you catch his interest, and doesn’t hide anything from his good friend Meowgiko.


Kuador
Age 19 \ January 10th \ 168cm \ B80 W56 H85
Female warrior of the East Tower Forest Keepers. Good with a sword and shield. Fell out of line just to see Iron Arty at West Forest Keeper Tower in Longhorn Forest. Persistent personality who doesn’t speak much, often surprises people with her boldness.

Mia Kettica
Age 18 \ October 10th \ 156cm
A buddy Shama met while acting at Caffarno. The two of them are in sync like Twin Spirits; she is important to Shama. Made a promise with Shama to climb Terasyr, the Tree of Life together. Mia and Shama end up in Vuzahem by fate after the troupe was invaded by ichthyopagion.

Rui
Age 18 \ June 15th \ 162cm \ B82 W52 H83
One of Uzato’s most trusted Priests. Takes care of many Sacred Temple arrangements. Has a unique gift, able to detect all spirits. Was originally sought as an Uzato Star Ark Priestess but in the end Wanin’s younger sister Naire got the nod. Has a special place in her heart for Welly and has a younger sister working part time at Muscles Bar.

Varoussa
Leader of the secret organization in Vuzahem. Honorable and cold, no one dares look her straight in the eye. Shama calls her Mother, but is not her birth mother. She expects good things to come for Shama.


Korrud
February 29 \ 165cm \ B83 W50 H84
A traveler from Nassan taking shelter at the Pekt Tavern. Goes out at night and comes back tired during the day to sleep in. Always has a evil grin while asking others if they fancy a game of Quent, a card game she uses to seek her fortune that day.

Ahdurio
February 11th \ 183cm

detailed_description:
Heroine Anthem ZERO 2: Scalescars Oath When the world was freed of chaos, the Twin Virgin Saints started the circle of the seven doomsday. When the lands were flooded on the sixth doomsday, after the descendants of the Savior received blessings from God, they resurrected under the new born Tree of Life Terasyr, establishing the royal city of Vuzahem. But ichthyopagion still continued to grow, making clear that the Gods have not forgiven the world. People must find answers to the meaning of war while surviving the sins and punishments before Judgement Day. The story includes multiple subtle metaphors for the relationship between God and humans.

The game revolves around Shama, the young descendent of Gon Arrue who survived ichthyopagion. Living under the Tree of Life and becoming a priestess, then leaving the Tree of Life on the eve of the Star Ark Festival, she traveled to the far west to Uzato, the town of the Forest Keepers. She goes looking for the benefactor her mother told her of in hopes of finding an ordinary and simple home, but the only clue her mother left was a pin. What has Shama been through? Keeping her tears and loneliness secret behind her smile, leaving the place she promised to look for. But will her fate truly bring her peace?


Heroine Anthem ZERO 2 : Scalescars Oath is a real time 2D mixed with 3D side-scrolling story-based ARPG, simultaneously supporting controller and keyboard input. Unlock more skills by leveling your character.
The game’s producers have used their innovative creativity to bring you a long magical “duet”. The game combines legends of mermaids as well as Serbian and East Asian tribal culture to create its cultural world. Created over many years, it features nearly 400,000 words of dialogue, over 500 stories CG, 300 stages, and over 500 story performances. It has genuinely been brought to life a like a long TV series but as an adventure game. The soundtrack includes many songs from multiple music producers, which takes your experience to a whole new level!


  • Vivid Storytelling
    With more than 100s of CGs and 2D animation, each scene is carefully aligned with both visual and audio. More than 100 stages and 400,000 words, players can truly immerse in the world of Heroine Anthem Zero.

  • World-class BGM
    Music composition team includes Joe Chou, Japanese composer Motoki Ohno, Tetsuya Ueda, and Shigezo Kamimura who received the Highest-Kuninomiya International Culture Award in 2013. Heroine Anthem Zero 2 continues to bring some of the best BGMs to its players.

  • Unlocks Different Skills
    As the character levels up, players have a range of skills to unlock including dodge, perry, triple jump, jump attack, and more. With the desired combination, players can have their own style of combat.

  • Combat Companion
    There is a combat companion system in Heroine Anthem Zero 2. Combat companion levels up as the story progresses, thus unlocking more skills to activate during combat.

  • Puzzle Solving
    There are puzzles to solve in each map. Not only are they essential for stage completion, but also hidden treasures for players to explore. Some of the hidden treasures will considerably assist the players.
  • Crafting and Cooking System
    Players can collect loot throughout the game and craft different equipment, upgrade the weapons, or make them into a variety of food to enhance the character.

  • Equipment Passive Skills
    Weapons and armors have different passive skills. Players can choose any type of weapon depending on their combat style.
  • Special Event
    There are different options for players to choose during conversations. Sometimes by making a different choice, there might be a special event in the game.

  • Expedition System
    Don’t miss any suspicious areas in a stage! Crouching and exploring gives you a chance to pick up good stuff. In dangerous travel situations, use Cuckoo’s ability to look for suspicious exploration sites and command Cuckoo to further explore the area for a chance to obtain special loot.
  • Cooking and Crafting System
    Using materials gained from exploring to cook or craft can create useful weapons, gear, and meal boxes. These can be used to increase the stats of weapon and gear.
  • Other Items and Gear
    Character progress, weapons, and gear have a tight connection. Many weapons, armor, projectiles, runes, seals, food ingredients, and cuisine benefits not only provide atk/def to gear, weapons, armor, and rune effects but also adds a different attack move effect.
  • Easter Egg Questline and Multi-option Conversation System
    Story progresses through dialogue. To enable certain story lines, choosing different dialogue options are needed. Don’t forget to choose every option even if it may lead to death, as a different interpretation of the story may lead to unexpected events. Besides the main quest line, there are hidden stages as challenges for players to explore.
  • The game supports customized keyboards
    PS4/PS5/XBOX360 and up, as well as most controller brands. Provides a toggle option for PS controller settings (US spec/JP spec) and partial UI customization. (Ex: BUFF icon). Due to OS, some controllers may experience button setting errors under wireless mode. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

[Don’t worry about feeling out of the loop if you haven’t played the previous ZERO 2, we’ll catch you up on previous events in-game. Please have fun!!]

A young girl descended from Gon Arrue, parted from her own mother by the age of 10. Having gone through slavery, stealing, acting, and wandering for quite some time, unfortunate things happen to people close to her. She has learned to not cry and to guard her secrets by being strange and weird. Accustomed to dressing like a young lad, with top notch lockpicking, singing, and cooking skills, she’s able to strike when needed. Being able to feast is her way of living. about_the_game:
Make Sungaia Your Playground

Combine fun platformer movement and fluid combat with rhythm elements as you storm different locations across the land of Sungaia.

As newly-appointed Blade Guardian Yinyang, learn techniques that use various types of ki energy such as fire, wind and metal!

An important decision you make will determine which territories and bosses you face throughout your journey to save your brother.

If You Can't Beat Them, Copy Them

Harness the sonic powers of the Beat Blade! Parry enemy attacks then mimic them by catching the rhythms of their sonic vibrations. Use the stolen moves to fight back or discover hidden secrets in the environment.

Two Rival Clans, One Divided Land

The Iruha Clan runs the western half of Sungaia. They are a traditional clan of blade wielders and martial artists, led by the elderly Chief Rezru, with their key territories protected by the Blade Guardians.

The Laruha Clan occupies East Sungaia, governed by Premier Elemi who defends the land alongside her clan’s best fighters. They promote technology and equality, rejecting old-fashioned thinking and religion.

Chief Rezru has two warrior grandsons - Arangei, training to be the next Chief of Iruha, and his younger brother Yinyang. When Premier Elemi offers Yinyang his kidnapped brother back in return for fighting for the Laruha Clan, Yinyang must make the hardest decision in his life.
