about_the_game:
RogueType is the first typing game that borrows roguelike elements, while on the surface it looks like a traditional 2D game, it's both familiar and unique because on one hand, you have standard 2D minigames that everyone is familiar with (there are also newly designed ones) but the minigames are being remixed with a typing mechanic. Every time you have a new game you will have 20 stages that have random typing minigames, each time having larger words that will make them harder, you can also get card stages that contain a random effect that can make your game easier or harder, after finishing the 20 stages your score will be compared to your previous scores to unlock new characters.




Minigames are divided into 2 types, speed with precision and memorization, speed with precision minigames will reward you by giving you a lot of points but if you fail a word it won't take away a lot of points for you, memorization minigames will punish you by taking more points.



At the bottom left there are the hearts you have, you start with 5 but can have up to 10, if you fail stages and lose all your hearts it will be game over and you will start again in stage 1.

A note from the developer:
If you’re thinking about buying RogueType please keep in mind that while I am super passionate about this game, I am a solo developer. This is not a triple-A experience with hundreds of hours of content. Instead, I offer a small, satisfying experience inspired by roguelike mechanics to add a little more randomness to the game.

What you get:

  • A game that will improve your typing precision
  • A game that will improve your typing speed
  • Different runs every new game
  • Minimal pixel art UI and graphics

What you don't get:

  • Advertisements
  • LootBoxes
  • Cute Dialogue and An Emotional Story

about_the_game:
BUCKLER 2, originally titled Rosefury: The Golden Plains, is an action-packed platformer with a few roguelike elements sprinkled in. You can play as a wide variety of unique characters, each with their own weapons, styles, and personalities. Travel across a brand new world, fight some baddies, dodge some hazards, and maybe make a few friends along the way. Shield-bash your way to victory and take back what's rightfully yours!

The Olive Heroes

A group of unlikely heroes bands to together to embark on a journey across Sector Omega, the last thing standing between the Olives and victory. However, the Roses will make sure they take the last area of uncovered land for themselves and will do anything to ensure they are triumphant.

With an army of savage killers fighting against our heroes, they will have no choice but to use powerful weapons to wipe them out. Venice, our silent scarved protagonist, wields The Buckler, a mighty shield with offensive capability. Using The Buckler and a wide variety of unique weapons, Venice and his friends are ready to take on the Roses and seize Sector Omega once and for all!

Cool Features

What can you do in this game? Well, there's all sorts of stuff to do! You can:

  • Bash some red dudes in the face with a shield
  • Venture across many unique levels, each varying in shape, size, and difficulty
  • Go fishing
  • Play as a diverse cast of characters, each with their own weapons, abilities, and personalities
  • Unlock powerful items that can aid you on your journey
  • Die a bunch of times
  • Fight a giant worm
  • Play the slots
  • Strive to achieve both endings

...And so much more!

The World of Regroja

Long ago, somewhere in the Goodbar Galaxy, there was a planet called Regroja. On this planet dwelled Regrojans, a race designed to create love. However, due to their curiosity, they stumbled upon a sleeping god, awakening it from its slumber. This diety cursed the Regrojans with two plagues, each changing the mind and bodies of Regrojans, eventually splitting them into two factions. Rising tensions between the Regrojans lead to a worldwide race war, and the once united Regrojans turned their backs on one another and killed solely in the name of hate. This continued to about 1000 years, until the day they remembered their purpose.

Do you think you have what it takes to leave every square inch of this world untouched? What will you find on your adventures? How far will your luck take you? Who will live? Who will die? I leave that up to you.

about_the_game:
Story

Hey, can you hear me?　Can you see me?

You, after quitting your job, was casually browsing the video site with the spare time. It was 2 am when a strange video with a blank thumbnail caught your eye.

"What is this? What's happening...?"

The viewer count of the live stream was 1, with no one but yourself watching. The avatar on the other side looked puzzled, as if she had not intended to do any of the things.

The next day, you receive a message: "Will you produce 'Owarino Rinne' with me?"

"I keep having the same dream. I dream of traveling somewhere far away."

"Becoming a VTuber is like a near-death experience."

Game System

You are managing the new VTuber "Owarino Rinne", a doomsday type VTuber. Switching between "Chat mode" and "Stream mode," you will give advice on video planning and activities.

Chat Mode

This is the part where you chat and call with Rinne using a communication app AloneZoo to advance the story. You will guide her as a beginner VTuber through everything from proposing a project to mental care. The content of the conversation changes depending on the response options.

Stream Mode

Based on the plan developed in the call mode, Rinne will stream on a video site. Talking, singing and even ASMR streaming... what awaits her at the end of her increasingly broadening streaming life?

Character

Name

Owarino Rinne

Height

160cm

Hobbies

Sometimes finding delicious preserved food.

A girl who travels around the post-apocalypse world. She streams from an abandoned train with a mysterious cat-like creature (named "Emergency Food").

Her personality is easygoing, with few emotional ups and downs.

Staff

Scenario and direction

Gainen Sanagi

System and sound

Ao Takeuma

Character Design and Illustration

Itsuki Inubozaki

Product Information

Title

Near-Death-Expedition

System requirements

Supported OS: Windows or macOS

Estimated playing time

90 to 120 minutes

Rules for live video and live streaming, etc.

◽️ live-playing videos are welcome! ◽️

Purchasers of “Near-Death-Expedition” are allowed to play the entire game live.

Please make sure to put the URL of “Near-Death-Expedition” on Steam in the summary section. Monetization is also acceptable.

We also welcome your feedback on social networking sites.

How to play

Basic operation

Left click/Enter/Space key ... Progress text

Right click ... Switch between stream mode and chat mode

Move the cursor to the bottom center to display the menu. The menu is in order from left to right

(1) Stream button ... Moves to stream mode.

(2) Chat button ... Moves to chat mode.

(3) Auto ... Automatically progresses the text.

(4) Quick Load ... Resume from the point saved by Quick Save.

(5) Quick Save ... Save the progress at your favorite scene.

(6) Menu: Opens the menu screen.

In Election Day, you decide who runs the government! Players take on the role of voters navigating a vibrant and ever-changing game board as they strive to make their voices heard in the zaniest election ever.

A new leader is elected each round, and their quirky policies transform the board. Depending on the whims of the current leader, tiles might grant unexpected bonuses, impose ridiculous penalties, or create wild scenarios.

-Every round elect a new leader that will change the board and mechanics based on their whims

-Choose the leader that will increase the odds of every player winning... Or the one that gets you on top!

-Avoid losing all your hearts! Or get taken to the hospital!

-Losing all your money means the overseer takes you out of the game... One way or another.
-Letting war take over the board is only good for the people with money already!

Work with other players or deceive them into thinking you are on Election Day!!!

about_the_game:
In the seas of the distant future, humans have all but disappeared.
Now, fish and crustaceans fight great wars, massacring one another with deadly lasers.
In your current, newly-awakened state, you are no more than a piece of seafood.
However, you have been blessed with the talent for leading your allies into battle.
Ransack the reefs. Discover underwater worlds. Raise an army. Rack up your victories.

Do whatever it takes to become the Ace of Seafood.

More About the Game

Defeat enemies, gather allies, hone your skills, secure reefs, and voyage the seas from top to bottom!
Ace of Seafood is a third-person action game in which you establish a party of up to six fish/crustaceans, exploring the vast ocean and battling with various forms of marine life in order to expand your oceanic domain.


At the beginning, you need to share your secret desire to become one of the seafood.

Take control of an array of sea creatures and freely explore the ocean in an open-world map.
Engage in battle with various forms of marine life in order to capture the reefs they guard.
The reefs serve as bases from which you can strengthen your allies and breed more of them.

The more victories you rack up, the stronger the army you can control, and the further out to sea you can explore.
In battle, your allies will follow the commands of the Ace (that's you). Guide them wisely as they enter battle formations and use their special abilities.
In the world of Ace of Seafood, sea creatures possess the ability to shoot powerful rays of light that can destroy just about anything.


So, do you get it now? No? Why not?

New Features


An online mode has been added to the latest version of the game!

You can create your account on the top screen (see below image). Once you log in and go to the load data screen, an "UPLOAD" option will be displayed to the right. Use this option to upload your data to the server and share your account between iOS/Android versions, other PCs, etc.



As an extra added bonus, once you’ve beaten the game you will be able to battle the Ace Team of another player who has uploaded their own data to the server as well.

  • Note: When uploading data, if you do not specify names of your team and team members, they will not appear in the game and will be invisible to other players.
    Additionally, from "CONFIG", you can set "ONLINE FEATURE" to "OFF" to prevent other teams from attacking you. (Attack is set to “ON” by default).

Message from the Developer


Hmm, what kind of game should I make...?

I'd love to float endlessly through a vast, rich world.
I want to freely speed around in all directions, in beautiful formations.
I also want to dig holes and explore the depths of the ocean floor.
I want to be able to take on monsters several times my size.
I want to shoot laser beams from my mouth... and so on.

So many dreams... and to think that “playing as seafood” would be the way to fulfill them.

Behold: the school of fish and their sleek, agile movements, honed through experience from battles past.
Admire the underground tunnels dug out by the shrimp.
Discover the terrors that lurk in the deep, and the creatures which can light up even the darkest depths of the ocean!
These are the sorts of creatures that I could never create on my own...
So allow me to pass onto you the legend of their awesome deeds instead.

This is the epic tale of the champion of an ocean world.
And epic tales are known to carry a tiny bit of exaggeration...

Introducing "Battle Royale with Cheese," y'all! This game ain't your average shoot-'em-up – it's a high-octane, strategic showdown that'll have you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. Picture this: 20 teams, three players per squad, duking it out in a modern-day battlefield that'll remind you of the rugged terrains of Iraq and Afghanistan. But here's the kicker – we ain't skimpin' on the visuals. Sure, it's low-poly, but with some slick post-processing effects, this game looks as fly as a fresh pair of kicks.

Now, let's talk gameplay. It's straight-up battle royale, baby – last team standing takes the crown. But don't think it's just a run-and-gun affair. Nah, "Battle Royale with Cheese" is all about teamwork and tactics. You gotta stick with your squad, scavenge for weapons, and outsmart the competition if you wanna come out on top.

And speaking of weapons, we got 'em all – pistols, sniper rifles, you name it. Each piece comes with its own set of attachments, so figure out which is the best from what you find and lay down some serious heat on the battlefield. But hey, it ain't just about firepower. You gotta stay stocked up on health packs, ammo, and grenades too – 'cause in this game, survival ain't guaranteed.

So grab your crew, hone your strategy, and get ready for the ride of your life in "Battle Royale with Cheese." It's gonna be one hell of a showdown, and only the baddest, boldest teams will come out on top. You ready to show 'em what you're made of? Let's do this!

Description


Elendia Ceus is an epic RPG developed by Aldorlea Games (Asguaard, Moonchild, The Book of Legends etc.) and featuring about 20-30 hours of playtime as well as a large cast of enemy bosses.


Storyline


What lies beneath the skies?
This is a question nobody in the cloud world of Elendia wants answered - nobody but one man, LaCaster, who lost his wife as she passed to the other side.
And because the prophecies say Elendia will collapse if a breach is made through to the other world, you have to stop LaCaster from trying to revive his wife. But he is a general of the Kingdom and you are only a pirate. He has the power and you are barely legal. In such impossible adversity, do you have what it takes to stop the imminent disaster from happening?

Features


  • Visible encounters
  • Mouse control
  • 3 modes of difficulty
  • 20-30+ Hours of epic and rich gameplay
  • Choose whether your characters are "astrology-aligned" for more depth and strategy
  • 50+ secret rooms to discover (and even mega secret rooms!)
  • 6 Relics, 8 Artifacts, 7 Legends, 4 Dragons etc.
  • Colyseum with 3 Leagues for you to test your skills
  • Great-looking enemies, beautiful environments and charming music

More Games

about_the_game:
"Envy: Better to wake it up than feel it"

You play as a man named Roger Bennett who wakes up in a cryo room inside a big laboratory 50 years after the collapse of civilization and the possible extinction of the human race.

It's your duty to discover what is hidden in that mysterious place. Will there be more humans alive? Has the destiny of the human race come to an end?

The hope of finding something to continue living for remains latent.

EQUIP YOURSELF WITH THE BEST WEAPONS
Survival inside the bunker will not be easy. Choose the best weapons to defeat the different enemies you meet along the way. All with different behaviors and attacks.

Survival inside the lab will not be easy. Choose the best weapons to defeat the different enemies you meet along the way. All with different behaviors and attacks.

MANAGE YOUR INVENTORY










.







You will have a limited number of slots to store your items. Take the ones you consider most important for your advancement. The rest, you will have to leave them in a trunk.

DIFFICULTY LEVELS:
Play to enjoy the narrative and scenarios or to turn your adventure into a real nightmare where death will always be near you.

OBSERVE, LEARN AND INTERPRET:
In this kind of games there are no dialogues. There will be some text and notes but most of the story you will have to interpret for yourself. Will you have the ability to decipher the great mysteries hidden in this gigantic lab? You can't trust anyone but yourself.

PUZZLES, TRAPS AND LOTS OF EXPLORATION
If you enjoy having your mind, memory, and creative skills tested, you'll have enough to solve different puzzles and obstacles to advance in your adventure. Be careful, the enemies will not be your only concern.

CONTROLLER SUPPORT:
If you don't want to use the mouse and keyboard to advance in your adventure, you can play with a joystick.

about_the_game:
A word of caution to disclaim:
It's more a poetry than a game.

The story goes the way you pull it.
A bullet hell without bullets.

What would I call it for my part?
A piece of something. I hope, of art.


The Game We All Have To Play is a challenging minimalistic action game. It will take you about 15 minutes to reach the end, but if you want to get an excellent result, you will probably fail again, and again. And each run will feel different due to the abundance of commentaries in poetry form.

Have you ever had a feeling that there is too much on your plate? Some of us even wish there were more than 24 hours in a day. What is more important to you - your career, your hobby, your family? You can always sacrifice one of those things to have more time for another. Or you can try and keep everything under control. But it won't be easy!

In this game you can go the long way from being a newborn to the adulthood in a matter of a few minutes. You will have to make choices along the way. And it will get quite hardcore by the end when you might feel all fingers and thumbs. But if you succeed you will reveal the true name of this game, which is so obvious to see and so hard to grasp.

about_the_game:
Dream of bells is a puzzle game. All bells in the world fall asleep because of some evil magic. Your goal is to wake them up in a specific order. Essentially you have to make a program for the car, but the program also a part of the puzzle world, some sort of Rube Goldberg machine.

You need to put commands block in the level, so the car can follow instructions and drive through bells in the desired order. Making the car drive through the correct bell wakes up the bell. Command block can be simple like turn right or turn left or conditional: turn right or left if the block on the roof of the car matches with the block in the front right side of the car, the game also has a pickup command block, put down command block, and rainbow block which can update the block on the roof.

about_the_game:
Liquid Abyss is a fantastical adventure game set in a mysterious underwater aquarium. The protagonist, Ellie, finds herself lost in this submerged world and discovers that her body has transformed into a jelly-like form. She has almost no memory of who she is or why she is there.

In the abyssal depths of this world, strange jellyfish and peculiar inhabitants begin to speak to Ellie. At times, they may even become threats.

Your first task is to help Ellie recover her memories.
To do so, you will need to perform several actions:

  • Listen
    Gather hints from the inhabitants of this world.

  • Respond
    Choose from options presented by the inhabitants.

  • Explore
    Search the submerged aquarium to find a way to escape.

By repeating these actions, the story will gradually unfold.
There may also be additional actions available to you.

When you finally uncover the truth behind why Ellie has become jelly-like, all the mysteries will come to light.

However, Ellie may not truly desire to return to the world she came from.
Even so, if you choose to guide her back, it might just be the first step toward a new beginning for her.

about_the_game:
Thrilling precision platforming, now easier and more exhilarating than ever!

Experience the same intense and thrilling fun of precision platformers, but without the frustration — a stylish and refreshing jump action game!

Use fast and stylish aerial combos and dash actions to dodge monsters and obstacles freely, and climb to the top in your own unique way.

Break free from fixed routes and repetitive patterns unleash your creativity and strategy to enjoy a fresh and thrilling experience every time!

In a world where steampunk and fantasy blend beautifully, feel the exhilarating sense of achievement as you reach the top in your own style!


About the Game

In a harsh and unforgiving world, people dream of something greater something monumental they hope to reach one day. Some say there’s wealth at the summit. Others speak of a utopia that awaits. But the truth is, no one really knows what lies at the end. HollowJump is a quiet yet relentless journey upward, chasing the question itself. You fall again and again and yet, even within the seemingly meaningless repetition, you keep climbing, higher and higher. Toward a destination no one has seen, just one more step upward.

Game Overview

You are an adventurer in a fantasy steampunk world. Armed with nothing but your ability to jump and dash, you traverse airborne cities, mechanical ruins, and bizarre, living structures inhabited by machine-fused creatures—all in search of the truth. With a dystopian setting, constant tension, tight controls, and a vertically expanding level design, 《HollowJump》 offers more than just a jump game. It’s a deeply immersive experience that quietly reflects on the essence of life itself.

Features

  • A thought-provoking message exploring the meaning of life

  • Striking vertical 2D pixel art maps

  • A fantasy world fused with flying airships, biomechanical lifeforms, and mysterious mechanical civilizations

  • Tense, timing-based gameplay focused on evasion

  • Precision controls with jump strength adjustment, aerial dashes, and rhythmic movement to test your skills

  • Simple at first, but designed to reveal deeper mechanics the higher you climb

  • A narrative told through fragmented world-building and mysterious NPC encounters, waiting for you to piece it together

    A profound journey, unfolding through simple controls.

    Feel the quiet message the world has to offer—firsthand.

about_the_game:
Mass Exodus Redux is a local multiplayer game developed from the ground up for the HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Quest 1,2 and PC.

Relaunched in 2020 with a brand new map, new visuals, new AI systems and massive performance improvements.

One VR player assumes the role of the seeker. The seeker is a large, sinister robot in control of the factory. He knows there are rogue androids amid his facility and his mission is to find and destroy them.

The PC players take the role of the rouge androids. The only way to escape the seeker is to switch off the control panels located around the factory and shut the facility down.

This is a pickup and play game that will keep you and your friends on the edge of your seats. There are 4 extensive maps each with a different theme and features. Both roles have access to creative power-ups, that if used cleverly can completely change the game advantage. Each round is always tense and never the same.



• Local multiplayer game 1 VR vs up to 4 PC players
• Great party VR game
• Easy “pick up and play”
• 4 exhilarating maps
• Creative power-ups for both roles
• Re-playable
• Custom game settings
• Trading Cards and Badges

about_the_game:
Ezekiel is an upcoming high-intensity "Boomer Shooter 2", a spiritual successor to the golden age of ’90s Build Engine first-person shooters like Blood and Duke Nukem 3D. It reimagines that era as if it had received a proper mid-2000s sequel, one that actually delivers on that promise.

Advanced Enemy AI & Complex Combat Interactions

Enemies aren’t just bullet sponges. Each type has unique behaviors, tricks, and reactions, ensuring no two fights play out the same. Expect ambushes, flanking maneuvers, and emergent chaos.

Multi-Purpose Arsenal with Tactical Depth

Every weapon features multiple firing modes and additional utility, including rocket-jump-style movement tricks for level traversal.

Detailed Gibbing & Gore System

Every shot has weight. Limbs fly, bodies explode, and the battlefield becomes a visceral mess. Bodies and blood persist letting you admire your carnage after the fight ends.

Features advanced volumetric blood effects and dynamic wound/dismemberment based on hit location.

Chaotic, Brutal, and Over-the-Top Based Action

A symphony of destruction where explosions rip through crowds, limbs fly with exaggerated gore, environments are full of stuff to destroy and screen shake is applied liberally.

Expansive Multi-path Levels

Large levels that don't feel like a cutscene corridor and respect the player's ability to navigate without a GPS marker in their face complete with Half-Life style set pieces and environmental storytelling.

Bold, Experimental Soundtrack

A sonic assault blending head-banding djent-inspired 8-string guitars with nomadic folk influences. Hypnotic, aggressive, and unlike anything else in shooters.

No Hand-Holding

NOT an arena combat game

NO pulling health/ammo out of thin air: scavenge, retreat, be clever

NO health regeneration

NO X-Ray vision

Survival is earned, not given.

about_the_game:
Dungeons & Bombs - dynamic fusion of classic sokoban puzzles and bomberman-inspired games. When enemies drag people into their dark lair and do their vile deeds there, the hero and his faithful sword always come to the rescue. But what if the hero does not have a sword, but a lot of enthusiasm and an endless supply of explosives? Well, bad for them. Go through dark labyrinths and dungeons and try not to blast yourself up.

A thousand years ago, there was a flourished Kingdom in these lands that was already called the ancient. And so the idyll would have continued, if not for the Unholy Union. Under its shadow - tribes of orcs from wild lands, necromancers and undead from chilly crypts, as well as apostate knights from the outskirts of the kingdom. And they decided to kidnap the beacon of the whole kingdom - its Princess, who in all the surrounding lands was famous for her beauty ... and her beard



Under cover of night they stole her from her own bedroom and hid her in the ancient catacombs under the castle. Few would dare to descend under these gloomy vaults, but only one 3Hero was needed to save the Princess. A kleptomaniac and a pyromaniac with an unhealthy craving for explosions, but still the most devoted knight at court - he was sent by the King to find his daughter. Will a brave knight be able to save the Princess or is he destined to perish in darkness among enemies?...

Get ready to meet:

  • 50 entangled puzzle-levels
  • Unbreakable laws of logic
  • Explosions
  • Bombs!!!
  • EXPLOSIONS AND BOMBS!!!!!

about_the_game:
Are you ready to build your dream e-commerce empire?

E-commerce Simulation is a detailed and realistic life-simulation game that puts you in the shoes of an aspiring entrepreneur. Starting from a tiny, single-room apartment, you'll experience every aspect of running an online business — from sourcing products and packaging to handling orders and earning customer satisfaction.

Key Features:

Dynamic City Life: A living, breathing city filled with traffic, NPCs, and interactive locations, all designed to simulate a realistic urban environment.

Immersive E-Commerce Mechanics: Accept orders, package products, ship them to customers, and manage your brand based on customer feedback.

Real-Time Survival Systems: Manage your hunger, sleep, bills, and time within a 24-hour day-night cycle.

Expandable Business: Upgrade to larger homes, unlock storage warehouses, and eventually run your own factory.

Vehicle Ownership and Driving: Buy vehicles from a dealership and freely drive around the city.

Advanced UI & PC Simulation: Use your in-game computer to manage orders, apps, finances, and business growth.

Role-Playing Elements: Explore the city, shop for groceries, visit entertainment venues, and build your lifestyle.

What Awaits You?

  • $100 starting capital, an old desktop computer, and a cramped little room.

  • 40 unique products and hundreds of potential customers.

  • A deep logistics system: shipping, customer feedback, fines, jail sequences, and more.

  • Unlockable content: storage units, production factories, expensive cars, and luxury homes.

Life isn’t only about selling... but in this city, you’ll need to sell to survive. Build your brand, fulfill your orders, and dive into the world of E-commerce Simulation!

about_the_game: This game invites players into a magical winter night adventure, where they play as a brave beetle making its way through the snow. The game features stunning visuals, with a snowy ground contrasting beautifully against the deep blue night sky, creating a serene yet mysterious atmosphere. Players use the keyboard to control the beetle, avoiding various obstacles and traps, such as pits and suddenly appearing monsters. If the beetle falls into a trap or collides with a monster, the game ends. However, the beetle has a special ability—it can load itself into a cannon and be fired out at the right moment to leap over obstacles. Along the way, players can collect gold coins scattered along the path, which not only increase the score but also come with rich sound effects, adding much fun to the gameplay. This is a game that tests players' reaction speed and strategic planning, perfect for those who enjoy a challenge.

about_the_game:
In a distant kingdom, the Lutherian Guard, the elite warriors responsible for protecting the royal family, live in perfect harmony. The youngest member, Dartan, is a skilled and loyal young man, dedicated to defending the king and his people. However, his loyalty is put to the test when he discovers a dark secret: the king he is sworn to protect is not who he says he is.

Determined to expose the truth, Dartan assembles his fellow Lutherian Guards to confront the King about his suspicions. To his surprise, they discover that the king is actually Vadniit, a malevolent being who has usurped the throne and takes the form of the rightful monarch. An epic battle ensues, but the Lutherian Guard is defeated by Vadniit's sinister force.

With a terrible blow, Vadniit uses a powerful magical artifact to separate the Guard members, sending them to another dimension. Now, Dartan and his fellow warriors must find a way to come together again to face the malevolent threat plaguing the realm.

On their journey of rediscovery and self-discovery, each member of the Lutherian Guard faces personal challenges and confronts their own fears. They learn to rely on their individual abilities and, at the same time, the strength of teamwork. Hoping to restore peace and justice to the kingdom, they embark on a perilous journey, where they will face mystical creatures and overcome magical obstacles.

However, time is running out, and Vadniit is growing more powerful. The Lutherian Guard will have to overcome each other and unite again to challenge evil in its purest form and save the realm from utter destruction. In this thrilling saga of action, magic and loyalty, the heroes will discover that true courage lies in standing up against the darkness, even when all seems lost. The final battle looms, and the fate of the kingdom depends on the valor and determination of the Lutherian Guard.

GAME FEATURES


  • 3D scenery and pixelated 2D sprites
  • Turn-based battles, simple mechanics and easy to play
  • Various types of weapons for each character, allowing different combat strategies
  • Two parallel worlds to explore
  • Five dungeons full of challenges
  • 24 Creatures to register in the bestiary

about_the_game:
Snow Fortress is a room-scale Virtual Reality snow fort building & battle game. Relive your childhood by building snow forts as you prepare for epic snowball fights! Unlock tools to protect your fort and deliver a fury of snowballs at your opponents!

Demo Features
5 Snow Fort Levels

Full Game Features
Build your snow forts and destroy the snowman's fort in 20 unique levels
Throw snowballs or use your slingshot to do some real damage
Build and maintain a fort while protecting it against waves of attacking snowmen in Survival Mode
Play against friends in online multiplayer
Unlock a shield and other tools to protect yourself and your fort
Compete in global leaderboards
Build a miniature snow fortress and defend it by placing your own snowmen on it's walls

Snow Fortress is created from the ground up for room-scale VR and supports both HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. It takes full advantage of tracked controllers to let you build the perfect snow fort ... and then watch it get trashed by an army of angry snowmen.

Oculus Rift support requires touch controllers, but does not need full 360 room-scale, 2 forward facing cameras are sufficient.

about_the_game:
Agelast is a single-player first-person horror game set in a South Korean school.

You don't know why you're here, you don't even remember how you got here.
Escape from school.
However, something is happening at school.
This school is obviously temporarily closed, but someone is there.
Interact with objects and find items to find your way out.

There are no puzzles except for pathfinding.
This is because I believe that puzzles during horror games can disrupt the flow of the game and cause irritation.

This game is conceived up to Chapter 3.
Currently, only Chapter 1 has been produced.

Control keys are specified in In-Game Pause (ESC).
This game does not support controllers. A mouse and keyboard are required to play.
Does not support 2560 x 1080 monitors.

Caution) It can contain shocking scenes

+ This game was made by a Korean high school student.
Please note this.

about_the_game:
Tina Lee is having a rough spot in life right now. The bar she co-owns with her best friend is losing money and she’s just found out that her husband of 3 years is cheating on her. Broke and depressed, she’s at a loss as to exactly what she should do with her life. about_the_game:
The Story of the Lost Dot is a unique, simple, and fun casual game in which you play as a small dot. You have fallen from your place after the words ‘THE END’ in the novel Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland. You will experience the classic tale in a whole new way as you literally dive into the text of the novel and begin a story of your own. You will go deeper and deeper inside the novel, trying to find your way, avoiding traps and enemies. You will need to find your way back to the end where you belong to make the story complete again.

  • Immerse yourself in the mystery as the last dot of the 1865 novel Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
  • Dodge Enemies and Avoid Traps
  • Solve Puzzles
  • Rewind Time

about_the_game:
Build Your Empire, Outsmart the Competition

Compete against AI-driven rival companies that will challenge your rise through takeovers, acquisitions, or price wars. Stay ahead by acquiring key ports, expanding your fleet, investing in shipyards, and making savvy economic moves. Outsmart opponents by mastering global trade, logistics, and dynamic market trends.

  • Advanced AI competitors with takeover strategies and market pressure

  • Dynamic business environment where every move counts

Deep Simulation, Real Strategy

Manage every aspect of your shipping business from purchasing vessels and designing routes to balancing regional demand and responding to economic events. Success demands sharp decision-making and smart resource allocation.

  • Full-scale management of ships, routes, ports, and resources

  • Responsive economic systems that reflect global and local trends

Cargo or Containers? Your Fleet, Your Strategy

Choose between customizable cargo ships and efficient container vessels. Optimize each ship's route and speed to maximize profits. As your business grows, build a diverse portfolio of assets from cutting-edge technology and capital to reputation and financial reserves.

  • Multiple ship classes with distinct advantages and customization options

  • Asset growth system including tech, capital, reputation, and infrastructure

Chart a Course to Global Shipping Enterprise

In Global Magnates, your success depends on smart, strategic planning. Master the art of global route optimization by analyzing supply and demand across ports, anticipating market shifts, and building the most profitable shipping lanes. Every decision brings you closer to becoming a logistics titan.

  • Real-time route planning influenced by live market demand

  • Interactive global trade map with evolving port activity

Mod-Friendly with Steam Workshop Support

Customize your game using the built-in editor. Modify ships, ports, economic parameters, or create entirely new gameplay experiences. Share your creations or download others' through Steam Workshop.

  • Full modding support with a powerful in-game editor

  • Active Steam Workshop integration for community-driven content
